tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// bstan bcos 'gyur ro 'tshal gyi dkar chag /

gang zhig srid 'dir dregs pa'i nga ro can// tshangs dang khyab 'jug mig stong ldan la sogs// 'jig rten gsum na ston par rlom rnams kyang*// chu skyes zhabs na lhag par skyabs 'gro pa'i// zla med ston pa gcig pu zas gtsang sras// rgyal ba shākya seng ge'i zhabs la 'dud// sku bzhi'i bdag nyid ston pa sangs rgyas dang*// des bstan thabs shes dbyer med dam pa'i chos// der gnas 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad la// sgo gsum kun nas dang bas phyag 'tshal lo// rgyal dang rgyal sras dgra bcom 'phags pa'i tshogs// bka' yi bsdu ba mdzad pa thams cad dang*// lnga rig paṇa grub sgra bsgyur 'jig rten mig /bka' drin can gyi skyes mchog thams cad rgyal// 'dir bdag cag gi ston pa lha dang bcas pa'i/ 'jig rten pa thams cad kyi skyabs gcig pu ston par khas 'che ba gzhan thams cad kyi 'gran par bzod dka' ba/ lha yi yang lhar gyur pa'i ston pa/ sngon bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i sngon rol nas skyon thams cad spangs/ yon tan thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i bdag nyid/ sa bcu gnyis kyi dbang phyug /mkhas pa chen po sgyu 'phrul 'chang ba/ sgyu 'phrul chen po'i mig 'phrul can du sangs rgyas zin nas/ 'dzam bu'i gling las kyi sa 'dir mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi tshul bstan nas/ de'i rjes su rgyal sras sa bcu'i dbang phyug chen po rdo rje snying po la sogs pa rnams dang*/ dgra bcom pa chos kyi spyan dang ldan pa'i 'phags pa rnams dang*/ so so skye bo dang*/ 'phags pa'i gang zag gi paṇ+ḍi ta rnams kyis bka' bsdu ba rim pa gsum gyis rgyal ba'i gsung rab thog mtha' bar gsum du dge ba rnams rim par bsdus shing rab tu phyi ba'i sgo nas bstan pa dam pa'i chos 'jig rten na gnas shing gsal bar mdzad la/ khyad par du 'jig rten gyi 'dren phyir dam par gyur pa'i skyes mchog skad gnyis smra ba'i lo paṇa khyad par can rnams dang*/

bod kyi rgyal sngon byang chub sems dpa' chos rgyal me dbon rnams gsum la sogs pas gangs ri'i khrod du bstan pa dam pa'i chos phal cher bsgyur zhing*/ 'chad nyan gyis gtan la phab nas zhus chen bgyis te dar cing rgyas par mdzad do// des na dam pa de rnams kyi rnam par thar pa ngo mtshar ba dag gdul bya gzhan rnams la bstan te dang ba bskyed pa'i ched dang*/ bstan pa rin po che yun ring du gnas pa'i phyir/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten pa thams cad kyis 'dren pa dam pa mtshungs pa med pa'i chos kyi rje rin po che'i karma pa'i zhal snga nas kyis bstan bcos bod du 'gyur ro 'tshal thug dam du bzhengs pa'i bstan bcos rnams kyi mtshan gyi rnam grangs tsam ni 'dir gang brjod par bya ba'i chos so// 'di la gnyis/ sngags dang*/ mtshan nyid kyi theg pa'i bstan bcos kyi phyogs gnyis so// dang po la gsum/ mchod par brjod pa bstod tshogs kyi skor/ dngos gzhi'i bstan chos rnams dang*/ bstan srung chos skyong dang nor lha sogs kyi skor ro// dang po la/ (ka)pa'i nang du/ thog mar ston pa sangs rgyas la khyad par du 'phags pa'i bstod pa/ slob dpon mtho btsun grub rjes mdzad pa/ dpal brtseg 'gyur/ de'i 'grel pa shes rab go chas mdzad pa/ lo chen 'gyur/ thams cad mkhyen pa dbang phyug chen po'i bstod pa mtho btsun grub rjes mdzad pa/ lha las phul du byung bar bstod pa/ slob dpon bde byed bdag pos mdzad pa/ de'i 'grel pa shes rab go chas mdzad pa/ de rnams lo chen 'gyur/ bsngags par 'os pa bsngags pa slob dpon ma ti tsi tras mdzad pa le'u bcu gnyis pa yan dpal brtseg 'gyur/ nor rgyun mas bstod pa nyi ma rgyal mtshan 'gyur/ mya ngan las 'das pa la bstod pa chos kyi grag pas mdzad pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa brgyad la bstod pa zhi ba 'tshos mdzad pa/ dbang bskur ba'i bstod pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa lnga la bstod pa/

de bzhin gshegs pa bdun la bstod pa rnams 'gyur gong ltar lo chen 'gyur/ rgyal ba brgyad pa'i bstod pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la bstod pa/ sangs rgyas thub pa la bstod pa dkon mchog 'bangs kyis mdzad pa/ sangs rgyas kyi mtshan la bstod pa ma ti tsi tras mdzad pa/ rab tu bsngags par nam langs pa'i bstod pa ha sa de bas mdzad pa/ gnas chen po brgyad kyi mchod rten la bstod pa slob dpon shir ha ri de bas yum gyi ched du mdzad pa/ de gnyis dzi na mi tra dang*/ yon tan dpal gyis 'gyur/ mchod rten brgyad kyi bstod pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa gnyis/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bstod pa ma ti tsi tras mdzad pa/ dkon mchog gsum la dbyig gnyen gyi bstod pa/ sangs rgyas kyi mtshan la bstod pa/ gcig las 'phros pa'i bstod pa ste gnyis ma ti tsi tras mdzad pa/ gaṇ+ḍi'i bstod pa rta dbyangs kyi mdzad pa/ dkon mchog gsum la bkra shis kyi bstod pa ma ti tsi tras mdzad pa/ brgya lnga bcu pa zhes bya ba'i bstod pa rta dbyangs kyis mdzad pa/ shra dha dang*/ shākya blo gros kyi 'gyur/ yon tan mtha' yas par bstod pa dkon mchog 'bangs kyis mdzad pa/ sarba de ba dang*/ rin chen mchog gi 'gyur las/ slar yang dpal brtseg kyis zhus pa/ spel mar bstod pa/ shākya tsi tra dang*/ phyogs glang dag gis mdzad pa/ ku ma ra ka la sha dang*/ bsod nams bzang pos bsgyur ba/ chos kyi dbyings su bstod pa/ sher phyin la bstod pa rngog 'gyur/ dpe med par bstod pa/ 'jig rten las 'das par bstod pa/ sems kyi rdo rje'i bstod pa/ don dam par bstod pa/ sku gsum gyi bstod pa/ sems can mgu bar bstod pa/ bsam gyis mi khyab par bstod pa/ bstod pa las 'das par bstod pa/ bla na med pa'i bstod pa/ dmyal ba nas 'don pa'i bstod pa rnams mgon po klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ ti la ka dang*/ pa tshab 'gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i mdzad pa bcu gnyis la bstod pa klu sgrub

the tshom kyis mdzad pa/ mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi bstod pa mdor bsdus jo bo the tshom rjes mdzad pa/ bshags bstod tsan tra go mis mdzad pa/ bshags bstod kyis 'grel pa slob dpon sangs rgyas zhi bas mdzad pa/ de nyid dang*/ lo chen 'gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan brjod pa skal bzang rgyan gyi phreng ba/ kha che paṇa chen gyis mdzad pa/ ma ti tsi tras mdzad pa'i dkon mchog gsum gyi bstod pa'i 'grel pa slob dpon rgyal ba'i sras kyis mdzad pa/ yon tan mtha' yas par bstod pa'i 'grel pa/ de'i don gyi tshig le'ur byas pa phyogs glang gis mdzad pa/ dpal brtsegs 'gyur/ sku gsum la bstod pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ de'i 'grel pa shra dhas mdzad pa/ lo chen 'gyur/ brgya lnga bcu pa zhes bya ba'i bstod pa'i 'grel pa dga' byed snyan pas mdzad pa/ shra dha dang*/ shākya blo gros kyis 'gyur/ bcom ldan 'das la/ bstod pa rdo rje 'dzin gyi dbyings/ bir+ya ka ra pra bha dang*/ dpal brtsegs 'gyur/ de'i 'grel pa zhi ba 'tshos mdzad pa/ dpal brtsegs 'gyur/ 'jam dbyangs la bstod pa rig pa'i khu byug gis mdzad pa/ 'dul ba la bstod pa slob dpon chos kyi tshang dpon gyis mdzad pa/ dzi na mi tra/ klu'i rgyan gyis mdzad pa/ 'jam dbyangs la bstod pa phyogs glang gis mdzad pa gu gum gzhon nu lta bu'i bstod pa mi g.yo seng ges mdzad pa/ jo bo dang*/ nag tsho 'gyur/ 'jam dbyangs kyi bstod pa byin brlabs dang bcas pa tsan dra go mis mdzad pa/ mar pa do pa'i 'gyur/ dpal ye shes yon tan bzang po'i bstod pa rdo rje mtshon cha la sogs pas mdzad pa/ dpal bo gcig grub kyi bstod pa gser phreng ngag dbang grags pas mdzad pa/ 'jam dbyangs kyi bstod pa jo bo ma tis mdzad pa/ gnyan lo dar ma grags kyis 'gyur ro// de bzhin gshegs pa dang 'jam dpal 'jig rten dbang phyug sgrol ma rnams la rgyal ba'i snyan bzang pos bstod pa/

de nyid dang*/ nyi ma rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i gyur/ 'jam dpal gyi bstod pa 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ klog skya gzhon nu 'bum bur gyi 'gyur/ 'jam dpal rnon po la bstod pa/ 'jam dpal la khye'u bcu drug gis bstod pa/ 'jam dpal la don dam pa'i bstod pa/ snying rje la bstod pa gnyis klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ 'jam dpal la bu mo brgyad kyi bstod pa/ mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i dkyil 'khor la bstod pa so ma shris mdzad pa/ ma hā dza na dang*/ gzhon nu 'od kyi 'gyur/ ngag gi dbang phyugs gtso 'khor la bstod pa thig le bum pas mdzad pa/ ngag gi dbang phyug gi bstod pa dze ta kar+ṇa dang*/ nyi ma rgyal mtshan 'gyur/ khyad par gyi bstod pa a nan+ta shris mdzad pa/ de nyid dang chos shes 'gyur/ 'jam dbyangs la bstod pa tsan+d+ra go mis mdzad pa/ su ma ti dang gnyan chung dar ma grags kyi 'gyur/ 'jam dpal gyi bstod pa byin rlabs dang bcas pa tsan+d+ra go mis mdzad pa'o// don zhag lha bcu drug la don rtags kyi sgo nas bstod pa dri med 'od/ thugs rje chen po la bstod cing bskul ba dge bsnyen zla bas mdzad pa/ 'gos 'gyur/ thugs rje chen po dge slong ma dpal mos bstod pa tshan pa gsum/ spyan ras gzigs kyi snying rje la bstod pa kun sbyin zla bas mdzad pa/ 'jig rten dbang phyugs la zla ba grags pas smre sngags kyi sgo nas bstod pa/ 'jig rten dbang phyug gis bstod pa brgya pa shri badz+ra de bas mdzad pa/ lak+ṣiṃ ka ra dang*/ shang 'gyur/ 'jig rten dbang phyug la a tsar+ya ṭi pa zhabs kyi bstod pa/ nyi ma rgyal mtshan 'gyur/ nor bu gling gi thugs rje chen po lha lnga la bstod pa rta dbyangs kyis mdzad pa/ 'jig rten dbang phyug 'khor bcas la bstod pa/ bstod pa yid phrog sdig 'joms gnyis tsan+t+ra go mis mdzad pa da na shi la'i rang 'gyur/ don yod zhags pa'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la bstod pa dri med 'od/

don yod zhag pa lha lnga la bstod pa e ra pa tis mdzad pa/ don yod rdo rje dang*/ rin chen grags kyi 'gyur/ don zhag lha lnga la bstod pa tsan+t+ra go mis mdzad pa/ thugs rje chen po la bstod pa tsan+t+ra go mis mdzad pa/ seng ge sgra'i bstod pa ti la kas mdzad pa/ mal gyo 'gyur/ spyan ras gzigs 'jigs pa brgyad la skyob pa'i bstod pa tsan+t+ra go mis mdzad pa mal gyo 'gyur/ gos sngon can gyi bstod pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ phyag na rdo rje la bstod pa ngag dbang grag pas mdzad pa/ phyag na rdo rje la don rtags kyi sgo nas bstod pa blo bo rjes mdzad pa de nyid dang*/ rgya brtson seng 'gyur/ mtshan nyid bsdus pa'i sgo nas bstod pa bir+ya tsan+t+ra mdzad pa/ phyag na rdo rje la sku gsung thugs kyi sgo nas bstod pa gcig /rdo rje dbyangs chen ma'i bstod pa dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa/ mar do 'gyur/ 'khor lo chen po lha tshogs la bstod pa sa ba ris mdzad pa/ de ba puṇ+ya ma ti dang*/ 'gar chos kyi bzang po'i 'gyur/ dbyangs chen ma la bstod pa grub pa ngag gi 'od zer bram ze phur bus mdzad pa/ sum pa dar ma yon tan gyi 'gyur/ rmug 'dzin la btsun pa zla bas mdzad pa/ pa tsab 'gyur/ rmug 'dzin la dz+nya na badz+ras bstod pa/ 'dzam bha la la mi'i dbang po nyi ma rnam par gnon pas bstod pa/ yar lung ba grags pa rgyal mtshan 'gyur/ rmug 'dzin 'chol pa'am man ngag gi bstod pa na byang chub sems dpas mdzad pa/ nor rgyun ma la bstod pa dza ma ris mdzad pa/ nag po chen po la bstod pa a wa dhu tis mdzad pa/ nag po chen po la sred med kyi bus bstod pa/ gdong can la bstod pa sangs rgyas grags kyis mdzad pa/ pre ta'i skad las se los bsgyur ba/ bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor la bstod pa lu i pas mdzad pa/ sur+ya gup+ta dang*/ 'gos lha btsas 'gyur las/ su ma ti kirti dang mar pa do pas zhus pa/ 'khor lo bde mchog gi lha tshogs la bstod pa gar gyi nyams dgu dril bu pas mdzad pa/

bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la bstod pa in+t+ra bhu tis mdzad pa/ 'khor lo sdom pa la rnam dag gi sgo nas bstod pa in+t+ra bhu tis mdzad pa/ bde mchog 'khor lo la bstod pa don thams cad grub pa rnam dag gtsug gi nor bu nog mi pas mdzad pa/ he ru ka'i bstod pa mtshan brgya tsa brgyad pa mkha' 'gro ma thams cad kyi snying pos bskul ba'i rgyud las phyung ba/ bde mchog 'khor lo la yon tan gyi sgo nas bstod pa/ bde mchog gi bstod pa in+t+ra bhu tis mkha' 'gro gnas su pradz+nya ka ra barma dang*/ rin chen bzang po'i gyur/ 'khor lo sdom pa'i bstod pa dha ri ka pas mdzad pa/ dharma badz+ra dang*/ brtson seng 'gyur/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i bstod pa rgyun chags pa dpal chos kyi grags pas mdzad pa/ chags lots+tsha'i 'gyur/ 'khor lo sdom pa'i bstod pa in+t+ra bo dhis mdzad pa/ 'khor lo sdom pa'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa'i bstod pa cig 'khor lo sdom pa'i bstod pa shu ra ka la shas mdzad pa/ bsod nams bzang po'i 'gyur/ 'khor lo sdom pa'i lha tshogs la bstod pa bram ze rin chen rdo rjes mdzad pa/ bstod pa dha ri ka pas mdzad pa/ dkyil 'khor la bstod pa rin chen sgyu 'phrul zhi ba dril bu pas mdzad pa/ mar do 'gyur/ 'khor lo sdom pa'i bstod pa mai tri pas mdzad pa/ yang bstod pa chos dbyings rnam dag ma/ jo bo rjes zhal gzigs dus bstod pa// smre bshags in+t+ra bu tis mdza pa/ bhu ti pa'i rgyun bshags nyung ngu*/ rdo rje phag mo'i bstod pa mdor bsdus ngag gi dbang phyug dang*/ klog skya 'gyur/ mkha' spyod ma dkar mo'i bstod pa jo bos mdzad pa/ lo chen 'gyur/ zhing gi dbang phyug ma'i bstod pa rgyu rigs shin tu dga' ba'i paṇ+ḍi tas mdzad pa/ bhu ri pas mdzad pa'i rgyun bshag kyai rdor bstod pa nyi shu pa mtsho skyes kyis mdzad pa/ dgyes pa rdo rje la bstod pa rin chen rdo rjes mdzad pa/

byang chub shes rab kyi 'gyur/ bdag med ma lha mo bco lnga'i bstod pa 'phags pa lhas mdzad pa/ ku ru ku le'i bstod pa ḍom+bhi he ru kas mdzad pa/ gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma'i bstod pa/ gdug dkar bstod pa girti brtas mdzad pa/ thugs rje chen po sgrol la mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad kyi sgo nas bstod pa gnyis/ seng ge lding nag sgrol gyi bstod pa/ dpal 'phel lha mo'i bstod pa ste gnyis klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ rnam dag gtsug gi nor bu sur+ya hi pas mdzad pa/ des mdzad pa'i mtshan sum bcu rtsa gnyis kyi sgo nas bstod pa don thams cad grub pa/ phreng ba 'dzin pa'i bstod pa/ smre sngags kyi sgo nas bstod pa gnyis thams cad mkhyen pa'i bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ me tog phreng ba'i bstod pa/ mu tig phreng ba'i bstod pa ste gnyis tsin+t+ra go mis mdzad pa/ sgrol ma'i bstod pa 'dzub ker ma tsan+t+ra go mis mdzad pa/ 'jigs pa brgyad skyob ma'i bstod pa dpal btsun zla bas mdzad/ dam tshigs sgrol ma'i bstod pa ngag gi dbang phyug gis mdzad pa/ sgrol dkar bstod pa 'khor ba las sgrol ta re ma/ sgrol ma la bstod pa mar me mdzad bzang pos mdzad pa/ tsan+t+ra go mis chus khyer dus bstod pa/ bstod pa don thams cad grub pa/ sgrol ma me tog rgyas mdzad ma'i bstod pa 'bum phrag gsum pas mdzad pa rnams bzhugs so// gnyis pa la bzhi/ rnal 'byor bla med dang*/ rnal 'byor dang*/ spyod pa dang*/ bya ba'i rgyud do// dang po la gnyis/ gsang sngags gsar ma dang*/ snga 'gyur rnying ma'i skor gyi bstan bcos so/ dang po la gsum/ gnyis med kyi rgyud du grags pa dus 'khor dang rnal 'byor ma rgyud dang*/ pha rgyud kyi phyogs kyi bstan bcos so// (kha)pa'i nang du/ snga rab pa rnams la gnyis med kyi rgyud du grags pa'i dus 'khor gyi skor la/ bsdus pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyas 'grel dri ma med pa'i 'od kyi le'u dang po'i rgyas 'grel dang*/

nang gi le'u dang*/ dbang gi le'u yi rgyas 'grel dang gsum bzhugs/ (ga)pa'i nang du/ bsgrub thabs kyi le'u dang gnyis kyi rgyas 'grel ste/ mdor na rgyud kyi rgyal po dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyas 'grel rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi rjes su 'jug pa stong phrag bcu gnyis pa dri ma med pa'i 'od ces bya ba pad ma dkar pos mdzad pa/ kha che'i paṇ+ḍi chen po so ma na thā dang*/ 'bro dge slong shes rab grags kyis bsgyur cing gtan la zhus te gtan la phab pa las/ dus phyis lots+tsha ba dge slong shong ston rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyis yul dbus kyi rgya dpe gnyis la gtug cing legs par bcos te gtan la phab pa las/ slar yang lo ts+tsha ba blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po dang*/ blo gros dpal bzang pos rgya dpe mang po la gtugs nas dag pa rnams dang mthun par bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa dang*/ go sla'i 'grel pa pad+ma can dus zhabs pas mdzad pa'i le'u dang po yan bzhugs/ (nga)pa la/ le'u lhag ma bzhi so ma na thas rang 'gyur mdzad pa/ dri med 'od kyi mdor bsdus dang po'i bshad sbyar a tsa la karmas mdzad pa yang blo brtan gyis bsgyur ba/ rang gi lta ba'i 'dod pa mdor bstan pa 'jam dpal grags pas mdzad pa bal po'i paṇ+ḍi ta mañju shri dang*/ chos grags dpal bzang pos bsgyur ba dang*/ pad ma dkar pos mdzad pa'i don dam bsnyen pa kha che zla mgon gyis rang 'gyur du mdzad pa/ dbang mdor bstan gyi 'grel pa dus zhabs pas mdzad pa kha che zla mgon dang 'bro 'gyur/ rnal 'byor gsum snying gi rang 'grel dang*/ nā ro pas mdzad pa'i sbyor drug shākya shri bha tra'i rang 'gyur/ a bh+ya kā ras mdzad pa'i sbyor drug de nyid dang*/ rtsi mi sangs rgyas grags kyis bsgyur ba/ sbyor ba yan lag drug dus zhabs pa mdzad pa/ bhud dhā kā ra bha tra dang gyis jo zla ba'i 'od zer gyis bsgyur ba rnams bzhugs so// (ca)pa la/ dbang mdor bstan 'grel pa na ro pas mdzad pa kha che'i paṇ+ḍi dharma dha ra dang*/

lots+tsha ba grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur ba/ dbang mdor 'grel pa ston lo ts+tshas bsgyur ba/ dbang rab byed 'grel pa dha ri ka pas mdzad pa 'brom 'gyur/ sbyor drug gi rgyud kyi 'grel pa a wa dhu tris mdzad pa sbas pa mi 'byed ces bya ba/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po zla ba grags pa'i 'gyur/ dus 'khor gyi dkyil chog dpal bo yid du 'ong ba dus zhabs pas mdzad pa paṇ+ḍi ta bhi shri dang*/ 'chi yon tan 'bar gyi 'gyur/ bsgrub thabs yan lag bzhi pa 'gyur gong dang 'dra ba dang*/ bsgrub thabs rgyas pa yan lag bcu gcig pa/ zla mgon dang*/ 'brom 'gyur/ de gsum dus zhabs pas mdzad pa dang*/ sa dhu su tras mdzad pa'i bsgrub thabs dang*/ dkyil chog gnyis rgya gar gyi mkhan po bha ki shwa ra gup+ta dang*/ lo ts+tsha ba dge slong chos rab kyis bsgyur ba dur khrod lhan skyes kyi bsgrub thabs rol pa'i rdo rje mdzad pa rnams bzhugs/ (cha)pa la/ rab gnas/ tshogs 'khor/ sbyin sreg rnams dus zhabs pas mdzad cing 'gyur gong dang 'dra/ ro bsreg gi cho ga sa dhu pu tras mdzad pa 'gyur gong dang 'dra ba dang*/ dus 'khor bstod pa rgyun chags sa dhu kit+tis mdzad pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta bi na ya shri mi tra dang*/ 'dan ma tshul khrims seng ge'i 'gyur/ snying po rgyan ces bya ba'i bsgrub thabs bram ze bsod snyoms pas mdzad pa paṇ+ḍi ta bha tra bo dhe dang*/ gyi jo 'gyur/ nang gi snye ma bhi bhu ti tsan+t+ras mdzad pa de nyid kyis rang 'gyur/ rtsa mi sangs rgyas grags pas mdzad pa'i sbyor phreng khams pa dge tshul shes rab dpal gyi 'gyur/ sdom tshig a bh+ya ka ras mdzad pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta jo bo ri dang*/ khe'u rgad pa 'khor lo grags pas bsgyur ba dang*/ dus kyi 'khor lo la 'jug pa a bh+ya kā ras mdzad pa de nyid dang*/ dhar+m+ma ki rti shris bsgyur ba las/ slar yang ra hū la shri bha tra dang*/ chag los bsgyur ba/ rtsis kyi man ngag /nyi zla gzas 'dzin gyi man ngag

/gza' lnga so so'i rkyang rtsis kyi man ngag rnams shākya shris mdzad pa/ sbyor drug gi gzhung dpe med mtshos mdzad pa/ bhi bhu ti tsan+t+ra dang*/ gnyal lo ts+tsha ba mi mnyam bzang pos bsgyur ba dang*/ de'i 'grel pa nyi ma dpal gyis mdzad pa bhi bhu ti ts+tshan+t+ra'i 'gyur/ lhan skyes rol pa'i rdo rje mdzad pa thar lo 'gyur/ phyag na rdo rjes mdzad pa'i sbyor drug cog ro ting nge 'dzin bzang pos bsgyur ba/ sha ba ris mdzad pa'i sbyor drug bhi bhu ti tsan+t+ra'i 'gyur/ rdo rje tshig gis rgyas 'grel shākya shris mdzad pa de nyid dang dpyal chos bzang gi 'gyur/ zab lam rdo rje gsum gyi bsnyen bsgrub rdo rje'i tshigs rkang*/ dri med bshes gnyen ti pu pas mdzad pa'i phyag rgya chen po zab mo bsnyen bsgrub kyi gdams pa/ ༈ mtshan brjod 'grel pa 'jam dpal grags pas mdzad pa/ a bha ya dang*/ sbas rdo rje rgyal po'i 'gyur/ mtshan brjod 'grel pa dri med 'od pad ma dkar pos mdzad pa dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa bsod snyoms pas bsgyur ba/ mtshan brjod phan yon gyi 'grel pa sngags don snying po bsdus pa dus zhabs pas mdzad pa/ a bha ya dang*/ rdor rgyal 'gyur/ mtshan brjod kyi mngon par rtogs pa zhes bya ba spyan ras gzigs kyis mdzad pa rnams bzhugs/ (ja)pa las/ mtshan brjod 'grel pa bdud rtsi thigs pa sgron ma gsal ba zhi mo rnams 'thag ces bya ba paṇ+ḍi ta chen po a nu sa ma rak+ṣi tas mdzad pa kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta su ga ta shri dang*/ lo ts+tsha ba dharma kirti dang*/ dge slong rdo rje rgyal mtshan 'gyur/ mtshan brjod 'grel pa bdud rtsi thigs pa nyi ma dpal ye shes kyi mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta nor bu dpal ye shes dang*/ re wen tra dang*/ chags los bsgyur ba las/ slar yang dge slong slob dpon dpal bzang pos bcos pa dang*/ mtshan brjod 'grel par rad na aka ra gup+tas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po ka la tsakra dang*/

lots+tsha ba dz+nya na garba sogs kyi 'gyur/ mtshan brjod 'grel pa ḍom bhi he ru kas mdzad pa khyung grags 'gyur/ 'grel pa mngon par rtogs pa gnyis med rdo rjes mdzad pa pradz+nya shri kir tis rang 'gyur du mdzad pa/ mtshan brjod 'grel pa a wa dhu tis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dharma shri mi tra dang*/ lots+tsha ba chos bzang gis bsgyur ba/ nye bar bsdus pa'i rtog ge gnyis med rdo rjes mdzad pa/ sha dha bo dhe dang*/ dpyal bsod nams rgyal mtshan 'gyur/ man ngag sngags don rnams gzigs dang de'i rjes su 'brang ba gnyis med rdo rjes mdzad pa nye bar sbyar ba'i rtog ge sbyar ba'i bsdus don dang*/ me tri pa'i gdams ngag nye bar bsdus pa phreng bzhi/ me tri pas mdzad pa las nye bar bsdus shing zab cing rgya che ba'i 'grel pa dril bu pas mdzad pa/ mañju shri sidhi dang*/ blo ldan shes rab 'gyur/ mtshan brjod 'grel pa mtshan don gsal bar byed pa gnyis med sbas pas mdzad pa/ dharma shri mi tra dang lots+tsha ba dge slong chos kyi bzang po'i 'gyur rnams bzhugs/ gnyis pa la/ rig drug ka mnyam par ston pa'i rgyud dang*/ he ru ka'i rigs dang*/ rtag pa'i rig dang*/ rdo rje nyi ma'i rigs dang*/ pad ma gar dbang gi rigs dang*/ rta mchog gi rigs rdo rje 'chang gi rigs dang bdun du gnas pa la/ dang po ni/ sngags rnying ma ba rnams kyi rgyud sde bco brgyad du phye ba'i tshe sku'i rgyud du gsungs pa ltar der bzhugs so/ gnyis pa la bde chog /kyai rdor/ sangs rgyas thod pa/ ma hā ma ya/ a ra li ste lnga gsungs pa las/ dang po la rtsa rgyud dang*/ bshad rgyud/ bsgrub dkyil sogs dang*/ zhar la phag mo'i skor rnams so// dang po ni/ (nya)pa la/ mngon par brjod pa 'bum pa las phyung ba nyung ngu'i rgyud kyi bsdus pa'i don rnam par bshad pa le'u dang po'i rgyas 'grel byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rjes mdzad pa rgya gar gyis mkhas pa chen po dpal 'byor zhi ba dang*/

cog gru lo ts+tsha ba dge slong ting 'dzin bzang pos bsgyur ba las/ dus phyis shong blo brtan gyis bcos shing*/ slar yang blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos bcos pa dang*/ bsgrub thabs kyi gling gzhi zhes bya ba la ba pas mdzad pa/ mkhan po sur+ya gup+ta dang*/ 'gos lha btsas 'gyur/ bsgrub thabs gnas pa'i man ngag thams cad rgya cher bshad pa lha sbas kyis mdzad pa dang 'di gnyis gcig tu snang*/ dka' 'grel lang ka rgyal bzang gis mdzad pa/ gnyis ka'i bshad sbyar ta thā ga ta rak+ṣi tas mdzad pa de nyid dang*/ lo ts+tsha ba dar ma blo gros kyi 'gyur rnams bzhugs/ (ta)pa la/ bsgrub thabs kyi gling gzhi slob dpon kaṃ pa las bshad pa/ bai ro tsa na dang gyi jo 'gyur/ rnam 'grel yon tan ma lus pa'i gnas ces bya ba dpal bo rdo rjes mdzad pa/ ba ri lo ts+tsha dang*/ paṇ+ḍi ta chos skyong gi 'gyur/ in+t+ra bā+o dhis mdzad pa'i 'grel pa rnams so// (tha)pa la/ dka' 'grel rin po che'i tshogs dka' rgyal zla bas mdzad pa/ mkhan po ta ra shu kla dang*/ dge slong kun shri'i 'gyur/ dpa' bo yid du 'ong ba skal ldan grags pas mdzad pa/ dharma shri bha tra dang*/ lo chen rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ dka' 'grel bha ba bha tras mdzad pa/ mi nyam rdo rje dang ba ri 'gyur/ bsdus don gyi 'grel pa/ jo bo rje dang*/ khu ston dngos grub kyi 'gyur rnams bzhugs/ (da)pa la/ rgyas 'grel tshig don rab tu gsal ba dpa' bo rdo rjes mdzad pa'o// de dag rtsa rgyud kyi skabs so/ gnyis pa bshad rgyud dang bsgrub dkyil sogs kyis skor la/ rtsa rgyud kyi man ngag thams cad mngon zhing nges par brjod pa'i rgyud kyi 'grel pa shu ram ga mdzad pa/ zangs skar 'phags pa shes rab kyis 'gyur rnams bzhugs/ (na)pa la/ 'khor lo bde mchog gi bsgrub thabs de kho na nyid kyi snying po zhes bya ba byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rjes mdzad pa/ so ma na tha'i rang 'gyur/

phyi rol mchod chog mdor bsdus rtag pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa su ma ti kit+ti dang mar do 'gyur/ phag mo'i lag pa mchod pa'i cho ga mdzad pa po sogs gong dang 'dra/ bde mchog gi gtor chog mdzad pa po sogs 'dra ba dang*/ dpa' bo drug gi mngon rtogs ka na ka shris mdzad pa 'gyur 'dra ba dang*/ dpa' mo drug gi mngon rtogs 'gyur gong dang 'dra/ lu i pa'i mngon rtogs kyi dka' 'grel pradz+nya rak+ṣi tas mdzad pa dang*/ mngon rtogs kyi dka' 'grel rnam par 'byed pa jo bo rjes mdzad pa de nyid dang*/ nag tsho tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ li hi pas mdzad pa'i bsgrub thabs mar do 'gyur/ mngon rtogs gi bshad pa zhes bya ba dang*/ mngon rtogs kyi 'grel pa sdom pa 'byung ba bde ba'i rdo rjes mdzad pa bi bhu ti'i rang 'gyur/ mngon rtogs kyis 'grel pa khyad par gsal byed de bzhin gshegs pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa snga 'gyur 'dra ba las khro chu lo ts+tshas dag par bcos pa dang*/ bde mchog bcu gsum ma'i mngon rtogs rab tu dga' ba'i rdo rjes mdzad pa dang*/ mngon rtogs kyi man ngag 'khrul spongs a bh+ya ka ras mdzad pa da na shi la'i rang 'gyur/ dbang rab byed a bh+yas mdzad pa dang*/ dril bu pa'i gzhung lnga yong grag gzhung gsum zer na/ bde chog lha lnga'i bsgrub thabs su ma ti kit+ti dang*/ mar do 'gyur/ lus dkyil rat+na rak+ṣi ta dang*/ chag 'gyur/ dbang gi bya ba'i rim pa mdor bsdus sgra tshad pa rin chen rnam rgyal gyi 'gyur/ rim pa lnga pa/ su ma ti kit+ti dang*/ blo ldan shes rab kyi 'gyur/ bde mchog phyag gnyis pa'i bsgrub thabs rat+na rak+ṣi dang*/ chag 'gyur ste lnga'o// lhan skyes a bh+yas mdzad pa/ rim lnga'i 'grel pa sangs rgyas 'byung gnas chen po dang 'gos 'gyur/ nag po pas mdzad pa'i bsgrub thabs/ ngag gi dbang phyug dang*/ mar do 'gyur/ dkyil 'khor dharma shri bha tras dang*/ lo chen 'gyur/

sbyin sreg dharmā shri bha tra dang*/ dge slong rig pa gzhon nu'i gyur ro// sbyin bsregs 'jam pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa/ 'di bod yin kyang bris zin nas bzhag /dpyid kyi thig le/ su ma ti kit+ti dang*/ mar do 'gyur/ gsang ba'i de kho na nyid gha ya dha ra dang*/ 'gos 'gyur las slar yang su ma ti kirta dang*/ mar do 'gyur/ rim pa bzhi pa 'gyur gong dang 'dra/ rim pa bzhi pa'i rang 'grel 'bro shes rab grags kyi 'gyur/ sgron ma bzhi ces bya ba man ngag gi ṭik+ka shi dha ra nyid kyi brtsams te bsgyur ba ste de rnams nag po pas mdzad pas so// sgron ma bzhi'i dka' 'grel rin chen rdo rjes mdzad pa shri dha ras bsgyur cing zhus pa rnams bzhugs/ (pa)pa la/ bsgrub thabs thub dka' zla bas mdzad pa bdud rtsi 'dzag pa/ bde mchog shes par byed pa zhes bya ba byang chub rdo rjes mdzad pa/ badz+ra shri bo dhi dang dge ba'i blo gros kyis 'gyur/ sgrub thabs lang ka rgyal bzang gis mdzad pa/ don yod rdo rje dang*/ rin chen grags kyi 'gyur/ he ru ka'i bsgrub thabs mdor bsdus bram ze bh+riṃ ga ras mdzad pa/ bcu gsum ma dang*/ lha lnga'i bsgrub thabs ti paṃ ka ra shri dz+nya nas mdzad pa de nyid dang*/ lo chen 'gyur/ he ru ka lha re gnyis pa'i bsgrub thabs rin chen rdo rjes mdzad pa dharma shri bha tra dang*/ rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ bsgrub thabs nyin mor mdzad kyis mdzad pa/ shri su bhu ti shan ti dang*/ dge blo'i 'gyur/ dkyil chog yid 'ong phreng ba dpa' bo rdo rjes mdzad pa/ dkyil mchog bhu ba blo ldan gyis mdzad pa/ dkyil chog rgya gu brgya pa lang ka rgyal bzang gis mdzad pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta 'jam dpal dang*/ ba ri'i 'gyur/ dkyil chog de bzhin gshegs pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa bhi bhu ti tsan+t+ra'i rang 'gyur rnams lta te gnyis pa 'o// bde mchog gi dbang gi cho ga'i rab byed bde ba'i rdo rjes mdzad pa/

shri ba ra he ta dang*/ dge slong shes rab rgyal mtshan gyis 'gyur/ lā ba pas mdzad pa'i bcu gsum ma'i sgrub thabs dang*/ dkyil chog gnyis su ma ti kat+ti dang mar do 'gyur/ bcu gsum ma'i bsgrub thabs gnyis med rdo rjes mdzad pa/ slob dpon sha ba ri pa'i rim pa bha ran tra ru rtse dang*/ rma ban chos 'bar 'gyur/ rnal 'byor ma kun spyod kyi bshad sbyar ta thā ga ta rak+ṣi tas mdzad pa de nyid dang*/ dharma kit+ti'i 'gyur/ gsang ba rdo rje'i rgyud kyi 'grel pa yang dag lam ston/ ḍom+bhi pas mdzad pa/ rin chen rdo rje dang*/ 'brog 'gyur/ rtsa rgyud kyi mtshams sbyar nā ro pa'i rjes su 'brang pa su ma ti kit+tis mdzad pa de nyid/ grags 'byor shes rab 'gyur/ sdom pa bshad pa nag po pas mdzad pa 'or ston chos 'byung gi 'gyur/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rgyud kyi dka' 'grel de nyid rab tu bstan pa nor bzang gis mdzad pa/ gha ya dha ra dang*/ gyi jo 'gyur/ (pha)pa la/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rgyud kyi 'grel pa bha ba bha tras mdzad pa/ gha ya dha ra dang*/ 'gos 'gyur/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i bsgrub thabs byang sems kun tu gzigs pa'i phreng ba shri ka ra ya dang*/ 'gos 'gyur/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i dkyil chog dpa' bo rdo rjes mdzad pa rnams bzhugs so// (ba)pa la/ bde mchog dang cha mthun gyi rgyud mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i skor la rgyud kyi 'grel pa gru gzing pad ma badz+ra gyis mdzad pa/ mkhas pa dza ya se nas mdzad pa'i rin chen sna bdun la/ sgrub thabs rin po che pad ma ra ga'i gter/ sum pa dar ma yon tan gyi 'gyur rnams bzhugs/ (ma)pa la/ dkyil chog rin po che dbang gi rgyal po'i mdzod/ ye shes rdo rje'i 'gyur/ bstod pa rkang pa bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad pa shri dza ya se na dang*/ dar ma yon tan gyi 'gyur/ gtor ma'i cho ga rin po che asma gar+bha dang*/ bla ma'i maṇ+ḍal rin po che mar gad/ sbyin sreg gi cho ga rin po che me shel ste gsum po ye shes rdo rje'i 'gyur/

'dir rab gnas dang*/ tshogs 'khor gnyis btsal dgos/ sdom 'byung gi rgyud kyi 'grel pa pad ma can rad na rak+ṣi tas mdzad pa thams cad mkhyen pa dang dpal bzang pos rang 'gyur du mdzad pa las/ slar yang blo brtan gyis bsgyur ba dang*/ sdom 'byung gi dkyil chog rad na rak+ṣi tas mdzad pa thams cad mkhyen pa dpal bzang pos rang 'gyur du mdzad pa las/ slar yang rad na rak+ṣi ta dang paṇ+ḍi ta ma ṇi ka shri dz+nya na'i zhal snga nas/ chag lo ts+tshas bcos pa dang*/ bde mchog nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sgrub thabs rdo rje mtshon chas mdzad pa/ kha che dz+nya na badz+ra rang 'gyur/ bde mchog lha lnga'i bsgrub thabs/ maṇ+ḍal gyi cho ga nang gi mchod chog /sbyin sreg gi cho ga /zhi ba'i sbyin sreg rnams nā ro pas mdzad pa rnams dang*/ yig ge bdun pa lha bdun gyi bsgrub thabs nag po pas mdzad pa/ mkhan po ngag gi dbang phyug dang*/ klog skya shes rab rtsegs dang mar do 'gyur/ yig ge bdun pa lha bdun gyi sgrub thabs gnyis med rdo rjes mdzad pa/ mar do 'gyur/ yig ge bdun pa'i bsgrub thabs lha bdun ma rgyal dka' zla bas btus pa dang*/ bdag byin brlabs pa ri khrod chen po'i gsung me nyag lots+tsha'i 'gyur/ bdag byin brlabs pa ri khrod chen po'i gsung phreng bzhi/ rang byin brlabs pa'i man ngag ma tshang ba/ bde mchog gi bsgrub thabs slob dpon 'i pas mdzad pa/ de kho na'i snying po zhes bya ba'i bsgrub thabs dar byed go chas mdzad pa kha che bi na ya ka dang rngog 'gyur/ bde mchog dpa' gcig zhal phyag rdzogs pa'i bsgrub thabs lo hi pas mdzad pa/ dharma shri bha tra dang lo chen 'gyur las/ chag dgra bcom gyi 'gyur/ gzhan yang dpa' gcig gi sgrub thabs la/ rin chen rdo rjes mdzad pa/ rab 'byor zhi ba dang*/ ting 'dzin bzang po'i 'gyur/ gar+bha ris mdzad pa/ ma ṇi ka shis mdzad pa/ pradz+nya kirti dang*/ su ma ti kit+ti dang*/ mar do 'gyur/ mar me mdzad ye shes kyis mdzad pa de nyid dang*/
nag tsho 'gyur/ ḍoṃ bhi he ru kas mdzad pa 'gyur gong dang 'dra ba rnams so// rab gnas kyi cho ga nag po pas mdzad pa/

'di kye rdor du snang*/ bde mchog gi rab gnas gnyis med rdo rjes mdzad pa badz+ra pa ṇi dang*/ chos 'gyur/ rab gnas cho ga thun mong ba su ma ti kirtis mdzad pa/ tshogs 'khor cho ga nag po pas mdzad pa/ sbyin sreg gi cho ga dharma shri bha tra dang*/ rig pa gzhon nu'i 'gyur/ sbyin bsreg gi cho ga bram ze chen pos mdzad pa rab 'byor zhi ba dang*/ ting 'dzin bzang po'i 'gyur/ ro sreg gi cho ga ta thā ga ta rak+ṣi tas mdzad pa/ rig ldan ma'i de kho na nyid nges pa u rgyan du grub pas mdzad pa ti paṃ ka ra'i 'gyur/ gzhon nu ma'i mchod chog stong nyid snying rje ting 'dzin gyis mdzad pa bhi bhu ti tsan+t+ra'i rang 'gyur/ bdud rtsi lnga yi lus grub pa'i thabs bhi bhu ti tsan+t+ras phyag rdor dang*/ la ba pa'i 'grel pa nas phyung ste mdzad pa de nyid kyi rang 'gyur/ thod pa mchod chog /gtor ma byin brlabs/ gtor mas mchod chog rnams mar me mdzad ye shes kyis mdzad pa de nyid dang*/ lo chen 'gyur/ o ṭi ya na'i rnal 'byor pa dang rnal 'byor ma'i rang byung gi longs spyod dur khrod kyi rtog pa bir wa pas bsdus pa pradz+nya kit+ti'i rang 'gyur/ bzang sbyin gyis mdzad pa'i tshogs 'khor cho ga /shākya shri bha tra dang*/ kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i 'gyur/ 'du ba bsgrag pa ḍom+bhi pas mdzad pa pradz+nya shri dz+nya na'i rang 'gyur/ las rgya brtag pa rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud chen po nas a mo gha badz+ras phyung ba de nyid dang*/ 'gos 'gyur/ rjes chags kyi sbyor bas de kho na'i rnal 'byor la 'jug pa'i man ngag don yod rdo rjes mdzad pa dang*/ dbang chos rten 'brel gyi 'gro ldog nā ro pas/ te pu pa dang*/ rma 'gyur/ dug lnga spangs pa 'phags pa lhas mdzad pa/ snying po rir bsgrub pa dza lan dha ris mdzad pa dang*/ lhan skyes de nyid snang ba dpag med rdo rjes mdzad pa/ ti paṃ ka ra rak+ṣi ta dang*/ mar do 'gyur/

bsam gtan gyi man ngag rnal 'byor gyi gtum mo dge ba'i mgon pos mdzad pa/ bal po wa ki shwa dang*/ mar do 'gyur/ snying po'i de nyid bsdus pa ku su lu pas mdzad pa/ 'gyur gong dang 'dra ba dang*/ de kho na nyid kyi man ngags ku su lu pas mdzad pa/ kha che bha tra bo dhi dang*/ mar do 'gyur/ lhan cig skyes pa'i de nyid snang ba ku su lus mdzad pa kha che de ba a ka ra tsan+t+ra kirti'i rang 'gyur rnams bzhugs so// zhar la rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skor la/ (tsa)pa la/ mchog tu sbas pa keng rus ta ra na'i rim pa rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bsgrub thabs bdag byin gyis brlabs pa rdo rje gdan na bzhugs pa lha 'dre bran du 'khol ba'i slob dpon chen po rgya yis mdzad pa/ de'i 'grel pa gzhan la phan pa zhes bya ba ku ma ra bho dis mdzad pa/ zhing gi dbang phyug ma mchod pa'i rim pa pa ra he ta dang*/ shes rab rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ rnal 'byor ma'i bsgrub thabs nā ro ta pas mdzad pa/ su ma ti kirti dang*/ pradz+nya kirti'i 'gyur/ rnal 'byor ma'i bsgrub thabs mngon rtogs kyi snye ma da na shi la'i rang 'gyur/ phag mo'i bsgrub thabs byang sems rgyal po seng ge'i gdan can khyab 'jug sbas pas sbyar ba/ 'jig med lha dang pradz+nya kit+tis bsgyur ba/ dpa' mo gcig pa'i bsgrub thabs/ rdo rje phag mo'i bsgrub thabs pradz+nya bha tras mdzad pa u rgyan nas byung ba'i rdo rje phag mo'i bsgrub thabs gnyis mar do 'gyur/ phag mo'i bsgrub thabs dril bu pas mdzad pa/ rnal 'byor ma'i bsgrub thabs dza lan dha ri pas mdzad pa/ jo bo rjes mdzad pa/ ri khrod dbang phyug gis mdzad pa/ in+t+ra bo dhis mdzad pa/ phag mo dkar mo'i bsgrub thabs kang kas mdzad pa/ yang phag dkar ma'i bsgrub thabs/ sngags kyi byin brlabs in+t+ra bo dhis mdzad pa/ phag mo brtag pa don thams cad grub pa dang*/ sbyin bsreg gi de nyid/ bsgrub thabs leg smin ka ras mdzad pa/

rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i 'grel pa dha ri ka pas mdzad pa/ da na shi la'i 'gyur/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i man ngag mdzad pa po sogs gong dang 'dra/ bsgrub thabs me tri pas mdzad pa/ mchod chog ba ri bas mdzad pa/ mngon pa'i ku ma da'i gdams pa dang*/ grub thob rngon pas mdzad pa'i mkha' spyod ma dmar po'i bsgrub thabs/ slob ma rjes bzung gi cho ga dang*/ tshogs 'khor cho ga gnyis sha ba ris mdzad pa/ phag mo'i bsgrub thabs don thams cad grub pa dang*/ yang phag mo'i bsgrub thabs gnyis a wa dhu ti gnyis med rdo rjes mdzad pa/ rdo rje phag mo la sogs pa mchod sogs mdor bsdus badz+ra pā ṇi dang mtshur dbang nge'i 'gyur/ slob ma rjes gzung*/ gtor ma'i cho ga sogs dang*/ ye shes dbab pa/ ye shes 'pho ba'i rim pa a wa dhu tis mdzad cing*/ lag mchod/ mchod chog de kho na nyid ye shes yang dag par grub pa'i rgya cher 'grel pa de kho na nyid bshad pa brtson 'grus dpal bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta mañju shri dang nyi ma rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ he ru ka mngon 'byung gi dka' 'grel zla ba gzhon nus mdzad pa mkhan po ta thā ga ta rak+ṣi ta'i zhal snga nas/ lots+tsha ba dar ma blo gros kyi 'gyur/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i rgyud kyi rgya cher 'grel pa shin+ti pas mdzad pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta shu n+ya ta sa ma ti dang*/ shes rab ye shes kyi 'gyur/ gsang chen pad ma'i rgya chen 'grel pa kha che longs spyod rdo rjes mdzad pa de nyid kyi 'gyur/ phag mo mngon byung lha so bdun ma u ma pa ti tras mdzad pa/ mkhan po wa ti pa dang chos rab kyi 'gyur/ de'i dkyil chog mdzad pa po sogs 'dra ba dang*/ nā ro mkha' spyod kyi gzhung nā ro pas mdzad pa dang*/ mā+ai tri mkha' spyod kyi bsgrub thabs dang rjes gnang rgyal ba'i sde ming gzhan khang pas mdzad pa dang*/ phag mo las bcu'i bsgrub thabs slob ma rjes bzung dang bcas pa/ sngags kyi de nyid rnams in+t+ra bhu tis mdzad pa/

slob ma rjes bzung phyir zlog gi cho ga dang bcas pa bha ran tra ru tses mdzad pa/ ye shes rdo rje'i 'gyur/ phag mo rin chen rgyan gyi sgrub thabs tshan pa gnyis dang*/ phag mo brda bzhi'i gzhung jo bos mdzad pa de nyid dang*/ rgya brtson seng ge 'gyur/ ru sbal zhabs kyi bsgrub thabs a nan ta ka ra'i zhal snga nas dpyal chos bzang gi 'gyur/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i gsang bsgrub/ zhal gzigs kyi bsgrub thabs/ nye bsgrub gsang bsgrub yid bzhin nor bu/ sku gsung thugs rgyun mdzad ma'i bsgrub thabs rnams nā ro pas mdzad pa de nyid dang*/ chos blo 'gyur/ phag mo gzhung drug gi zhal gnyis ma chung ba'i bsgrub thabs/ mkhan po bsod nams 'byung gnas 'gyur/ dbu bcad ma'i bsgrub thabs che chung gnyis bir wa pas mdzad pa/ bha ran tra ru rtse dang*/ 'di gsum rma chos 'bar 'gyur/ shes rab gsal byed ma'i bsgrub thabs/ dbang du bya ba/ bstod pa rnams kaṃ ka na pa tas rin chen srung ba dang*/ grub pa dpal bzang po'i 'gyur ste bde mchog gi skor rnams so/ gnyis pa kyai rdor gyi skor la/ rtsa rgyud kyi skabs ni/ kyai'i rdo rje'i bsdus pa'i don gyi rgya cher 'grel pa byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje snying pos mdzad pa/ mkhan po da na shi la dang*/ 'bro seng dkar shākya 'od sogs kyi 'gyur las dpang los dag par bcos pa rnams bzhugs/ (tsha)pa la/ de'i smad mai tra pa las mnyan te 'gro shes rab grags kyis 'gyur/ dka' 'grel nā ro pas mdzad pa shākya shri bzang po'i zhal snga nas/ lots+tsha ba chos kyi bzang po dang dpang lo'i 'gyur/ dka' 'grel rdo rje'i tshig bsdus ka ma dhe nus mdzad pa/ mkhan po bi na ya de ba dang*/ lots+tsha ba chos shes kyis 'gyur/ dka' 'grel pad ma can mtsho skyes kyis mdzad pa/ mkhan po k+ṣi ti garba'i zhal snga nas/ lots+tsha ba khu ston dngos grub kyis bsgyur ba/ dka' 'grel ku mu ṭi mi thub zla bas mdzad pa/

pradz+nya in+t+ra tu tsi dang*/ shāka ye'i 'gyur rnams bzhugs/ (dza)pa la/ dka' 'grel dran pa'i 'byung gnas nag po pas mdzad pa/ mkhan po skal ldan dga' ba dang*/ 'gos lha btsas 'gyur/ 'grel bshad kha sbyor dri ma med pa dam ka dha shas mdzad pa s+thi ra ma ti'i 'gyur rnams bzhugs/ (wa)pa la/ shan+ti pas mdzad pa'i 'grel pa mu tig phreng ba a wa dhu ti pa dang*/ shākya brtson 'grus kyis 'gyur/ rnam 'grel bha wa bha tras mdzad pa/ mkhan bu ra na kirti dang*/ lots+tsha ba bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis 'gyur/ dka' 'grel spyan 'byed sgron ma dharma kirtis mdzad pa rnams bzhugs so// (zha)pa la/ dka' 'grel rin po che'i sbyor ba'i phreng ba dam tshig rdo rjes mdzad pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta chen po nag po'i zhal snga nas dang*/ 'gos 'gyur/ rtsa rgyud kyi skabs so// bsgrub dkyil gyi skor la/ kye'i rdo rje'i bsgrub thabs mtsho skyes kyis mdzad pa/ gha ya dha ra dang*/ 'brog mi shākya ye shes kyi 'gyur/ ḍom bhi pas mdzad pa'i bdag med ma'i man ngag bdud rtsi 'od kyi bsgrub thabs 'gyur gong dang 'dra ba dang*/ tshogs 'khor cho ga /'du ba bsgrags pa/ de kho na nyid bcu pa jo bo dang*/ dge blo 'gyur/ lhan cig skyes grub 'brog mi 'gyur rnams ḍom bhi he ru kas mdzad pa'o// tshogs 'khor dam tshigs lnga pa dang*/ mar me'i rtse mo lta bu'i gdams pa mtsho skyes kyis mdzad pa phyi ma 'brog mi 'gyur/ bsgrub thabs yan lag drug pa/ gtor ma'i cho ga gnyis mi thub zla bas mdzad pa 'brog mi 'gyur/ bsgrub thabs de kho na nyid gsal ba nag po pas mdzad pa/ nag tso 'gyur/ dkyil chog nag po pas mdzad pa de nyid dang*/ chos shes 'gyur/ bsgrub thabs rnam par dag pa'i gter mai tri pas mdzad pa/ a dhu l+ya dha sa badz+ra dang*/ mar do 'gyur/ bsgrub thabs rin chen 'bar ba dpa' bo rdo rjes byas pa de nyid/ 'brog 'gyur/ rdo rje glu'i bshad pa sgron ma mkhan gyis sdes mdzad pa 'brog 'gyur/

rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi bshad pa rnams grangs bdun gyi le'u klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ mañju gho sha dang*/ shes rab grags kyi 'gyur/ slongs mo'i 'grel pa ḍo bhi pas mdzad pa/ u rgyan nas 'ongs pa'i kyai rdor gyi rgyud rin po che'i mngon rtogs kyi rim pa 'brog 'gyur/ de kho na nyid kyi rim pa/ dur khrod brgyad kyi bshad pa gnyis/ brda nges par bzung ba/ glu'i de nyid pad mas mdzad pa rnams 'brog 'gyur/ rim pa bzhi pa nag po pas mdzad pa dang*/ de nyid snang ba so ma nā tha'i 'gyur/ bsgrub thabs kyi don gsal bar byed pa dril bu pas mdzad pa 'brog 'gyur/ 'khrul spong shan+tis mdzad pa/ bsgrub thabs rin chen sgron ma mar me mdzad ye shes kyis mdzad pa/ dpa' bo gcig pa ḍom bhi he ru kas mdzad pa dang*/ nag po pas mdzad pa/ zhal gsum pa'i bsgrub thabs yan lag med pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa/ phyag bcu drug pa'i sgrub thabs kriṣ+ṇas mdzad pa/ he ru ka phyag bcu drug pa'i bsgrub thabs dang*/ bsgrub thabs bde ba'i rdo rjes mdzad pa rnams bzhugs/ (za)pa la/ phyag gnyis pa'i bsgrub thabs sa ha badz+ra bi la pas mdzad pa rma 'gyur/ lhan skyes kyi bsgrub thabs shri a nan tas mdzad/ he ru ka mnyes par bya ba'i cho ga 'jam dpal ye shes kyis mdzad pa rong zom 'gyur/ de kho na bzhi'i rim pa kaṃ pa las mdzad pa glan 'gyur/ phyag gnyis pa'i bsgrub thabs ma ti shri ba dra dang*/ shākya 'od kyi 'gyur/ phyag gnyis pa badz+ra a la las mdzad pa/ phyag gnyis pa ta ra shris mdzad pa mar do 'gyur/ bsgrub thabs byang chub snying po'i mdzad pa/ dpa' bo gcig pa dril bu pas mdzad pa 'brog mi 'gyur/ dran pa gcig pa ghar bha ris mdzad pa 'brog 'gyur/ maṇ+ḍal dang*/ sbyin sreg gi cho ga mtsho skyes kyi mdzad pa dang*/ sbyin sreg gsang ba'i man ngag rin chen dpal gyis mdzad pa/ rlung dngas snyig gnyis rtse sprad pa'i man ngag sbyin sregs las kyi rim pa rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug dpal gyis mdzad pa/

ro bsreg gi cho ga ye shes snying pos mdzad pa*/ ro sreg gi cho ga nag po pas mdzad pa 'gos 'gyur/ sbyin sreg /rab gnas/ tshogs 'khor rnams nag po pas mdzad pa 'gos 'gyur/ gtor chog mi thub zla bas mdzad pa/ gtor ma'i de nyid bsdus pa da ma kas mdzad pa/ gtor ma'i cho ga a la badz+ras mdzad pa/ khro bo bcu'i rig pa'i cho ga dze ta ris mdzad pa/ gtor ma'i las rim kha che rin chen rdo rjes mdzad pa/ slob ma'i khrus kyi cho ga'i rim pa/ gshin po rjes bzung gi cho ga nag po pas mdzad pa/ bdag med ma'i sgrub thabs kraṣ+ṇi paṇ+ḍi tas mdzad pa/ bdag med ma'i sgrub thabs mi thub zla bas mdzad pa 'brog 'gyur/ bdag med ma'i sgrub thabs nye bar bstan pa dkon mchog 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa/ bdag med ma'i bsgrub thabs gnyis med rdo rjes mdzad pa/ gur gyi sgrub thabs lha'i brtul zhugs kyis mdzad pa/ dpa' mo gcig pa'i sgrub thabs bskyed pa dang rdzogs par ldan pa sgra gcan 'dzin gyis mdzad pa/ rdo rje sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs gur las byung ba grub thob sna tshogs dmar po zhabs kyis ra na mdzad pa/ ku ru ku le'i bsgrub thabs lhan skyes sgegs pas mdzad pa/ ku ru ku le'i man ngag chen po lnga zhi ba 'tshos mdzad pa ste gsum po dwa na shi la'i rang 'gyur/ ku ru ku le'i bsgrub thabs dran pa'i don du bris pa/ rdo rje gur gyi man ngag de kho na nyid bcu pa dri med grags pa mar pa chos blo'i 'gyur/ gdung bsreg pa'i cho ga gur gyi don a sho ka'i man ngag /ro bsreg pa'i cho ga nā ro pas mdzad pa/ mchod rten gyi cho ga nag po pas mdzad pa/ de nyid bcu pa jo bo dang dge blo'i gyur/ bdag med ma'i man ngag stong nyid ting 'dzin rdo rjes mdzad pa/ de kho na nyid bzhi'i man ngag gsang ba'i sgo tai lo pas mdzad pa/ thig le chen po'i rim pa sgegs rdor gyis mdzad pa/ lhan gcig skyes pa'i dga' sbyor shin+ti pas mdzad pa/

bde chen bdud rtsi'i 'od ye shes rin po ches mdzad pa thabs shes gnyis su med pa'i byang sems theg pa'i man ngag las kyi zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ man ngag gi rim pa gsum pa ḍom bhi he ru kas mdzad pa/ rim pa lnga shes rab gsang bas mdzad pa/ lhan cig skyes dga' la yang dag par sbyor ba shan+ti pas mdzad pa/ lhan cig skyes dga'i rnal 'byor dam pa dang*/ lhan cig skyes pa'i 'grel ba snying po gsal ba bram ze tha ga nas mdzad pa/ ye shes 'byung ba'i man ngag ka yas+tha pa gha ya dha ras mdzad pa/ bung ba'i bsgrub thabs rad na tsha has mdzad pa/ rin chen thig pa'i bsgrub thabs dang*/ ye shes mkha' 'gro'i bsgrub thabs gnyis shes rab gsang bas mdzad pa/ yan lag brgyad pa'i rim pa ye shes gsang bas mdzad pa/ rin po che'i char yang shes rab gsang bas mdzad pa/ de kho na nyid bdud rtsi'i man ngag mchog gi dngos grub brnyes pa in+t+ra bu tis mdzad pa/ go byed snying po snang ba mthas rdo rjes mdzad pa/ 'dod pa'i bstan bcos mdor bsdus pa gzugs bzang gis mdzad pa/ gur gyi 'grel pa lha'i rigs kyi blo gros kyis mdzad pa/ gha ya dha ra dang*/ 'gos 'gyur/ ('a)pa'i nang du/ rdo rje gur gyi 'grel pa rgyal po in tra bo dhis mdzad pa/ gur gyi bstod 'grel nag po pas mdzad pa lha ya dang*/ 'brog mi 'gyur/ mkha' 'gro lnga rig bsdus pa'i bsgrub thabs mi thub zla bas mdzad pa/ des mdzad pa'i dkyil chog bzang po yongs bzung*/ badz+ra pa ṇi dang*/ tshul khrims shes rab kyi 'gyur rnams bzhug /saṃ bhu ṭi'i 'grel pa man ngag snye ma mkhas pa 'jigs med 'byung gnas sbas pas mdzad pa/ sangs rgyas grags pa'i gyur/ (ya)pa'i nang du/ sam bhu ṭi'i 'grel pa yang dag pa'i lta ba dran pa'i snang ba'i gzhung in+t+ra bo dhis mdzad pa mkhan po shri badz+ra bo dhi dang*/ gyi jo 'gyur/ kha sbyor 'grel pa dpa' bo rdo rjes mdzad pa rin po che'i phreng ba/ rgyud 'di bde mchog gi bshad rgyud du mi thub zla bas sogs bzhed na'ang*/

'dir sa skya pa'i rgyud gsum gyi rnam gzhag ltar mdzad snang*/ de ltar na thun mong min pa gur dang*/ thun mong ba sam bhu ṭi ste bshad rgyud gnyis so// rgyud phyi ma ni/ phyag rgya chen po thig le las don gsal rmad du byung ba nang dang gsang ba rgya cher bshad pa zab pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa shes rab dpal gyi 'gyur rnams bzhugs/ (ra)pa la/ phyag chen thig le'i dka' 'grel dga' ba'i spyan shes rab gsang bas mdzad pa/ bshad pa'i rgyud ye shes thig le'i dka' 'grel/ a tsar+ya dz+nya na pa ra ya mis mdzad pa/ byang chub 'byung gnas kyi 'gyur/ 'bras bu'i 'gyur ni de kho na nyid kyi sgron ma'i rgyud kyi dka' 'grel ma hā su ka ta badz+ra gyis mdzad pa byang chub 'byung gnas kyi 'gyur/ lhan skyes kyi dkyil 'khor gsum gsal bar byed pa dz+nya na shris mdzad pa zhi ba 'od kyi 'gyur/ dkyil 'khor las rim mtsho skyes kyis mdzad pa 'brog mi 'gyur/ he ru ka 'byung ba nyin mo 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa/ dbang rin chen snang ba shes rab gsang bas mdzad pa/ dbang rin chen phreng ba'i man ngag shes rab dpal gyis mdzad pa/ dbang gi rim pa mdor bsdus shes rab gsang bas mdzad pa/ dbang gi me tog shes rab dpal gyis mdzad pa/ gsang ba'i dbang gi rab byed bi na pas mdzad pa/ dbang rnam par gtan la dbab pa dgra las rnam par rgyal bas mdzad pa/ dga' ba'i me tog in+t+ra bo dhis mdzad pa/ dbang bskur cho ga pradz+nya na shris mdzad pa/ dkyil 'khor gyi de kho na nyid dang*/ gsang dbang gi rab byed bi na pas mdzad pa/ rdzogs rim gyi man ngag dang*/ dbang bskur rab byed dge slong 'od srung gzhon nus mdzad pa/ rang byin brlabs pa dpal ting 'dzin rdo rjes mdzad pa/ rang bzhin dga' ba'i sgron ma'i dka' 'grel rdo rje gsang bas mdzad pa/ rin chen snye ma'i rgya chen 'grel pa shri gup+tas mdzad pa de nyid kyi 'gyur/ de kho na nyid gsal bar byed pa'i sgron ma dpal kum pa la'i yum gyis mdzad pa bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad ḍom bhi he ru kas mdzad pa rnams bzhugs so// gsum pa sangs rgyas thod pa'i skor la/

(la)pa las/ sa ra ha'i chos lnga ni/ dka' 'grel ye shes lnga ldan/ bsgrub thabs rgyas pa lha nyer lnga ma/ gtor chog /dkyil chog /bsgrub thabs bsdus pa ste lnga/ gyi jo 'gyur/ sangs rgyas thod pa'i rgya cher 'grel a bha ka ra gub+tas mdzad pa/ ding ri chos grags kyis bsgyur ba las/ spang blo brtan gyis hor khong bsab pa/ sa ra ha'i gtor chog rnams so// ma ya 'og tu bzhugs so// gnyis pa rtag pa'i rig ni/ gdan bzhi'i rgyud 'grel dran pa'i rgyun bha ba bha tras mdzad pa/ ga ya dha ra dang*/ 'gos 'gyur/ (sha)pa la/ gdan bzhi'i rnam bshad dran pa ye shes grags pas mdzad pa de nyid kyi 'gyur/ gdan bzhi'i bsgrub thabs ar+ya de bas mdzad pa/ ka ma la gup+tas dang*/ lo chen 'gyur/ rnal 'byor nam mkha'i ye shes mkha' 'gro ma'i bsgrub thabs rnam par rgyal ba dpa' bo'i sdes mdzad pa/ ye shes dbang phyug ma'i bsgrub thabs ar+ya de bas mdzad pa/ dkyil mchog snying po mdor bsag ar+ya de bas mdzad pa 'brog mi 'gyur/ rtsa shing gi sbyor ba klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ shing cig gi 'grel pa ar+ya de bas mdzad pa/ mchan khung sbyor ba klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ rdo rje dril thabs kyis mchod pa'i rim pa ar+ya de bas mdzad pa/ de kho na nyid drug rnam par bzhag pa dz+nya na kart-is mdzad pa de nyid gyi 'gyur/ ye shes snang ba'i bsgrub thabs bha bas mdzad pa/ de kho na nyid bzhis dzi ta ris mdzad pa 'gos 'gyur/ yan lag pa'i ye shes snang ba'i sgrub thabs so/ he ru ka'i rigs ma ha ma ya'i skor la/ ma hā ma ya'i rgyud kyi dka' 'grel slob dpon rgyan pas mdzad pa/ a ni la badz+ra dang*/ 'gos 'gyur/ dka' 'grel dpal du dza ya tsan+t+ras mdzad pa bde gshegs grag pa'i gyur/ rgyud kyi 'grel pa yon tan ldan pa shin+ti pas mdzad pa zhi ba bzang po dang*/ 'gos 'gyur/ 'grel pa dran pa nag po dam tshig rdo rjes mdzad pa/ dzi na ra dang*/ 'gos 'gyur/

ku ku ri pas mdzad pa'i dkyil chog karma badz+ra dang// gzhon nu tshul khrims kyi 'gyur/ rgyud kyi rjes su 'brang ba'i bsgrub thabs/ rmongs pa dgrol ba'i rab byed 'gos 'gyur ro// de kho na nyid kyi man ngag blo bzang snying pos mdzad pa dang*/ de'i 'grel pa 'gro bzang gis mdzad pa gnyis/ bsgrub thabs kyi dkyil chog nag pos pas mdzad pa/ dkyil chog rim pa gsal ba nag po pas mdzad pa ste gnyis/ dkyil chog 'dul ba byin gyis mdzad pa/ bstod pa zhal gzigs ma rnams bzhugs so// (sa)pa la/ sgrub thabs ku ku ris mdzad pa/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'i bsgrub thabs/ shin tu spros med kyi man ngag ku ku ris pa mdzad pa/ sgrub thabs shin ti pas mdzad pa dang*/ mkhan po sku med rdo rjes mdzad pa/ dkyil chog sbyin sreg nag po pa dang gcig snang ba bcas pa gcig /de kho na nyid kyi man ngag dang*/ de kho na nyid kyi man ngag su dza la ya shri bha tras mdzad pa/ bsgrub thabs mkha' 'gro ma nyid kyi u rgyan pas gsungs pa/ sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro'i bsgrub thabs nag pos pas mdzad pa/ rdzogs rim gyi man ngag chos zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ byang sems theg pa'i man ngag las kyi zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ phyag rgya gcig pa'i sgrub thabs/ yang sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro'i bsgrub thabs/ chos spyod la 'jug pa'i man ngag rnams nag po pas mdzad pa/ ro sbyong ba'i sgrub thabs dkyil 'khor pa rnams la bstod pa/ dge ba'i chos spyod kyi rim pa/ bdun tshig gis dus su dge rtsa bsgrub pa nag po pas mdzad pa/ gtor chog ku ku ris mdzad pa'o// bzhi pa rdo rje nyi ma'i rig ni/ rdo rje bdud rtsi'i rgyud kyi 'grel pa smri tis mdzad pa de nyid kyi 'gyur/ rdo rje bdud rtsi'i rgya cher 'grel pa bdud rtsi 'dzag pa bha nos mdzad pa/ mkhan po tā ra bā lo dang*/ lo ts+tsha ba ching yon tan 'bar gyi 'gyur rnams so// pad ma'i rig 'jig rten dbang phyug ni pha rgyud kyi pad ma'i rig dang phyogs gcig tu bzhugs so// drug pa rta mchog gi rig ni/

sgrol ma nyi shu rtsa gcig gi sgrub thabs nyi ma sbas pas mdzad pa/ sgrol ma nyer gcig gis las kyi yan lag dang mal gyo 'gyur/ las sbyor srung ba'i 'khor lo dang*/ yang phyag 'tshal nyer gcig gi sgrub thabs shākya shri dang*/ khro lo'i 'gyur/ bstod pa ste de rnams nyi ma sbas pas mdzad pa/ sgrol ma la mar me mdzad/ a k+ṣo bh+ya badz+ra/ ngag dbang grags pa/ mi bskyod rdo rjes/ 'bum phrag gsum pa/ tsan+t+ra go mi rnams kyi bstod pa/ sgrol ma sgom pa'i cho ga mar me mdzad kyis mdzad pa/ me tog phreng 'dzin gyi sgrub thabs ta tha ga ta rak+ṣi tas mdzad pa/ stong nyid bsgom pa/ log lta sun phyung ba/ chom rkun bcing ba/ rig pa bskyed pa/ 'chi ba bslu ba rnams dang*/ phreng 'dzin gyi sgrub thabs bstod pa dang bcas pa zhang lots+tsha'i 'gyur/ seng ldeng nags sgrol gyi sgrub thabs klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ 'jig pa brgyad skyobs mar me mdzad kyis mdzad pa/ sgrol dkar bsgrub thabs thu bos mdzad pa/ 'jig pa brgyad skyobs sgrub thabs tsan+t+ra go mis mdzad pa/ sgrol ma'i bsgrub thabs mar me mdzad kyis mdzad pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ chom rkun bcing ba/ khrus kyi cho ga bha ba bha tras mdzad pa/ maṇ+ḍal gyi cho ga snying rje chen pos mdzad pa/ gso sbyong gi cho ga bha ba bha tras mdzad pa/ tshe 'phel ba'i cho ga tsan+t+ra go mis mdzad pa/ sgrol mas mchog thob bsod snyoms pas mdzad pa/ bstod pa nyer gcig gdon thabs shākya shris mdzad pa/ 'chi kha ma'i nyams len shākya shris mdzad pa/ dkyil 'khor la 'jug pa'i bya ba bha wa bha tras mdzad pa dang*/ des mdzad pa'i dkyil 'khor la 'jug pa mdor bsdus pa/ dbang bskur ba'i cho ga sa pa ra he tas sbyar ba/ rdo rje sgrol ma'i bsgrub thabs shin+ta pas mdzad pa chag 'gyur/ u rgyan rim pa'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje ldan ma mdzad pa/ sgrub thabs shākya shri bha tras mdzad pa/

sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rim pa'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs/ sgrol ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub thabs lhan skyes rol pas mdzad pa/ mngon rtog bsdus pa mar me mdzad kyis mdzad pa/ bstod pa ma ti tsi tras mdzad pa rnams so// de rnams kyi 'ga' zhig bya spyod yin na'ang sgrol ma rnams phyogs mthun du bris pa'o// ral gcig ma'i bsgrub thabs rtag pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa/ gtor chog da na shi las mdzad pa/ blo 'phel rtag pa rdo rjes mdzad pa/ ral gcig ma'i bsgrub thabs mi pham pas bsdus pa/ rol pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa/ kri ra tis mdzad pa/ ral gcig ma dmar mo'i bsgrub thabs dang*/ de'i byin brlabs kyi cho ga nag po pas mdzad pa dang*/ ral gcig ma dkar mo'i sgrub thabs rol pa'i sbas pas mdzad pa/ 'od zer can gyi sgrub thabs mya ngan med pa'i dpal gyis mdzad pa dang*/ kun dga' snying pos mdzad pa gnyis lo chen 'gyur/ rdo rje lu gu rgyud kyi sgrub thabs dze ta ri dgra las rgyal bas mdzad pa/ mar do 'gyur rnams bzhugs/ gsum pa rnal 'byor bla med thabs kyi rgyud la/ mi bskyod pa/ rnam snang*/ rin 'byung*/ 'od dpag med/ don grub/ rdo rje 'chang gi rig dang drug du mdzad pa la/ mi bskyod pa'i rigs la gsang 'dus dang*/ phyag na rdo rje dang*/ gshin rje gshed kyi skor ste gsum mo// dang po la/ (ha)pa la/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i rtsa rgyud kyi 'grel pa klu sgrub kyi mdzad pa mkhan po karma badz+ra dang*/ gzhon nu tshul khrims kyi 'gyur bzhug (a)pa la/ dkyil chog klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ bsgrub thabs mdor byas lo chen 'gyur/ mdo dang bsres pa 'gyur 'dra ba dang*/ rdo rje sems dpa'i sgrub thabs zla grags kyis mdzad pa/ ba ri 'gyur/ rnam bzhag rim pa dang*/ cho ga nyi shu pa gnyis klu byang gis mdzad pa/ nag po pas mdzad pa'i dkyil 'khor cho ga mchod chog gnyis/ klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i rim lnga lo chen 'gyur/

rim lnga bsdus pa gsal ba nā ro pas mdzad pa/ rim lnga'i 'grel pa gnad kyi zla zer a bh+yas mdzad pa/ bhi bu ti'i rang 'gyur/ ar+ya de bas mdzad pa'i spyod bsdus sgron me lo chen 'gyur/ spyod bsdus 'grel pa shākya bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ ro bsreg gi cho ga /mngon par byang chub pa'i rim pa 'bras bu dang bcas pa gnyis lo chen 'gyur/ bdag byin brlab pa dang*/ sems kyi sgrib sbyong ste bzhi po ar+ya de bas mdzad pa/ rim pa khongs su bsdu ba'i man ngag dang*/ byang chub sems 'grel che chung gnyis klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ byang chub sems kyi 'grel bshad smri tis mdzad pa/ lam gyi rim pa sgra dbyangs bcu gcig pas mdzad pa/ rgyan bdun dgrol pa shra dhas mdzad pa gnyis lo chen 'gyur/ rtsa rgyud tshul bzhis bshad pa ar+ya de bas mdzad pa/ mngon rtogs rgyan rtsa 'grel gnyis zla ba grags pas mdzad pa dang*/ des mdzad pa'i sbyor drug 'grel pa/ bsgrub pa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa dz+nya na badz+ras mdzad pa/ rgyud don la 'jug pa bsdus pa shra dhas mdzad pa/ rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgrub thabs kyis bshad pa ta thā ga ta rak+ṣi tas mdzad pa rnams bzhugs/ (ki)pa la/ rtsa rgyud kyi 'grel pa sgron gsal zla ba grags pas mdzad pa 'gos 'gyur la slar yang thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang grags pas 'gos 'gyur gyi rgyud 'grel mang po la gtug nas dag par byas pa dang*/ rgyud phyi ma'i 'grel pa nā ro pas mdzad pa dang*/ sgron gsal gyi 'grel bshad ar+ya de bas mdzad pa dang*/ sgron gsal gyi dka' ba btus pa'i bshad pa legs ldan 'byed kyis mdzad pa dang*/ bshad sbyar ku lan dha ri pas byas pa rnams bzhugs/ (khi)pa la/ sgron gsal gyi 'grel bshad dgongs pa rab gsal la bha bh+ya kit+tis byas pa'i le'u bcu gcig pa yan bzhugs/ (gi)pa la/ de'i smad rdzogs pa ku ma ra nyid kyi 'gyur/ sgron gsal gyi sa gcad snying gi me long lak+ṣi ka ras byas pa/

gzhon nu 'bum dang*/ sha ka blo'i gyur/ rdo rje phreng ba'i 'grel pa a lang ka ka la shas mdzad pa le'u bzhi bcu rtsa bzhi'i phyed bar du rtsom gzhi la bris pa stengs pa lo ts+tsha'i 'gyur rnams bzhugs/ (ngi)pa la/ lha mo bzhis zhus kyi 'grel pa smri tis mdzad pa de nyid kyi 'gyur rgyud de'i 'grel pa ye shes snying pos mdzad pa dran pa ye shes grags pa'i 'gyur/ dbang gi cho ga zung 'jug gsal ba sgra gcan 'dzin dpal bshes gnyain gyis mdzad pa/ shākya shri dang*/ kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur mdor byas kyi 'grel pa rin chen phreng ba shan ti pas mdzad pa karma badz+ra nyid kyi 'gyur/ gtor ma'i cho ga nag po pas mdzad pa/ phyir zlog gi cho ga dang*/ gtor chog gnyis bal po 'ba' ros mdzad pa/ rdo rje grag kyis bsgyur ba/ rab gnas cho ga jo bo rjes mdzad pa/ rim lnga'i 'grel pa nor bu'i phreng ba klu byang gis mdzad pa/ karma badz+ra dang*/ gzhon nu tshul khrims kyi 'gyur rnams bzhugs/ (ci)pa la/ rim lnga'i 'grel pa nag po pas mdzad pa/ nag tsho 'gyur/ rim lnga'i 'grel pa don gsal tshul khrims bzang gis mdzad pa/ bir+ya bha tra dang*/ shes rab brtson 'grus kyi 'gyur/ rim lnga'i dka' 'grel bha bh+ya kirtis byas pa/ rgyal mchog dang*/ shākya brtson 'grus kyi 'gyur/ rdo rje bzlas pa'i bshad pa shra dhas mdzad pa/ lo chen 'gyur rnams dang*/ kun snying gi 'grel chen le'u lnga yan bzhugs/ (chi)pa la/ le'u drug pa nas/ bcu gnyis pa ma rdzogs pa tsam dang*/ (ji)pa la/ de nas bcu bzhi pa ma rdzogs tsam dang*/ (nyi)pa la/ yongs su rdzogs pa paṇ+ḍi ta shra tas kyis bsgyur ba bzhugs/ (ti)pa la/ kun snying gis mdzad pa'i 'grel chung lo chen 'gyur/ rgyud phyi ma'i 'grel pa bi shwa mi tras mdzad pa dang*/ dka' 'grel rgyal bas byin gyis mdzad pa'i le'u bcu bzhi yan bzhugs/ (thi)pa la/ de'i smad yongs su rdzogs pa zhi ba bzang po dang*/

dar ma grags la sogs pa'i 'gyur dang*/ bshad sbyar snyim pa'i me tog shan+ti pas mdzad pa/ zhal lung 'grel pa/ bo dhi pas mdzad pa/ rtsa rgyud kyi 'grel pa rin chen ljon shing tse lu pas mdzad pa/ mnga' bdag ye shes rgyal mtshan shan ta bha tra dang*/ 'gos 'gyur rnams bzhugs/ (di)pa la/ 'jam dpal zhal lung sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ ka ma la ghu h+ya dang*/ mnga' bdag ye shes rgyan mtshan gyis 'gyur/ rtsa rgyud 'grel pa tha ga nas mdzad pa smri ti'i gyur/ dri med sbas pas mdzad pa'i 'grel pa 'dus pa'i rgyan gyi le'u dgu pa yan bzhugs/ (ni)pa las/ de'i smad rdzogs pa dang*/ rgyud phyi'i 'grel pa zla ba'i 'od kyis mdzad pa/ dar ma grags kyi 'gyur/ rgyud phyi'i 'grel pa bir+ya pas mdzad pa/ man ngag gi 'gyur/ rgyud kyi 'grel pa smri tis mdzad pa de nyid kyi rang 'gyur/ mi bskyod pa lha bcu dgu'i sgrub thabs rin chen rdo rjes mdzad pa smri ti dang*/ ye shes rin po che'i 'gyur rnams bzhugs/ (pi)pa la/ 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor cho ga phyed bcas bzhi brgya pa mar me mdzad bzang pos mdzad pa/ lo chen 'gyur/ de'i 'grel pa shin+ta pas mdzad pa/ bid h+ya bha tra dang*/ lo chen 'gyur/ sbyor ba bdun pa bhi dhi pas mdzad pa lha 'gyur/ dkyil chog bsod snyoms pas mdzad pa lo chen 'gyur/ dbang rab byed dga' ba'i rdo rjes mdzad pa dharma kirti'i 'gyur/ dbang bskur cho ga ngag dbang grags pas mdzad pa/ mar pa chos dbang 'gyur de kho na nyid bcu pa dar ma grags kyi 'gyur/ bstod pa mi gnas rdo rjes mdzad pa/ mar me mdzad ye shes kyis mdzad pa gnyis lo chen 'gyur/ zhal lung gi man ngag gi sgrub thabs dang*/ sgrub thabs kun bzang sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ de'i 'grel pa tha ga nas mdzad pa dang*/ shri pha las mdzad pa rnams lo chen 'gyur/ bsgrub thabs kun tu bzang po sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyis mdzad pa blo ldan shes rab kyi 'gyur rnams bzhugs/

(phi)pa la/ kun tu bzang mo'i 'grel pa smri ti'i 'gyur/ sgrub thabs dngos grub 'byung ba'i gter bi ta pa dhas mdzad pa lha ye'i 'gyur/ sgrub thabs rtog sla su na shri mi tras mdzad pa/ mngon par rtogs pa zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs smri ti dang*/ ye shes rin po che'i 'gyur/ bstan pa'i nor thams cad pa ces bya ba'i sgrub thabs rad na kir+t+t-is mdzad pa/ pad ma 'byung gnas dang*/ gnyen dar ma grags kyi 'gyur/ (bi)pa la/ sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i dka' 'grel rab zhi bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa lo chen 'gyur/ las mtha' rnam 'byed klu byang gis mdzad pa chag 'gyur ro// gnyis pa phyag rdor gyi skor la/ dza wa ris mdzad pa'i gzhung phran rnams ni phyag na rdo rje 'khor lo chen po'i bsgrub thabs/ dkyil chog /bstod pa/ rgyud drag po gsum 'dul gyi 'grel pa/ gtor chog /mdze nad kyi mtshan nyid/ rim pa drug pa/ klu rig bzhi'i bsgrub pa/ gnod sbyin gyi sde rnam par sbyang ba'i sgrub thabs/ yi dwags dang*/ sha za dang grul bum/ rjed byed rnam par sbyong zhing sgrub thabs/ thabs sgud pa/ sbyin sreg gi cho ga /klu khro bo gsad pa/ klu rig bzhi gnan pa/ klu gsad pa/ gsol ba/ las thams cad pa'i sbyin sreg rnams 'gar chos bzang gi 'gyur/ srung ba'i 'khor lo/ rten 'brel gyi srung ba gnyis she'u lots+tsha'i 'gyur rnams so// phyag na rdo rje'i sgrub thabs dang*/ drag po phur bu'i man ngag dang*/ rdo rje gtum po phur gcig ma'i phyi sgrub dang*/ gtum po'i nang bsgrub rnams las kyi rdo rjes mdzad pa glan 'gyur/ des mdzad pa'i khyung sham can gyi sgrub thabs/ drag po'i khor lo tsan+t+ra go mis mdzad pa/ u tsa ma'i sgrub thabs dang*/ gzungs kyi 'grel pa gsal sgron klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ brtson seng gi 'gyur/ gzungs kyi sgrub thabs/ gzungs kyi 'grel pa/ bum pa'i sgrub thabs/ bum pa'i sgrub thabs gsal byed kyi man ngag

/de kho na nyid sgron ma/ spur gsad las tshogs bsdus pa rnams slon dpon su bi ki shwa ra kirtis mdzad pa/ mchod rten gyis man ngag te lo pas mdzad pa/ mdo lugs kyi man ngag gi sgrub thabs bhir+ya tsan+t+ra pa mdzad pa/ sgrub thabs shra dhas mdzad pa// rnam thos kyi gsang ba'i sgrub thabs dga' rab rdo rjes mdzad pa/ sgrub thabs gtor ma'i man ngag dang*/ gzungs kyi gtor chog /sgrub pa'i go rim/ sgrub thabs/ gnod sbyin sde dpon bzhi'i bsgrub thabs 'khor lo'i man ngag rnams su bā ki shwa ras mdzad pa dang*/ spur gsad kyi las sbyor/ sngags bzlas thabs/ sgrub thabs rnams bhir+ya tsan+t+ra mdzad pa dang*/ sgrub thabs yid bzhin nor bu bram ze nyin byed rdo rjes mdzad pa/ sgrub thabs stong nyid ting 'dzin zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ dkyil 'khor cho ga stong nyid snying rjes mdzad pa gnyis ba ri 'gyur/ rdo rje snying po'i man ngag sgrub thabs dz+nya na shris mdzad pa/ rigs sngags gtad pa'i cho ga /sgrub thabs de kho na nyid sgron me dang*/ de'i 'grel pa dpa' bos mdzad pa/ phyag rdor gyi skur sprul nus pa mtshan lag na rdo rjer grags pas mdzad pa'i rdo rje me lce'i rgyud kyi 'grel pa de nyid snang ba/ mañju shri dang*/ gzhon nu tshul khrims kyi 'gyur/ phyag na rdo rje me lce dbab pa'i 'grel pa mu tig phreng ba dang*/ lce dbab pa'i bya rten 'brel gyis srung ba dang bcas pa dang*/ lce dbab pa'i sgrub thabs gsang ba yang bkol dang*/ rnal 'byor gyi spyod lam brgyad pa rnams rgyal bu sprin gyi shug can gyis mdzad pa mar 'gyur/ phyag na rdo rje'i dkyil chog /tshogs 'khor cho ga /tshogs 'khor gyi sbyor ba/ gtor chog /zhi ba dang*/ drag po'i sbyin sreg gnyis/ rgyas pa dang*/ dbang gi dang*/ gsang ba'i dang*/ sbyin sreg las kyi cho ga dang*/ las kyi rim pa mu tig phreng ba dang*/ las kyi tshogs rim par phye ba'i cho ga dang*/

sbyor kha chen po'i man ngag dang*/ sgrub thabs gsum rnams slob dpon bha bas mdzad pa/ tshul khrims gzhon nu'i 'gyur/ gos sngon can gyi sgrub thabs su na tras mdzad pa dang*/ chen po zhabs kyis mdzad pa rnams bzhugs so// (mi)pa la/ rdo rje gtum mo po lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dang*/ lam yan lag brgyad pa gnyis klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ gos sngon can gyi sgrub thabs su tsa na pra tis mdzad pa/ sgrub thabs/ gtor chog las thams cad pa'i srung ba gsum slob dpon ba su dha badz+ra mdzad pa/ srung ba'i thabs rigs sngags gcod pa dang gnon pa'i cho ga dang*/ sbyin sreg gi cho ga las kyi rdo rjes mdzad pa/ klu gtor rgyas pa dang*/ rdo rje khyung gi sgrub pa'i man ngag slob dpon rdo rje pad mas mdzad/ gnam lcag 'bar ba'i sgrub thabs dang*/ dkyil chog gnyis mā+ai tri pas mdzad pa gnyis 'gar chos bzang gi 'gyur/ gos sngon can gyi sgrub thabs ma tshang ba cig /dkyil chog rin chen phreng ba dang*/ rnam sras sgrub thabs shu ram gas mdzad pa/ rnam thos sras kyi sgrub thabs/ pra dbab phyir zlog gi sbyin sreg /dreg byed kyi cho ga las brtag pa'i sgrub thabs dang*/ sgrub thabs ste drug po 'gro bzang snying pos mdzad pa/ zangs dkar 'gyur/ gzungs kyi 'brel pa dang*/ dkyil chog gnyis karma ma badz+ras mdzad pa glan 'gyur rnams so// de rnams phyag rdor gyi skor ro// gsum pa gshin rje gshed skor la/ dgra nag gi 'grel pa lhan cig skyes pa'i snang ba bram ze dpal 'dzin gyi mdzad pa/ paṇ+ḍi ti bar gnyis dang*/ tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ slob dpon des mdzad pa'i dkyil mchog a tu sa dang*/ rwa lo ts+tsha la sogs pa'i 'gyur rgyud kyi 'grel pa mngon par mtho ba lam gyi sgron ma kriṣ+ṇa pa chen pos mdzad pa pradz+nya dz+nya na kir+t+ti'i rang 'gyur/ dka' 'grel nag po zhabs kyis mdzad pa a tsar+ya'i na ya tsan+t+ra dang*/

chos shes kyis 'gyur/ dka' 'grel rin chen sgron ma shin+t+ra pas mdzad pa chos shes 'gyur/ dka' 'grel rin chen phreng ba gzhon nu zla bas mdzad pa/ mngon rtogs dkrugs pa 'brel pa dang*/ rdzogs rim gyi man ngag nag po pas mdzad pa/ dkyil 'khor gyi mngon rtogs nag po pas mdzad pa/ man ngag gi 'khor lo nag po snying 'byin nag po pas mdzad pa dang*/ rdo rje rnon po zhes bya ba'i 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs shri dha ras mdzad pa dang*/ bsam gtan brtag pa/ ngag bcing ba'i 'khor lo/ las kyi 'khor lo rnams shri dha ras mdzad pa/ pradz+nya shri'i rang 'gyur/ sbyin sreg cho ga nag po pas mdzad pa dang*/ gtor chog pradz+nya shri dz+nya na kirtis rang 'gyur du mdzad pa dang*/ las thams cad grub par byed pa'i sgrub thabs dang*/ spyod pa'i dam tshig sgrub thabs dang*/ 'khor lo'i cho ga dang*/ rab gnas cho ga rnams nag po pas mdzad pa dang*/ rmongs pa dgrol ba'i brtag pa dang*/ tshad ma mngon par rtogs pa'i snying po gnyis ka ro pas mdzad pa dang*/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa sbyor ba gcig pa'i man ngag ni la badz+ra gyis mdzad pa rnams pradz+nya shri dz+nya na kirti'i rang 'gyur/ he ru ka'i mngon rtogs zhes bya ba rnams bzhugs/ (tsi)pa'i nang du/ dkyil chog gshin rje gshed 'byung ba la li tas mdzad pa cog gru shes rab bla ma'i 'gyur/ maṇ+ḍal cho ga dang*/ sbyin sreg gnyis bsod snyoms pa de nyid kyi 'gyur/ mchod rten cho ga ka la ma has mdzad pa 'gyur gong dang 'dra/ bsgrub thabs dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa dang*/ don yod rdo rjes mdzad pa gnyis ka nyos 'gyur/ bsgrub thabs bsod snyoms pa ka ma la rak+ṣi tas mdzad pa nag tsho 'gyur/ des mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs pradz+nya shri dz+nya na kirti'i rang 'gyur/ sgrub thabs ku mu ta kha phye ba shin+ta pas mdzad pa/ chos shes 'gyur/ gshin rje gshed dus mthar 'byin pa kriṣ+ṇa paṇ+ḍi tas mdzad pa/ sgrub thabs mar me mdzad kyis mdzad pa/

nyi ma bye bar grags pas mdzad pa/ nyi ma byed pas mdzad pa 'gro bzang snying pos mdzad pa/ zhal gsum phyag drug pa'i sgrub thabs la li tas mdzad pa/ 'o ma bsgrub pa'i man ngag a tsar+ya dzi mu tre pa ta las mdzad pa/ 'khor lo'i man ngag nag po de has mdzad pa/ sbyin sreg gi cho ga la li tas mdzad pa/ mchod pa'i cho ga kaṣ+ṇi paṇ+ḍi tas mdzad pa/ gshin rje gshed khro bo chen po'i sgrub thabs slob dpon rdo rje'i blos mdzad pa/ khro bo rnam par rgyal ba'i sbyin sreg gi rim pa don yod zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ tshogs 'khor cho ga ka ma la ma has mdzad pa/ ma smos pa rnams dgra nag go /gdong drug gi sgrub thabs a ka ra tsan+t+ras mdzad pa cog gru 'gyur/ 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs klu dbyang gis mdzad pa/ gshin rje gshed rnam snang dang// rin 'byung*/ mi bskyod pa'i snying po 'dod chags gshin rje ga shed/ gshin rje gshed rnon po/ tho ba gshin rje gshed/ dbyug pa gshin rje gshed/ pad ma gshin rje gshed/ ral gri gshin rje gshed/ bde spyod ma'i sgrub thabs/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'i rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub thabs/ rdo rje bde rgyas dbyangs chen ma'i sgrub thabs/ rdo rje sems ma go ri ma'i sgrub thabs rnams mar me mdzad kyis mdzad cing*/ pradz+nya dz+nya na kirti'i rang 'gyur/ de rnams phal cher dgra nag gi skabs so// gshin rje gshed dmar po lha lnga'i sgrub thabs dang dpa' bo gcig gnyis dpa' bo'i rgyal pos mdzad pa/ dpa' bo gcig pa dang*/ lhan skyes bi rus pas mdzad pa rnams chag 'gyur/ lhan skyes bir ba pas mdzad pa/ rang byin gyis brlab pa'i man ngag re wan+t+ras mdzad pa/ sgrub thabs rnam par snang mdzad srung bas mdzad pa/ blo gros bzang pos mdzad pa/ rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor 'jig med 'byung gnas sbas pas mdzad pa/ ting nge 'dzin gyi cho ga dang*/ dmar nag gnyis kyi mchod chog dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa ste de rnams chags 'gyur/

lag pa mchod pa'i cho ga da na shi las mdzad pa/ 'khrul 'khor phreng ba bir ba pas mdzad pa da na shi la'i rang 'gyur/ 'khrul 'khor gyi las mngon spyod kyi dus nges par bstan pa/ gtor ma'i cho ga bi ru pas mdzad pa chag 'gyur/ mchod chog dpyal 'gyur/ gtor ma'i cho ga dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa/ gtor chog bir ba pas mdzad pa/ dmar nag gnyis kyi mchod chog dpal 'dzin mdzad pa/ dkyil chog dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa rnams chag 'gyur/ rdzogs rims rnal 'byor bzhi'i de kho na nyid dpal 'dzin mdzad pa dang*/ 'tsho ba'i de kho na nyid gnyis glo bo 'gyur/ 'od 'dzin ma'i sgrub thabs dang*/ byin brlabs/ srung 'khor byin rlabs/ rang gi sems gong du 'pho ba'i man ngag byin brlabs dang bcas pa rnams dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa/ 'khrul 'khor cho ga re wan+t+ras mdzad pa chags 'gyur/ 'khor lo'i gsal byed ni ska a lam ka dang dpyal 'gyur/ 'khor lo'i de nyid gsal byed byang chub bzang pos mdzad pa 'gyur gong ltar/ rdo rje dbyangs chen ma'i sgrub thabs dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta chen po'i bhu ti tsaṇ+ḍa'i rang 'gyur ste/ gshin rje gshed dmar gyis skabs so// rdo rje 'jig byed kyi rgyud kyi mdo mdor bshad pa rdo rje grub pas mdzad pa/ dka' 'grel so na shris mdzad pa/ dka' 'grel gzhon nu zla bas byas pa dar ma grags kyi 'gyur/ dka' 'grel slob dpon mi spyod pas mdzad pa/ mkhan po bi na ya tsan+t+ra dang*/ dge bsnyen chos kyi bzang po dang*/ chos kyi shes rab dang*/ slad nas kha che a ka ra dang*/ 'o ru lo ts+tsha bas bcos pa dang*/ dka' 'grel man ngag rgyan ces bya ba la li tas mdzad las kyi rdo rje dang*/ ku ma ra shi la'i gyur/ rdo rje 'jig byed la de nyid lnga'i bstod pa dang*/ yang sho lo ka gsum pa gcig dang*/ bstod pa don yod rdo rjes mdzad pa dang*/ mtshan gyis bstod pa las kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa/ zhe dgu ma'i sgrub thabs la li tas mdzad pa dang*/

la li tas mdzad pa'i ro langs brgyad skor dang*/ sgrub thabs dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa dang*/ las bya ba'i cho ga sems dpa' bsdus pa don yod rdo rjes mdzad pa dang*/ des mdzad pa'i dkyil chog dang// sgrub thabs mdor bsdus pa shri bha tras mdzad pa dang*/ sbyin sreg gi cho ga dang*/ shan+ti pas mdzad pa'i tshogs 'khor dang bzhi po rwa lo tsa'i 'gyur/ tsu tsun+dha ra'i cho ga dang*/ rtog gsum don 'grel drag po'i las bdun dang*/ zhi ba'i las bdun snyen pa'i cho ga dang*/ drag po'i phyog gcig pa gnyis zhi ba ye shes kyis mdzad pa dang*/ sgrub thabs mdor bsdus shri bha tras mdzad pa/ mna' rgyud kyi cho ga /'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis mdzad pa'i phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs dang*/ 'di'i zhar la phyag bzhi drug kyang ston/ yang bstod pa gcig rgyun bshags dang sgrub thabs gnyis a mo gha badz+ras mdzad pa/ sgrub thabs sgegs pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa de dang*/ de rnams 'jig byed kyi skor ro// rnam snang gi rig ni sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i skor rnams yin cing*/ rin po che'i rig bcas dgos so// bzhi pa 'od dpag med kyi rigs kyi skor la/ bcom ldan 'das ral gcig ma'i sgrub thabs paṇ+ḍi ta adzi ta mi tra gup+tas mdzad pa dang*/ ral gcig lha bcu bdun gyis sgrub thabs mi pham bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa gnyis/ mi tra dang*/ khro phu lots+tsha'i 'gyur/ ral gcig ma dmar mo'i sgrub thabs gnyis med rdo rjes mdzad pa dang*/ byin rlabs kyi cho ga nag po pas mdzad pa gnyis/ gzhon nu shes rab pa'i 'gyur/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma grub pa'i rgyal mos mdzad pa'i tshe dpag med kyi sgrub thabs dang*/ dkyil chog bzang po yongs bzung*/ tshe bsgrub cho ga /rta mgrin gyi sgrub thabs byin rlabs dang bcas pa/ de rnams paṇ+ḍi ta zla ba bzang po/ glan dar ma tshul khrims 'gyur/ thugs rje chen po pad ma dra ba'i sgrub thabs dang*/ dkyil 'khor cho ga gsum rgyal ba dpal ye shes kyis mdzad pa gnyis kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta su ma shri bha tra dang*/

bu ston rin chen grub kyi 'gyur ro/ rigs kyi 'jig rten mgon po lnga bcu pa'i rgyud kyi 'grel pa kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta dri med dpal bzang pos mdzad pa/ yar lung ba shud ke grags pa rgyal mtshan 'gyur/ slob dpon des mdzad pa'i byin brlabs kyi cho ga dang*/ sgrub thabs ma hi las mdzad pa gnyis 'gyur gong dang 'dra ba rnams bzhugs/ rigs kyi 'jig rten mgon po 'di'i ma rgyud kyi pad ma'i rigs su bla ma rnams gsungs so/ bla med gsar 'gyur gyi skor rnams rdzogs so/ gnyis pa snga 'gyur gyi skor la/ (tshi)pa'i nang du/ rgyud thams cad kyi ching dang*/ man ngag thams cad 'jig rten kyi don bsdeb pa nyams len thams cad kyi gzer bstan pa snying gi mun sel zhes bya ba mkhas pa bi ma la mi tras mdzad pa/ sgra thal 'gyur rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi 'grel pa rin po che snang byed kyi sgron ma'i le'u dang po cung ma rdzogs pa rnams bzhugs/ (dzi)pa la/ de'i mjug yongs su rdzogs pa dang*/ thal 'gyur chos rnams kun gyi rgyab brten ye shes dam pa bzhugs/ (wi)pa la rgyud nyi zla kha sbyor gyi 'grel pa bar do gtan la 'bebs pa'i 'grel pa rin chen gser phreng dang*/ sku gdung 'bar ba'i 'grel pa sgron ma phreng bkod dang*/ mu tig phreng ba'i 'grel pa mu tig rin chen gsal bar byed pa zhes bya ba ste de bzhi bi ma las mdzad pa rnams bzhugs/ rdzogs chen man ngag gi sde'i skabs so/ (zhi)pa la/ sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam par sbyor ba mkha' 'gro ma sgyu ma bde mchog gi rgyud kyi don rnam par bshad pa slob dpon rgyal po brgya byin sdong pos mdzad pa/ mkhan po bi da ka ra sing ha dang*/ lha rin po che'i 'gyur/ dka' 'grel in+t+ra bo dhis mdzad pa/ lo chen 'gyur/ rgyud kyi rnam bshad snang bar byed pa kun dga' snying pos mdzad pa smri ti'i 'gyur/ dka' 'grel rab zhi bshes gnyen gyis bshad pa lo chen 'gyur/

'grel pa mnyam sbyor gyis rgyan rab dga' rdo rjes mdzad pa ste rgyud kyi 'grel pa'o// dkyil chog rin chen rdo rjes mdzad pa/ ye shes rdo rje dang gnyan bsod de'i 'gyur/ dkyil 'khor sgrub pa dang dbang bskur ba'i cho ga hūṃ ka ras mdzad pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor cho ga ku ku ras mdzad pa dang gnyis/ lha rin po che'i 'gyur rnams bzhugs so// mnyam sbyor gyi skabs te gur la ma rgyud kun gyi thog mar gsungs so/ (zi)pa la/ dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi rjes su bstan pa la 'jug pa'i cho ga lnga pa slob dpon ku ku ras mdzad pa/ rma rin chen mchog gi 'gyur/ bcom ldan 'das la bstod pa rdo rje 'dzin gyis dbyangs dang*/ bstod pa rdo rje 'dzin gyi dbyangs kyi 'grel pa gnyis dpal brtseg 'gyur/ he ru ka'i sgrub thabs thu bo ha stis mdzad pa/ he ru ka'i sgrub thabs hūṃ mdzad rdo rjes mdzad pa/ yan lag bzhi'i don snang bar byed pa hūṃ mdzad grags pas mdzad pa/ rdo rje sems dpa'i don rnam par bkod pa ku ku ras mdzad pa/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi don rnam par bkod pa dang*/ he ru ka'i gsang don rnam par bkod pa dang*/ pad ma gar dbang gi gsang don rnam par bkod pa dang*/ rdo rje rin chen nyi ma'i gsang don rnam par bkod pa dang*/ rta mchog rol pa'i gsang don rnam par bkod pa rnams ku ku ras mdzad pa lha rin po ches bsgyur ba/ rdo rje sems dpa' dang*/ he ru ka rjes su dran pa'i cho ga gnyis thu bo ra tsa ha stis mdzad pa/ rdo rje sems dpa' dang he ru ka'i sgrub thabs thu bo ra tsa ha stis mdzad pa/ sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor gyi tshogs 'khor cho ga in+t+ra bo dhis mdzad pa/ yang dag gi rtsa ba'i gzhung hūṃ ka ras mdzad pa rnams so// yang dag gi skor ro// rgyud kyi rgyal po gsang ba'i snying po spar khab sgeg rdor gyis byas pa/ sgyu 'phrul lam rim sangs rgyas gsang bas mdzad pa snyag dz+nya na ku ma ras bsgyur/

sgyu 'phrul man ngag rnam par bkod pa sangs rgyas gsang bas mdzad pa/ sgyu 'phrul gyi thigs pa dang*/ sgyu 'phrul gsal ba'i sgron me/ sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i lam bshad pa rnams bi ma la mi tras mdzad pa/ rim pa drug pa sgeg rdor gyis mdzad pa/ sgyu 'phrul gyi man ngag rim pa gsum pa bi ma la mi tras mdzad pa/ dam tshig pa'i cho ga mdor bshad pa byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa bde ba chen po'i man ngag jo bo dang*/ pho brang zhi ba 'od kyi 'gyur/ sgyu 'phrul gyi man ngag rim pa gsum pa bi ma la mi tras mdzad pa/ rdo rje dam tshig rdo rje gsal bkra spyi'i dam tshig mdor bsdus sgeg rdor mdzad pa/ tog tse pa'i bsam mi khyab rnams bzhugs so// ('i)pa la/ gsang snying gi 'grel pa nyi ma seng ge 'od kyis mdzad pa mkhan po pra swa ta dang*/ pad ma tsa ru rtsa'i 'gyur/ sgyu 'phrul dra ba rdo rje las kyi rim pa dbang gi don rab tu 'byed pa/ sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i dbang gi gal po/ dbang gi don nges par 'byed pa rnams sangs rgyas gsang bas mdzad pa/ sgyu 'phrul thugs kyi thigs pa/ gsang ba'i thigs pa'i man ngag bi ma la mi tras mdzad pa/ rdo rje sems dpa' sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i shes pa'i mtshan nyid bshad pa shes rab spyan 'byed zhes bya ba mi ma la mi tra mdzad pa/ man ngag gi rgyal po lta ba'i phreng ba/ las shan lta ba'i sgron ma zhes bya ba snang ba bcu bdun pa bzhad pa rdo rjes mdzad pa/ lta ba'i rim pa'i man ngag ka ba dpal brtsegs kyi mdzad/ g.yu'i thang ma kras dgu bi ma las 'phan yul du mdzad pa/ sgyu 'phrul dra ba me long lta bu'i sgrub thabs dz+nya na dza yas mdzad pa/ sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i sems bskyed pa'i ting nge 'dzin dkyil 'khor lnga'i dbang du sbyar ba 'od kyi rim pa'i man ngag sangs rgyas gsang bas mdzad pa/ sgyu 'phrul phyag rgya bi ma las mdzad pa/ sgyu 'phrul zhi ba dra chen/ zhi ba dra chung*/ de kho na nyid snang ba dam pa'i rgyan/

byang chub sems kyi ljon shing s+thi ra ma tis mdzad pa/ dam tshig phra rgyas bstan pa/ sgyu 'phrul sbyin sreg gi rim pa mdor bsdus bi ma las mdzad pa/ sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i sreg las 'phreng ba bi ma las mdzad pa/ sgyu 'phrul se'u chung rang gnas kyi rim pa sgeg rdor gyis mdzad pa/ sku gdung las kyi rim pa/ za tshogs gtor ma'i lung*/ gsang ba mdo don bsdus pa dharma bo dhes mdzad pa/ skabs 'grel bye brag rnam par bshad pa dang*/ yo ga'i phyi nang gzhung rgyud las nges don mdor bsdus pa rgyan dam pa'i le'u bam po gcig tu byas pa gnyis s+thi ra ma tis mdzad/ cog ro klu'i rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur ro// de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs gsang ba dur khrod khu byug rol pa'i rgya cher bshad pa bdud rtsi thig pa mtsho skyes rdo rjes mdzad pa/ pad ma'i thod phreng can dang*/ dz+nya na ku ma ra'i 'gyur/ 'phags pa thabs kyi zhags pa pad phreng gi 'grel pa gshin rje gshed kha thun gyi phran tsheg drug gi sgrom 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ kha thun nag po rgyas par 'byed pa'i rtsa ba 'khor lo 'dus pa 'jam dpal bshes gnyen mdzad pa/ khu long yon tan rgya mtsho'i 'gyur/ de nyid gsum pa zhes bya ba/ gshin rje gshed kha thun gyi sgrub thabs 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ gnub sangs rgyas ye shes kyi 'gyur/ gshin rje gshed nag po las kyi 'khor lo 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ rdo rje bkod pa'i rgyud bstan pa srung ba rnal 'byor yongs kyi mgon po legs ldan nag po'i bsgrub thabs dkyil 'khor bdun gyi rim pa rnam par phye ba rnam snang myu gus mdzad pa rnams bzhugs// sgyu 'phrul dang 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed kyi skor rnams so// gnyis pa rnal 'byor rgyud kyi skor la/ rtsa rgyud kyi skor ni/ (yi)pa'i nang du/ rtsa ba'i rgyud de nyid snang ba'i 'grel pa slob dpon kun dga' snying pos mdzad pa'i dum bu gnyis pa gzungs dkyil yan bzhugs/

(ri)pa la/ phyi ma'i yang phyi ma'i bshad pa rdzogs pa dang*/ (li)pa la/ 'jug yongs su rdzogs pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta thugs rje chen po dang*/ zangs dkar lots+tshas bsgyur ba dang*/ slob dpon des mdzad pa'i rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil chog rdo rje 'byung ba dang*/ de'i bsdus pa'i don a tsar+ya mu nan tra bha tras mdzad pa de nyid dang*/ chos shes kyi 'gyur/ dkyil 'khor gyi rnam par bzhag pa mu tig ta ko shas mdzad pa lo chen 'gyur/ yum mchog spros pa med pa'i sgrub thabs dang*/ khams gsum rnam rgyal kyi dkyil chog dang gnyis po kun snying gis mdzad pa/ rdo rje sems dpa'i sgrub thabs dang*/ sems dpa' 'byung ba gnyis dge blo'i 'gyur/ rdo rje sems dpa'i sgrub thabs in+t+ra bo dhes mdzad pa/ dpal ldan rgya che ba zhes bya ba'i cho ga dang*/ de nyid bsdus pa'i 'grel pa ko sa la'i rgyan shākya bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa'i dum bu dang po yan bzhugs/ (shi)pa la/ de'i 'jug yongs su rdzogs pa bzhugs so// (si)pa la/ sangs rgyas gsang bas mdzad pa'i 'grel pa a wa ta 'jam dpal go cha'i 'gyur/ 'jig rten gsum rgyal gyi 'grel pa mu tig gcig ko shas mdzad pa rgyud don la 'jug pa ces bya ba'i 'jug cung ma tshang ba dang*/ kun dga' snying pos mdzad pa'i dpal mchog 'grel chen gyi dum bu dang po yan/ lo chen 'gyur bzhugs/ (hi)pa la/ gsang ba ras ris kyi skabs kyi lo chen gyi 'gyur 'tshams yan bzhugs/ (i)pa la/ 'jug yongs su rdzogs pa dang*/ thams cad gsang ba'i bshad sbyar gsang ba'i sgron ma shan+ti pas mdzad pa lo chen 'gyur/ sbyongs rgyud kyi brtag pa dang po dang phyi ma'i dang phyi ma yang bshad pa/ gsal ba'i sgron ma kun snying gis mdzad pa/ ku ma ra ka la sha dang*/ khyung po chos brtson gyis bsgyur ba rnams bzhugs/ (ku)pa la/ sbyongs rgyud 'grel pa snang ba'i rgyan mkhan po bid dha ka ra warma dang*/ dge slong dbang phyug rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/
