sbyong rgyud kyi 'grel pa mdzes rgyan kun dga' snying pos mdzad pa dang*/ 'bru 'grel sangs rgyas gsang bas mdzad pa rnams bzhugs/ (khu)pa la/ sbyongs rgyud kyi 'grel pa ka ma dhe nus mdzad pa la tsar+ya pa ṇi ya tsan+t+ra dang*/ dge slong chos shes kyi 'gyur/ ngan song sbyong ba'i cho ga a nan ta pa ra hi pas mdzad pa/ tshig tha ma'i cho ga'i rnam grangs dpal ldan ting 'dzin rdo rjes mdzad pa/ pradz+nya kit+ti'i 'gyur/ rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor gyi don bsgom pa'i don bsdus pa ku ma ra kla shus bsgyur ba/ ro bsreg gi cho ga dharma kirtis mdzad pa dge blo'i 'gyur/ ro bsreg gi cho ga mdo dang bsres pa kun snying gis mdzad pa/ lo chen 'gyur/ sbyin sreg gi cho ga skal bzang dga' bas mdzad pa g.yung drung 'od kyi 'gyur/ dkyil chog gi rim pa sangs rgyas gsang bas mdzad pa/ rdo rje chos kyi rnal 'byor gcig pa sgom pa'i sgrub thabs/ spyan dbye yi cho ga kun snying gis mdzad pa/ sbyin sreg gi cho ga rab 'byor skyong gis mdzad pa/ sbyin sreg gi cho ga kun bzang*/ ngan song sbyong ba'i dkyil chog kun snying gis mdzad pa smri ti'i 'gyur rnams so// cha mthun dang*/ 'phros pa'i rgyud kyi skabs so// mtshan brjod rnal 'byor rgyud du bkral ba'i skor la/ mtshan brjod kyi 'grel pa slob dpon chen po 'jam dpal grags pas mdzad pa lo chen 'gyur rnams bzhugs/ (gu)pa la/ nam mkha' dri ma med pa 'jam dpal grags pas mdzad pa/ mtshan brjod 'grel pa sngags don rnams gzigs sgegs pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa/ smri ti'i 'gyur/ dkyil 'khor cho ga byang chub mchog gi mdzad pa'i yon tan 'byung gnas smri ti'i 'gyur/ gsang ldan gyi thig le cho ga smri tis mdzad pa/ sgrub thabs byang chub mchog gis mdzad pa/ de'i 'grel pa smri tis mdzad pa/ gsang ldan gyi tho yig smri tis mdzad pa/ de rnams smri ti'i 'gyur/

gsang ba'i dka' 'grel bshad pa don bsdus sgron me/ de ba a ka ra tsan+t+ra dang*/ glog skya'i 'gyur rnams bzhugs/ (ngu)pa la/ mtshan brjod klag pa'i sgom khog byang chub mchog gis mdzad pa/ mtshan brjod klag pa'i man ngag shākya shri bha tras mdzad pa/ 'jam dpal gyi sgrub thabs dge bsnyen snyan grags dge bas mdzad pa/ sbyin sreg gi cho ga rgyas pa byang chub mchog gis mdzad pa// rin po che'i sgrub thabs dge bsnyen ma grags sbyin mas mdzad pa gnyis smri ti'i 'gyur/ ye shes sems dpa'i sgrub thabs a wa dhu tis mdzad pa dang*/ de kho na nyid kyi sgrub thabs/ dharma shri mi tra'i 'gyur/ 'jam dpal dang po'i sangs rgyas kyi sgrub thabs dang*/ mtshan brjod kyi bsgrub thabs gnyis a wa dhu tis mdzad pa/ dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga ye shes gsal ba gnyis med sbas pas mdzad pa rnams dharma shri mi tra dang*/ chos kyi bzang po'i 'gyur/ mchod rten sgrub pa'i cho ga gtor ma'i cho ga /rnam pa nyi shus byang chub pa'i sgrub thabs/ 'jam dpal gyi sgrub thabs/ dkyil 'khor cho ga rnams so ma shris mdzad pa/ dge slong gzhon nu 'od kyis 'gyur/ 'jam dpal rig bsdus pa dang phye ba'i cho ga yid bzhin nor bu zla bzang grags pas mdzad pa/ dkyil 'khor cho ga shan+ti gar+bhas mdzad pa/ slob dpon des mdzad pa'i mtshan brjod kyi rdo rje'i glur blangs bla'i le'u yi sgrub thabs mdo dang bsres pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rnams so/ byang sems rdo rje'i dbang phyug dbyung*/ rnam snang dbang phyug dbyung*/ mi bskyod med pa dbang phyug dbyung*/ snang mtha' dbang phyug dbyung*/ rin 'byung dbang phyug dbyung*/ don grub dbyung*/ ro sreg cho ga /bdun tshig cho ga /sbyin sreg /tsha tsha rab gnas/ ngan sngags kyi 'khor lo/ bstod pa'i rim pa/ khrus chog /maṇ+ḍal cho ga/ skor ba bya thabs/ zas kyi rnal 'byor/ 'byung po'i gtor chog /sa chog /shes pa dug gsum las bzlogs pa'i man ngag

/byang chub kyi sems sgom pa'i man ngag /dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad la blta ba/ sgrub thabs/ spyod ched cho ga de kho na nyid sgom pa/ rten 'brel bcu gnyis bsgom pa dang*/ rjes dran du bsgom pa/ nam gyi cha smad mnyam par bzhag pa'i man ngag ste de rnams 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ yig ge brgya pa'i cho ga pad ma badz+ra gyi mdzad pa/ sgrub thabs/ spyod ched cho ga /bum pa'i cho ga /sbyin sreg cho ga /de bzhi mya ngan med pa'i dpal gyis mdzad pa dang*/ 'grel chung lo chen 'gyur/ man ngag gi 'grel pa gzhon nu grags pas mdzad pa/ 'jam dpal gyi mtshan brjod pa'i 'grel pa smri tis mdzad pa/ gsang sngags kyi tshul bshad pa/ tshul gsum gsal bar byed pa'i sgron ma/ mtshan brjod kyi rgya cher bshad pa tsan+t+ra go mis mdzad pa 'gos smra lha btsas dang*/ shes rab brtson grus 'gyur/ mtshan brjod 'grel pa zla bzang grags pas mdzad pa/ 'phags pa shes rab 'gyur/ mtshan brjod 'grel pa spu gri reg gcod ma rgyud gcod dga' rab rdo rjes mdzad pa rnams bzhugs/ (cu)pa la/ mtshan brjod 'grel pa mtshan don gsal ba bi ma las mdzad pa snyag gi 'gyur/ nā ro pas mdzad pa'i bar ma do'i cho ga sdog budha pa la'i 'gyur ro/ mtshan brjod kyi skor 'di thams cad yo ga yin nges mi snang yang mtshan brjod skor rnams phyogs mthun du bris pa'o/ gsum pa spyod rgyud kyi skor la/ rnam snang mngon byang gi rgyud kyi rgya cher bshad pa sangs rgyas gsang ba mdzad pa dang*/ slob dpon des mdzad pa'i bsdu don dpal brtsegs 'gyur/ thugs rje 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i sgom bzlas ye shes rdo rjes mdzad pa lo chen 'gyur rnams bzhugs/ bzhi pa bya rgyud la bya ba spyi'i rgyud dang*/ so'i rgyud gnyis las/ dang po ni/ (chu)pa la/ dpung bzang gi zhus pa'i rgyud kyi don bsdus sangs rgyas gsang bas mdzad pa/ rgyud don dgrol ba'i brjed byang*/

tshigs don bshad pa'i brjed byang ye shes rdo rjes mdzad pa/ legs sgrub kyi sgrub thabs gnyis mar me mdzad kyis mdzad pa/ legs grub kyi sgrub thabs byang chub mchog gis mdzad pa/ bsam gtan phyi ma'i rim par phye ba'i rgya cher bshad pa sangs rgyas gsang bas mdzad pa dpal brtseg 'gyur ste rgyud gnyis so// 'jam dpal gsang rgyud kyi 'grel pa rin chen phreng ba ngag gi dbang phyug gzhon nus mdzad pa/ 'jam dpal gsang rgyud kyi dkyil 'khor cho ga don yod zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ man ngag bdud rtsi'i 'khor lo lag na rdo rjes bsdus pa/ khro bo rnam par rgyal ba'i rtog pa gsang rgyud kyi rgya cher bshad pa/ 'di spyo rgyud du bzhed do// gos sngon can la klu sgrub dang*/ dza ba ri gnyis kyis bstod pa gnyis/ rnam 'joms la ma ni badz+ras bstod pa rnams bzhugs so// bzhi pa bya ba'i rgyud sgo drug la/ (ju)pa'i nang du/ dam tshig gsum bkod pa'i bsgrub thabs ku mu ta a ka ras mdzad pa kriṣ+ṇa pa dang*/ nag tsho 'gyur/ mi 'khrug pa'i gzungs sgrub/ dkyil chog /sgrub thabs/ sbyin sreg /bum chog rnams jo bo rjes mdzad pa/ sgrub thabs 'dze ta ris mdzad pa/ gtsug tor dri med 'grel pa lhan gcig skyes pa'i rol pas mdzad pa/ dza ye da ba dang*/ long so tshul khrims brtseg kyi 'gyur/ dri med sgrub thabs jo bo rjes mdzad pa/ gzung chog jo bos mdzad pa/ dri med kyi gzungs kyi cho ga mchod rten sgrub pa'i cho ga zhi ba snying pos mdzad pa/ mchod pa'i cho ga shan+ta rak+ṣi tas mdzad pa'o// gdug dkar dkyil chog pad ma lcags kyus mdzad pa/ gdug dkar sgrub thabs gnyis tsan+t+ra go mis mdzad pa/ las tshogs srung ba chen mo/ gzungs kyi cho ga mañju shris mdzad pa/ gzungs kyi 'grel pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor cho ga gnyis shu rang ga badz+ras mdzad pa zang dkar 'gyur/ sbyin sregs rdo rje rnon pos mdzad pa/ rim bsrung ba/

nor bsrung ba/ zhi ba'i sbyin sregs/ mngon spyod kyi las/ rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg /dbang gi sbyin sreg /sri bu gso ba/ zlog pa'i zor las rnams tsan+t+ra go mis mdzad pa/ sgrub thabs sher phyin 'gyur/ rab gnas cho ga /tsha tsha'i cho ga gnyis pad ma lcags kyus mdzad pa/ mchod rten bsgrub pa'i cho ga tsan+t+ra go mis mdzad pa'o// bsrung ba lnga'i sgrub thabs/ stong chen mo/ rma bya chen mo/ gsang sngags rjes 'dzin/ bsil ba'i tshal/ so so 'brang ma rnams kyi sgrub thabs/ so so 'brang ma'i 'khor lo ba'i cho ga rnams dze ta ris mdzad pa/ so 'brang ma'i sgrub thabs kyi cho ga sangs rgyas ye shes kyi gdams pa/ so so 'brang ba'i srung 'khor bri thabs shin+ta pas mdzad pa/ slob dpon des mdzad pa'i srung ba lnga'i sgrub thabs/ 'brang ma'i 'khor lo bri thabs klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ 'phags pa gnyis byi ta'i bum chog /sher phyin ma'i dkyil chog /sgrub thabs thams cad kyi las ka byed gsal byed gnyis rad na kirtis mdzad pa/ bal po ma hā pa na'i 'gyur ro// 'jam dpal dpal bo gcig sgrub kyi sgrub thabs mar me mdzad kyis mdzad pa/ dge blo'i 'gyur/ 'jam dpal gyi sgrub thabs ma tis mdzad pa/ a ra pa tsa'i sgrub thabs shra dhas mdzad pa/ de'i mchod chog /mtshan brjod sgrub thabs mi g.yo seng ges mdzad pa/ 'jam dpal blo 'phel klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ 'jam dpal g.yo ba'i 'khor lo shākya shris mdzad pa/ gsung gi sgrub thabs ka ma la shi las mdzad pa/ shes rab 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs tsan+t+ra ka ra gup+tas mdzad pa'o// spyan ras gzigs phyag stong pa'i sgrub thabs klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ dpal mos mdzad pa gnyis lo chen 'gyur/ dpal mos mdzad pa'i bstod pa tshan pa lnga/ snying rje la bstod pa kun sbyin gyis mdzad pa/ zla ba grag pas bstod pa/ yig ge drug pa'i sgrub thabs tsan+t+ra go mis mdzad pa/ tshan gnyis/ mar me mdzad kyis mdzad pa 'brom 'gyur/

phyag stong pa'i sgrub thabs ta thā ga ta badz+ra gyis mdzad pa/ yid bzhin nor bu'i sgrub thabs dze ta ris mdzad pa/ sgrub thabs klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ yi ge drug gi sgrub thabs dang gnyis/ yi ge drug pa'i sgrub thabs su dza badz+ras mdzad pa/ seng ge sgra'i sgrub thabs mar pa chos dbang gis 'gyur/ don zhag gi sgrub thabs/ gtor chog /gso sbyong blang ba/ gso sbyong gi cho ga'i man ngag ste bzhi po shākya shri mdzad pa/ rab mchog dpal gyis bsgyur ba/ yig ge drug pa'i rgyud kyi rim pa dkyil 'khor bstan pa'i sgrub thabs gzhon nu 'od kyi 'gyur/ yig ge drug pa'i sgrub thabs jo bos mdzad pa nag tsho 'gyur/ rta mgrin gyi sgrub thabs na ga ñju nas mdzad pa/ jo bos mdzad pa'i rta mgrin sgrub thabs gnyis/ tsan+t+ra go mis mdzad pa'i gtam rgyud/ bik+ṣi te de bas thugs rje chen po'i grub pa thob pa'i gtam rgyud/ shing bzo bas grub pa thob pa'i gtam rgyud/ bud med kyi grub pa thob pa'i lo rgyus/ su kha de bas grub pa thob pa'i lo rgyus ste bzhi paṇ+ḍi ta pu na ya shris bsgyur ba/ rdo rje lcags sgrog gi gzungs chog po ta li kas mdzad pa/ lta spyod rnam dag gam/ yi ge drug pa'i man ngag /'pho ba sbyong ba'i dus su bla ma'i rnal 'byor ste gsum po shākya shris sbyar ba/ 'ching ba rnam grol gyi man ngag mi tras mdzad pa/ dpa' bo gcig grub kyi rgyud kyis 'grel pa su bra ka ras mdzad pa da la shi la'i rang 'gyur/ dge ba'i 'dod 'jo'i bshad pa klu sgrub mdzad pa 'gos 'gyur/ sgrol ma brgya rtsa brgyad kyi sgrub thabs tsan+t+ra go mis mdzad pa/ nag tsho 'gyur/ me tog phreng 'dzin lha lnga'i sgrub thabs las chog dang bcas pa/ sgrol dkar sgrub thab thub bo dang*/ jo bo rjes mdzad pa dang*/ 'jig pa brgyad skyobs thams cad mkhyen pa'i bshes gnyen mdzad pa/ chu srin bcing ba chag 'gyur/

snying po dang nye snying gi sgrub thabs ḍom bhi pas mdzad pa/ mi g.yo ba'i sgrub thabs kha rgas mdzad pa/ sher phyir ma'i sgrub thabs ar+ya de bas mdzad pa/ bde mchog gi sgrub thabs bhu su kus mdzad pa/ tshe dpag med kyi sgrub thabs ka ma las mdzad pa/ 'dzam bha la'i man ngag ku lan dha ris mdzad pa/ bde mchog gi sgrub pa bya ba ka ma las mdzad pa/ byams pa'i sgrub thabs thogs med kyis mdzad pa/ sher phyin ma'i sgrub thabs dha ris pas mdzad pa/ mi pham mgon po'i sgrub thabs ni ri tis mdzad pa/ sher phyin ma'i sgrub thabs gser gling bas mdzad pa/ jo bos mdzad pa/ bstod pa jo bo rje mdzad pa gnyis/ pra bha ra kit+tis mdzad pa'i bstod pa sgrub thabs gnyis/ gshin rje gshed nag po'i sgrub thabs/ mi g.yo ba'i sgrub thabs gnyis a shwa shris sbyar ba/ mi g.yo bstod pa/ 'khor lo dze ta ris mdzad pa/ khams gsum rnam par rgyal bsgrub thabs dang*/ nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs las kyi rdo rjes mdzad pa/ bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sgrub thabs thang lo pas mdzad pa/ dzam+bha la'i sgrub thabs dang*/ gnod sbyin nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs gnyis las rdor gyis sbyar ba/ gnod sbyin nag po chen po'i bstod pa ka na ka ris mdzad pa/ klu'i dbang phyug rgyal po'i sgrub thabs klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ dam tshig gsum bkod kyi yig ge brgya pa'i sgrub thabs ke dha pa ṇi tas pas mdzad pa/ rdo rje sems dpa'i sgrub thabs rdo rje gdan pas mdzad pa/ yig brgya'i sgrub thabs rdo rje lcags kyus mdzad pa/ lus ngan po'i sgrub thabs dpa' bos mdzad pa/ mi 'khrug pa'i sgrub dkyil gnyis dze ta ris mdzad pa/ phyag rdor 'gro bzang gi sgrub thabs las tshogs dang bcas pa/ drag byed kyi cho ga 'gro bzang gis mdzad pa ste gnyis zangs dkar 'gyur rnams bzhugs/ gsum pa la/ rnam 'joms gzungs kyi 'grel pa rdo rje sgron ma slob dpon pad ma 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa/

bo dhe sa twas mdzad pa'i 'grel pa dpal brtsegs 'gyur/ gzungs kyi 'grel pa rdo rje go chas mdzad pa/ bi ma la mi tras mdzad pa/ rgya cher 'grel sgron me ye shes rdo rjes mdzad pa lo chen po 'gyur/ yang bi ma las mdzad pa bde ba'i myu gus mdzad pa/ smri tis mdzad pa/ rang 'gyur/ des mdzad pa'i gzungs kyis man ngag /rang 'gyur/ sangs rgyas gsang bas mdzad pa ste 'grel pa brgyad/ khrus kyis cho ga rad na shi las mdzad pa gnyis/ ye shes rdo rjes mdzad pa/ sbyin sreg rdo rje go chas mdzad pa/ gzungs sgrub ma ku ma ra se nas mdzad pa/ dpa' bo gcig pa/ las kyi sgrub pa/ gtor chog /sbyin sreg ste bzhi sangs rgyas gsang bas mdzad pa/ dkyil chog dga' ba'i sgron ma/ cho ga'i rim pa/ khrus chog ste gsum rdo rje go chas mdzad pa/ gzungs kyi 'grel pa rin chen phreng ba sha wa ris mdzad pa/ rnam 'joms cho ga rin po che'i mig thur shu rang ga badz+ra mdzad pa/ dkyil 'khor drug gi cho ga 'di gsum la ma tshang*/ sgrub thabs dang*/ khro bo gsang ba'i phrin las sha wa ris mdzad pa/ sbyin sreg cho ga dang gnyis bal po de sa pun+n+yai dang*/ chos bzang gis 'gyur/ sgrub thabs mdor bsdus tsan+t+ra go mis mdzad pa/ sgrub thabs ga ga dha ras mdzad pa/ gzungs sgrub ma ṇi badz+ras mdzad pa/ slob dpon des mdzad pa'i/ bum pa'i cho ga /zhi ba'i sbyin sreg/ gtor chog /las bzhi sgrub pa'i cho ga rdo rjes/ las bzhi'i sbyin sreg /bum pa'i cho ga /'khor lo'i cho ga gsum dz+nya na shris mdzad pa/ las bzhi'i sgrub thabs ma ṇi badz+ras mdzad pa/ las sna tshogs sgrub pa'i cho ga dz+nya na shris mdzad pa/ las mtha' bco brgyad pa'i man ngag rdo rje go chas mdzad pa/ khrus kyi cho ga byang chub snying pos mdzad pa/ dkyil 'khor cho ga bram ze dza ya warmas mdzad pa/ sgrub thabs las tshogs dang bcas pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor cho ga ye shes rdo rjes mdzad pa/ sgrub thabs sangs rgyas gsang bas mdzad pa/

bkra shis lha mo brgyad/ rig gsum gyi rtse mo sogs la bstod pa sogs yan lag bdun pa/ khrus chog dang*/ gzungs kyi 'grel gnyis sangs rgyas gsang bas mdzad pa/ slob dpon ye shes rdo rje/ mar me mdzad rnams kyis mdzad pa'i rnam 'joms brgya rtsar grags pa'i smad cung ma tshang ba rnams bzhugs/ bya rgyud kyi skabs so// gnyis pa rgyud sde spyi'i skor la/ sgrub thabs dang dkyil chog sna tshogs kyi skor ni/ (tu)pa la/ sgrub thabs rgya mtsho dang*/ sgrub thabs brgya rtsa dang*/ sgo drug gi gzungs kyi sgrub thabs dang*/ dkyil chog gnyis rin chen grags pas mdzad pa bal po ma hā sa ni'i 'gyur rnams bzhugs so// (thu)pa la/ mkhas pa a bh+ya ka rā gup+tas mdzad pa'i phreng ba skor gsum dang*/ bya ba bsdus pa'i piñca raka rig byin gyis mdzad pa grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ dkyil 'khor spyi'i rim pa kun dga' snying pos mdzad pa gsang ba spyi'i cho ga snying po rgyan 'jam dpal grags pas mdzad pa/ ka na shri dang*/ nyi ma rdo rje la sogs pa'i 'gyur/ dkyil 'khor cho ga mdor bsdus sangs rgyas gsang bas mdzad pa/ gzhal yas gsal ba'i mun sel sgron me pad mas mdzad pa/ dkyil 'khor gyi thig gdab pa'i tshul rtsa 'grel gnyis shra dhas mdzad pa lo chen 'gyur/ thig gdab pa'i rim pa dka' ba gcod pa shud dhi pra bhas mdzad pa/ thig gi cho ga dha rma kirtis mdzad pa rnams bzhugs/ (du)pa la/ kri ya sa mu ts+tsha zhes bya ba dar paṇa ar+yas mdzad pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta mañju shri dang*/ lo ts+tsha ba blo gros rgyal mtshan gyis 'gyur/ grub chen mi tra'i dbang brgya rtsa'i skor don yod rdo rje'i rang 'gyur rnams bzhugs/ rdo rje theg pa'i bslab pa yongs su dag pa'i thabs 'dul ba'i skor la/ (nu)pa la/ rtsa ltung bcu bzhi'i rgya cher 'grel 'jam dpal grags pas mdzad pa/ a tsar+ya u pa dang*/ badz+ra shi la dang*/ lots+tsha ba dge bsnyen brtson 'grus seng ge'i 'gyur/

rtsa ltung gi 'grel pa snying po zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ a mo ka dang 'o ru'i 'gyur/ rtsa ltung gi 'grel pa pradz+nya kirti 'gyur/ sbom po'i bshad pa rta dbyangs kyis mdzad pa/ rtsa ltung gi 'grel pa/ k+ṣa yaṃ ka ris mdzad pa/ rtsa ltung gi 'grel pa shan ti bas mdzad pa/ khyung grags 'gyur/ rdo rje theg pa'i ltung ba'i snye ma a bh+yas mdzad pa de nyid dang*/ rtsa mi 'gyur/ rtsa ltung dri med sbas pas mdzad pa/ rtsa ltung gi 'grel pa jo bo rje dang*/ nag tsho 'gyur/ ltung ba sbom po bsdus pa rta dbyangs kyi mdzad pa/ sbom po'i ltung ba klu sgrub kyi mdzad pa/ las dang po'i dam tshig mdor bsdus pa dz+nya na bo dhis mdzad pa/ tshul khrims gyi sdom pa mi 'gal ba ye shes bzang pos mdzad pa/ dam tshig bsdus pa jo bo rjes mdzad pa/ dam tshig kun la bsdus pa nyi shu rtsa lnga pa mar me mdzad pa ye shes kyis mdzad pa/ sdom gsum 'od phreng bi bhu ti tsan+t+ras mdzad pa de nyid kyis rang 'gyur rnams so// gdam pa sna tshogs dang man ngag sna tshogs kyi skor la rgyud ma lus pa'i dam pa'i don nges par bskul ba dpal gsang ba grub pa pad ma badz+ras mdzad pa/ kriṣ+ṇa paṇ+ḍi ta dang tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ thabs dang shes rab rnam par gtan la dbab pa grub pa yan lag med pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa/ shan ta bha tra dang*/ mgos lha btsas 'gyur/ ye shes grub pa in+t+ra bo dhis mdzad pa/ lo chen 'gyur/ gnyis med grub pa lha mo dpal chen mos mdzad pa lo chen 'gyur/ dngos po gsal ba'i rjes su 'gro ba'i de kho na nyid grub pa/ bi la pas mdzad pas 'gos 'gyur/ lhan cig skyes grub ḍom bhi pas mdzad pa/ gsang ba'i de kho na nyid kyi man ngag dha ri ka pas mdzad pa 'gos 'gyur/ de kho na nyid grub pa ker li pas mdzad pa rma chos 'bar 'gyur/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rim pa tog tse pas mdzad pa 'gos 'gyur/ bde ba chen po gsal ba a wa dhu tis mdzad pa/

rnyog pa med pa'i rgyud kyis dka' 'grel bik+ṣu ku ma ra tsan+t+ras mdzad pa badz+ra paṇi dang*/ mtshur dz+nya na ku ma ras bsgyur ba/ phyag rgya bzhi rjes su bstan pa klu sgrub mdzad pa/ phyag rgya bzhi'i rgya cher 'grel pa rin po che'i snying po bi ta kar mas mdzad pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i phyag rgya rnam par bshad pa/ lta ba ngan sel/ gnyis tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ lta ba ngan sel/ mtshur 'gyur/ de kho na nyid rin po che'i phreng ba tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ theg pa chen po nyi shu pa mtshur 'gyur/ de kho na nyid nyi shu pa/ de kho na nyid rab tu bstan pa/ tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ mi phyed pa lnga pa/ dga' gcug lnga pa/ de kho na nyid bcu pa/ mtshur 'gyur/ de'i 'grel pa lhan cig skyes pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa/ sgyu ma nges bstan a wa dhu tis mdzad pa'i des mdzad pa'i rmi lam nges bstan/ zung 'jug gsal ba/ dho ha ti de kho na nyid kyi man ngag thabs dang shes rabs brtse ba lnga pa/ rab tu mi gnas pa gsal bar ston pa/ lha ye shes drug pa/ dbu ma drug pa/ yid la mi byed pa ston pa rma 'gyur dbang gi dgos pa mdor bsdus ste de rnams gnyis med rdo rjes mdzad pa mtshur dang*/ tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ rdo rje'i tshigs ces bya ba badz+ra pā nis mdzad pa/ sgom rim drug pa pradz+nya ka la shris bsgyur ba/ gnas pa bsdus pa lhan cig skyes pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa rma 'gyur/ dbang skur nges bstan me tri pas mdzad pa/ de'i dka' 'grel ra ma pha las mdzad pa/ shes rab ye shes gsal ba/ de ba tsan+t+ra kā das mdzad pa de gsum tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur rnams bzhugs/ (pu)pa'i nang du/ rin po che 'od kyi snying po de kho na nyid kyi sgrub thabs nā ro pas mdzad pa/ badz+ra gu na ba tra dang*/ rin chen rgyal mtshan 'gyur/ gdam pa rin chen 'bru dgu shākya shris mdzad pa/ shākya shri mya ngan la 'da' khar nam mkha' la byon pa'i tshig bcad/

byang chub kyi yan lag bdun pa shākya shri'i spur sbyangs tshe nam mkha' la byung ba khro lo 'gyur/ thig le bcu drug gi nyam len na kaṃ ka li pas mdzad pa/ phyi nang byang sems bcing ba'i man ngag mi na pas mdzad pa/ rlung gi de nyid sgom pa'i man ngag gho ra k+ṣas mdzad pa/ rlung gi de nyid sgom pa'i man ngag tsi rang gis mdzad pa/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rdzogs rim bhi na pas mdzad pa/ rnal 'byor bzhi nyams su len thabs stan ta pis mdzad pa/ thabs dang shes rab gtan la dbab pa'i bsdus pa tsa ma ris mdzad pa/ rang bzhin grub pa med pa gzhi'i man ngag klu sgrub mdzad pa/ yig ge brgya pa'i sems dpa' gsum kyi sgom thabs nā ro pas mdzad pa/ rin chen phreng 'di la a lis mdzad pa/ snying rje'i sgom pa'i rlabs tai lo pas mdzad pa/ theg pa chen po'i gnas lugs gtan la dbab pa dha kan dhis mdzad pa/ sems la gros 'debs a dzo ka sis mdzad*/ gzhi lam 'bras bu yi sgom pa phyag rgya chen po'i nyams len ti pam ka ras mdzad pa/ rlung gi sgo nas rnal 'byor gyi spyod pa ḍom bhi pas mdzad pa/ ye shes gnyis pa'i man ngag dhaṃ gi pas mdzad pa/ de nyid bde ba sgom pa'i rjes 'brang rdor sgom pa'i man ngag ku ku ris mdzad pa/ 'dzag pa gcod pa'i man ngag ku dzi pas mdzad pa/ mu stegs kyi gtum mo tsin tis mdzad pa/ gser 'gyur gyi rtsi na lis mdzad pa/ sems dang sems nyid gdul ba'i thabs me ko las mdzad pa/ lha kun rdzob kyi rim pa'i lam ku dha ris mdzad pa/ nyi zla bcing ba'i thabs ka mas ris mdzad pa/ sems nyid thig le hūṃ yig sgom pa'i rim pa dza lan dha ras mdzad pa/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa bsgom pa dhu hū las mdzad pa/ hūṃ yig sems nyid thig ler bsgom pa'i rim pa dharma pas mdzad pa/ rang bzhin grub pa zhes bya ba dho ka ris mdzad pa/ lhan cig skyes pa'i gdams pa bha ga dzas mdzad pa/ a phreng ka phreng blags kyis rim pa/

bla med sbyor ba'i rim pa ghan dhas mdzad pa/ ka phreng bsgom pa'i lam dha ma dhu ta mas mdzad pa a phreng ka phreng bde mchog 'khor lo'i rnal 'byor chen po'i sgom pa sa ras mdzad pa rlung gnas kyi nad kyi brtag pa/ sems nyid kyi de nyid bcing ba ko lis mdzad pa gtum mo thig le bkram pa lus tsis kis mdzad pa lus kyi rtsa thig mnyam pa nyid kyi man ngag ni ku nis mdzad pa/ 'byung bzhi srid pa'i chag lugs tsa ra pa tris mdzad pa/ rang rig ye shes kyi lta ba'i nyams len tsam pa kas mdzad pa/ 'jigs brgyad rmongs par byed pa'i thabs be kha nas mdzad pa/ phyi nang gi dug sel ba'i rim pa te lo pas mdzad pa/ g.yung 'khyil pa gsum gyi gdams ngag gi nyams len yum kaṃ ka la me ka las mdzad pa/ lhan cig skyes pa'i rang bzhin khan ta ris mdzad pa/ a ti rnal 'byor gyi sgom pa'i thabs klu'i byang chub kyis mdzad pa/ byang chub kyi rlung rgyu ba'i gdams ngag sgom pa su ta lis mdzad pa/ lta bsgom skye med kyi sgom pa na has mdzad pa/ tshe bsgrub pa'i man ngag po ko lis mdzad pa/ dug sel bsgom pa'i rim pa a rang gis mdzad pa/ gnyis med kyi rtsa bsgom pa ni la khan dhas mdzad pa/ phra ba'i rnal 'byor gyi nyam len sa mu tras mdzad pa/ phyi nang bdud rtsi'i bcud len bh+ya ris mdzad pa/ rmi lam brtag pa bhi bhu ti tsan+t+ras rang 'gyur mdzad pa/ dho ha mdzod kyi dka' 'grel gnyis rdo rjes mdzad pa/ ba ri'i 'gyur/ dho ha mdzod kyi 'grel pa thar pa'i 'byung gnas sbas pa/ rgya lo ts+tsha'i 'gyur/ dpal nag po chen po rdo rje zhabs kyi dho ha mdzod kyi 'grel pa 'od dpag tu med pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa ba ri 'gyur/ spyod pa'i glu'i mdzod kyi 'grel pa thub pas byin gyis mdzad pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta chen po kirti dang*/ grags pa rgyal mtshan 'gyur/ lhan cig skyes grub shes rab grags kyis 'gyur mdzad pa/ de'i 'grel pa dpal mos mdzad pa 'gyur gong ltar/

rang bzhin gyi dho ha mdzod kyi glu'i lta ba lo hi pas mdzad pa/ rnam rtog spang pa'i glu lo hi pas mdzad pa/ las kyi gtum mo'i dho ha mdzod kyi glu bir ba pas mdzad pa/ lta bsgom spyod 'bras dho ha'i glu sa ra has mdzad pa/ dho ha mdzod kyi de nyid kyis glu tha ga nas mdzad pa/ spyod pa'i dho ha mdzod kyi glu kaṃ ka nas mdzad pa/ lhan cig skyes pa dho ha mdzod kyi glu bha dhes mdzad pa/ bde gshegs kyi lta ba'i glu dharma pas mdzad pa/ rlung gi de nyid kyi dho ha'i glu ma hi las mdzad pa/ dpyid kyi thig le'i dho ha mdzod kyi glu sa ra has mdzad pa/ rdo rje bzhi'i glu gnyis med rdo rje/ yang mai tri pa'i glu/ sa ra ha'i glu gnyis/ bh-i ra byed pa'i glu/ ka na pa'i glu/ dhi sha dz+nya na'i glu gnyis/ yang glu gcig /ka na ri'i glu/ ma ti tsa tra'i glu/ yang glu gnyis/ a tsa dpa' bo rnam snang mdzad kyi glu/ nā ro paṇa dhi'i glu/ klu'i pa'i glu/ ḍom bhi pa'i glu/ bhi ru pa'i glu/ la ba pa'i glu/ ma ha su ti'i glu/ pra sa ra'i glu/ klu'i glu/ ti pa ka ra'i glu/ yang glu gcig dho ha spyod pa'i glu'i lta ba ka na ris mdzad pa/ stong nyid lta ba sha ba ris mdzad pa/ bde sdug gnyis bral lta ba shan+ti pas mdzad pa/ 'brel med lta ba kaṃ pa las mdzad pa/ stong nyid snying rje'i lta ba tsa ta pas mdzad pa/ zhen med lta ba ka pa las mdzad pa/ sems nyid rin chen lta ba dhe ta nas mdzad pa/ de nyid brgyad kyi lta ba in+t+ra bo dhis mdzad pa/ sems nyid kyi rtog pa 'joms pa'i lta ba lak+ṣa mas mdzad pa/ mya ngan gyi lta ba dha'u ri mdzad pa/ sems tsam gyi lta ba mi tras mdzad pa/ snying rje spyod pa'i lta ba sa ra has mdzad pa/ 'brel med kyi lta ba nag po pas mdzad pa/ de bzhin nyid kyi lta ba dha ri ka pas mdzad pa/ phyag rgya chen po 'chi kha ma'i man ngag sa ra ha'i gdams pa/ ka kha dho ha'i bshad pa sa ra has mdzad pa/ de kho na nyid kyi man ngag rtse mo dho ha'i glu/

tshigs su bcad pa phyed kyi 'brel pa a ba dhu tis mdzad pa/ dngos po sbyang ba tai lo pas mdzad pa/ ko sa la'i rnal 'byor bā+ai ro tsa na'i 'gyur/ dngos po sbyang ba klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ rnam par mi rtog pa'i rab tu byed pa ar+ya de bas mdzad pa/ ma rtogs pa rtogs par byed pa gnyis med rdo rjes mdzad pa/ rang byin gyis brlabs pa'i rim pa sa ra has mdzad pa/ sems brtag pa tshul khrims 'phags pas mdzad pa/ de lnga rma 'gyur/ man ngag gi tshigs su bcad pa bcu gnyis pa sa ra has mdzad pa/ dngos po'i gnas lugs bsgom pa bde ba'i rdo rjes mdzad pa/ tshigs su bcad pa'i mdzod spyod pa'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa/ tshigs su bcad pa lnga pa nag po pas mdzad pa/ dpal rdo rje'i glu/ rnal 'byor spyod pa'i bsam gtan ka ro pas mdzad pa/ de kho na nyid grub pa'i rab tu byed pa slob dpon zhi ba 'tshos mdzad pa/ lo chen 'gyur/ de nyid mthong ba'i lam ye shes rdo rjes mdzad pa de nyid dang*/ rdog bhud dha pā la'i 'gyur/ slob dpon des mdzad pa'i sngags kyi bsgyur ba'i lam gyi rim pa/ sems kyi lam sbyang ba ste gnyis pa glan dar ma blo gros kyis bsgyur ba rnams bzhugs/ sngags kyi lam gyi rim pa dang cho ga sna tshogs kyi skor la/ (phu)pa'i nang du/ theg pa chen po'i lam gyi rim pa slob dpon ngan par grags pa dpal bzang po rdo rje zhes bya bas mdzad pa/ 'brog mi 'gyur/ lta bsgom chen mo/ lta bsgom 'bring po/ lta bsgom chung ngu*/ 'byung ba me lam du khyer ba/ chu lam du khyer ba/ chu gtor cho ga rnams rgya brtson seng 'gyur/ klu gtor cho ga lo chen 'gyur rnams mar me mdzad ye shes kyis mdzad pa'o/ de kho na nyid la 'jug pa bde bar gshegs pa'i bka' ma lus pa mdor bsdus te bshad pa'i rab tu byed pa ye shes grags pas mdzad pa/ bla ma brgyud pa'i rim pa'i man ngag phyag rgya chen po'i rnal 'byor du mtshon par byed pa badz+ra pa ṇis mdzad pa 'bro mi jo sras 'gyur/

de kho na nyid snying po bsdus pa chos kyi dbang pos mdzad pa gsang sngags kyi gsang ba slob dpon mtho btsun btso yig gis mdzad pa gnyis lo chen 'gyur lu gsang sngags la 'jug pa'i rab tu byed pa drug cu pa dz+nya na a ka ras mdzad pa/ de'i 'grel pa ye shes 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa gnyis lo chen 'gyur/ tshul khrims gsum sgron ma mtho btsun tri ba bhi kra mas mdzad pa lo chen 'gyur/ tshogs 'khor dbang gi rab byed rin chen snye ma/ rgyud thams cad kyi bskyed rdzogs thun mong du bstan pa man ngag gi snye ma gsum a bh+ya ka ra gup+tas mdzad pa zhang grub dpal gyi 'gyur/ dbang bskur nges bstan shan+tis pas mdzad pa tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ mtha' gnyis sel ba dz+nya na shris mdzad pa/ las dang po pa'i sgron ma a nu pa mas mdzad pa/ pu te pa la'i 'gyur/ las dang po pa'i bya ba rnyog med rdo rjes mdzad pa/ mchod pa'i cho ga dharma a ka ra mai tri pas mdzad pa dar ma grags kyi 'gyur/ las dang po pa'i bya ba mdor bsdus pa gnyis med rdo rjes mdzad pa/ maṇ+ḍal bya ba'i cho ga bsdus pa sangs rgyas gsang bas mdzad pa/ maṇ+ḍal gyi cho ga rin chen 'byung gnas sbas pas mdzad pa/ maṇ+ḍal gyi cho ga rnyogs med rdo rjes mdzad pa/ maṇ+ḍal gyi cho ga ka ma las mdzad pa/ las dang po pa'i bya ba bsdus pa mai tri pas mdzad pa/ gtor ma'i cho ga jo bo rjes mdzad pa/ gtor ma chen po'i las kyi rim pa'i 'grel pa mi bskyod rdo rjes mdzad pa/ cha gsum 'bring po shri dhas mdzad pa/ chu gtor dri ma med pa'i cho ga /rgyal chen bzhi'i cho ga gnyis mar me mdzad kyis mdzad pa/ gtor ma'i cho ga nyung ngu*/ rgyud sna tshogs las btus pa'i gtor ma'i cho ga klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa gzhon nu tshul khrims 'gyur/ gtor chog dza ya se nas mdzad pa/ chu gtor gyi rim par phye ba shākya shri mi tras mdzad pa/ gtor ma'i 'grel pa slob dpon bhi dha ngha dz+nya nas mdzad pa/

chos skyong thams cad kyi gtor ma'i cho ga slob dpon chen po ba laṃ a tsar+yas mdzad pa/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo las rnal 'byor ma drug bcu rtsa bzhi'i gtor chog bsdus pa paṇ+ḍi ta kirtis tsan+t+ras mdzad pa/ dkyil 'khor spyi'i rim pa tu su ra pa tras mdzad pa/ dbang gi don nges par brjod pa rgyal bzang pos mdzad pa/ yi ge brgya pa'i gang na tshul gyi sngon 'gro yi bsgrub thabs bi bhu ti tsan+t+ras mdzad pa/ yig brgya yi cho ga pad ma'i rdo rje lcags kyus mdzad pa/ yig brgya'i cho ga rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur rnams bzhugs/ (bu)pa'i nang du/ rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga mdor bsdus mi 'jigs pa'i dbang phyug gis mdzad pa/ rab gnas 'byung gnas go chas mdzad pa/ pa tshab 'gyur/ tshogs 'khor cho ga yid bzhin nor bu rat+na ka tas mdzad pa/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga a tsar+ya he ru badz+ras mdzad pa/ chos spyod thams cad kyi man ngag mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyud kyi rnam par bshad pa gzi brjid snang ba klu'i dbang phyug gi mdzad pa dge tshul khyung grags kyi 'gyur/ gtor ma'i cho ga gdon phal pa tshim par byed pa'i thabs rin chen bzang pos mdzad pa/ chu gtor cho ga jo bos mdzad pa/ rnam pa lnga mngon par byang chub pa'i rim pa shes rab grags kyi 'gyur/ 'chi ba bslu ba'i man ngag ngag dbang grags pas mdzad pa/ dus mchod bzhi'i ngos 'dzin shākya shris mdzad pa/ de kho na nyid la 'jug pa ye shes grags can no// bde mchog snyan rgyud rdo rje'i tshig rkang mar pa chos kyi blo gros 'gyur/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i man ngag zhal nas snyan du brgyud pa/ lus med mkha' 'gro'i chos bdud rtsi'i 'khor lo/ gsang ba rin po che nā ro pas mdzad pa/ rnal 'byor ma'i bsgrub thabs/ gtor chog gnyis nā ro pas mdzad pa/ gsang ba rin po che yid bzhin nor bu ye shes mkha' 'gro mas tai lo pa la gdams pa rnams mar pa chos kyi blo gros kyi 'gyur/

tai lo pas mdzad pa'i bsam mi khyab brgyad ni/ phyag rgya chen po bsam mi khyab/ phrin las bsam mi khyab/ bde ba chen po bsam mi khyab/ glu gar mkhan la gdams pa bsam mi khyab/ mu stegs la gdams pa chos nyid bsam mi khyab/ shan pa la gdams pa sbyor ba bsam mi khyab/ rig byed la gdams pa sna tshogs bsam mi khyab/ sgyu ma mkhan la gdams pa dngos po bsam mi khyab bo// ka dpe rtsa ba'i sdom mkha' 'gro ma'i zhal nas byung ba/ nā ro chos drug gi nyams len bka' dpe phyi ma'o/ rgyud sde chen po lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga de kho na nyid bsdus pa gsal rdo rje gdan pas mdzad pa/ ni gu mas mdzad pa'i bla ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga /'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor cho ga ni gu mas sdom pa rgya mtsho'i rgyud nas phyung ba/ 'khor lo sdom pa myur du 'grub pa'i thabs ni gu mas mdzad pa/ chos drug rdo rje'i tshig rkang khyung po la gdams pa/ sgyu ma lam rim/ de'i 'grel pa/ phyag rgya chen po rdo rje'i tshig rkang/ khyad 'phags lam khyer gyi chos gsum/ sems 'chi med rang grol gyi gzhung de rnams ni gus mdzad cing*/ glan dar ma'i 'gyur/ 'chi med grub pa'i 'grel pa/ de'i rtsa ba bir bas mdzad pa/ 'chi med grub pa'i dkyil chog /mar lots+tsha'i 'gyur/ bla ma phyi ltar bsgrub pa'i gzhung tai lo pas mdzad pa/ bla ma nang ltar bsgrub pa nā ro pas mdzad pa/ bla ma'i gsang sgrub klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa rnams bhi bhu ti tsan+t+ra'i 'gyur/ grub thob brgya bcu'i mngon rtogs dpal sdes mdzad pa/ bstod pa rdo rje gdan pas mdzad pa/ rtogs brjod rdo rje'i glu rnal 'byor pa nyi ma'i 'od zer gyis bsdus pa/ rdzogs rim rin po che'i phreng ba ḍa ma rus mdzad pa'o/ rnal 'byor pa chen po sa ra has dho ha spyod pa'i glu rgyal po la gdams pa/ mdzod kyi glu'i man ngag btsun mo la gdams pa/ dho ha mdzod kyi glu 'bangs la gdams pa/

de kho na nyid rnal du mtshon pa don dam pa'i yi ge /ka kha'i dho ha/ bā+ai ro tsa na'i rang 'gyur rnams so// gzhan yang dho ha mdzod sha ba ris mdzad pa/ bir ba pas mdzad pa/ tai lo pas mdzad pa/ nag po pas mdzad pa rnams 'gyur gong ltar/ lta bsgom spyod 'bras kyi glu mai tri pas mdzad pa/ yid la mi byed pa snying po don gyi glu/ rma rdo rje snying po'i 'gyur/ phyag rgya chen po'i man ngag rdo rje gsang ba'i glu/ sku'i mdzod 'chi med rdo rje'i glu gsung gi mdzod 'jam dbyangs rdo rje'i glu/ thugs kyi mdzod skye med rdo rje'i glu/ sku gsung thugs yid la mi byed pa'i glu phyag rgya chen po'i glu ste/ glu drug po sa ra has mdzad pa nag po pa'i rang 'gyur/ phyag rgya chen po'i man ngag tai lo pas mdzad pa gaṃ ga mar grag pa/ lta ba mdor bsdus nā ro pas mdzad pa ste gnyis po mar lo'i 'gyur/ rang gi sems ngal bso ba'i ma tshigs su bcad pa nyi shu rtsa lnga pa mi tras mdzad pa khro lo 'gyur/ lam 'bras rdo rje'i tshigs rkang rnams bzhugs/ (mu)pa la/ zhi byed kyi brgyud pa phyi ma'i bka' babs snyan rgyud bzhi'i gzhung las mchog gi brgyud pa rgyal po'i bka' lung thob pa lta bu phyag rgya chen po brda'i gdams pa bde gshegs bcu gnyis kyi man ngag /khyad par gyi brgyud pa mkha' 'gro'i tsi ta phyung nas snying khrag thang la pho ba rin po che'i gser gling du phyin pa lta bu'i man ngag mkha' 'gro ma'i skyes chos brgyad kyi dang po brda skor bzhi ni/ dam tshig mkha' 'gros gsungs pa'i brda dum bu bzhi/ dbyangs kyis mkha' 'gro gsungs pa'i mkha' 'gro brda'i gur chung*/ 'jig rten mkha' 'gro gsungs pa'i brda bam po lnga pa/ mkha' 'gro'i brda'i gur chung dum bu mkha' 'gro ma'i 'jam glu ring mo'o// don skor bzhi ni/ grub thob brgyad cu'i rtog brjod thig le dag pa'i phreng ba/ grub thob lnga bcu'i rtogs brjod thig le 'od kyi phreng ba/

grub thob bzhi bcu'i rtogs brjod rin po che gser phreng*/ mkha' 'gro ma sum bcu so lnga'i rtogs brjod shes rab gsal ba'i phreng ba dam pa rgya gar la gnang ba rnams zha ma lots+tsha'i 'gyur/ ngo mtshar brgyud pa'i bka' babs mkha' spyod bla ma so drug gi gdams pa/ sman pa mkhas pas nad gzhi lus zung du sgyur ba lta bu'i man ngag /thun mong gi gdams pa grub thob pho mo lnga bcu rtsa bzhi'i gdams pa rtsi mar la yang zhun byas pa lta bu'i gdams pa skor gsum gyi dngos so/ gzhung gi gnad bsdus pa lam dri med dngul sgong dag pa/ ngos sprod kyi gnad bsdus pa lam dri med gser sgong dag pa mi pham mgon pos gsung pa/ gdams pa'i gnad bsdus pa lam dri med shel sgong dag pa'i skor/ thun mong brgyud pa'i snyan rgyud sa ra ha'i dho ha gsang glu/ dho ha rdo rje gsang ba'i mgur gyi dka' spyod/ rngon pa chen pos mdzad pa'i brda phrad bdun/ zab don brda'i glu sha ba ri pas dam pa la gdams pa/ rnal 'byor thams cad kyi de kho na nyid snang ba grub thob rnams kyi rdo rje'i mgur grub thob stong gi gsang mdzod/ dam pa rang gis 'gyur/ mkha' 'gro ma thams cad kyi thugs kyi gsang mdzod rin po che dbang gi thig le/ mkhan po a bh+ya ka ra dang*/ blo gros seng ge'i 'gyur/ bstan srung chos skyong dang*/ nor lha'i skor la/ mgon po phyag drug pa'i sgrub thabs sa ra has mdzad/ nag po chen po'i gsang sgrub klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa rtsa mi 'gyur/ bla ma mgon po dbyer med du sgrub thabs sha ba ris mdzad pa gnyis/ yang sgrub thabs sha ba ris mdzad pa/ gsang sgrub rgyan can/ de'i byin brlabs/ zhal gzigs kyi sgrub thabs/ 'khor los gsad pa rnams sha ba ris mdzad pa/ bsgrub thabs ra hū las mdzad pa/ de'i byin brlabs kyi cho ga khyung pos mdzad pa/ dbang gi cho ga /phyag drug pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i sgrub thabs mkha' 'gro tshe bdag

/mgon po dbang gi rgyal po dmar po'i sgrub thabs mai tri pas mdzad pa/ rdo rje mkha' spyod ma'i sgrub thabs/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub thabs// lha bzhi'i sgrub thabs/ nag po chen po'i rgyud drag po'i brtag pa dur khrod chen po zhes bya ba'i 'grel pa rta dbyangs kyis sna nam bla ma'i 'gyur/ nag po chen po'i rgyud las dgra rnam par brlag par byed pa'i rim par phye ba sa man ta shris mdzad pa de nyid dang*/ chos rab kyi 'gyur/ char dbab pa la sogs pa'i sgrub thabs/ nag po chen po'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dngos grub rin chen 'byung gnas/ ye shes me sbar zhes bya ba'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga ste gsum po mdzad pa po sogs gong ltar/ nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs byin brlabs dang bcas pa slob dpon bsod snyam pas mdzad pa/ su ma ti kirti dang*/ pradz+nya kirti'i 'gyur/ nag po chen po'i gtor chog jo bos mdzad pa 'brom 'gyur/ nag po chen po lha bcu bdun gyi sgrub thabs/ de'i dkyil 'khor cho ga /gnyis po gyi ljang dbu dkar 'gyur/ srog gi spu gri'i sgrub thabs sbyin sreg gi cho ga rnams bram ze mchog sred kyis mdzad pa 'gyur gong ltar/ nag po chen po'i bstod pa a wa dhu tis mdzad pa/ bram ze mchog sred kyis mdzad pa/ yar lung ba seng ge rgyal mtshan gyis gud du byung ba/ sgrub thabs bram ze mchog sred kyis mdzad pa ba ri'i 'gyur/ sgrub thabs rgya mtsho las phyung ba/ las mgon nag po'i sgrub thabs bram ze mchog sred kyis mdzad pa/ mal gyo 'gyur/ nag po chen po phur bu'i sgrub thabs/ dur sol lha mo'i sgrub thabs ste gnyis po mdzad pa po sogs gong ltar/ dud sol ma'i gsang sgrub nā ro pas mdzad pa mar 'gyur/ zhal bzhi'i sgrub thabs klu sgrub can/ 'char ka nag pos mdzad pa'i par bu nag po'i sgrub thabs/ lha chen tshogs bdag gis sgrub thabs/

gsang bstan sgrub thabs/ nag po chen po bya rog ming can gyi khyad par gyi las tshogs bcu drug pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ phyag bzhi pa'i sgrub thabs ar+ya de bas mdzad pa/ bya gdong gi sgrub thabs rtsa mis mdzad pa/ seng gdong can gyi sgrub thabs rdo rje gdan pas mdzad pa/ des mdzad pa'i stag gdong can gyi sgrub thabs/ bka' sdod lce spyang gdong gi sgrub thabs/ mkha' 'gro sgrol byed ma'i sgrub thabs rnams so// ngan sngags kyi mtshon cha/ drag po'i btsan dug sha za seng gdong gi sgrub thabs a bh+ya dang*/ rtsa mi 'gyur/ nag po chen po bya rog gdong ma'i sham bu can brgyad la gnod sbyin gang po'i snying thig zab mo rdo rje gdan pas mdzad pa/ nag po chen po lha lnga'i sgrub thabs bka' mar grags pa klu sgrub can rtsa mi 'gyur/ bya rog ming can gyi sgrub thabs/ tshogs bdag gi bstod pa a mo gha badz+ras mdzad pa/ tshogs bdag gi sgrub thabs ma tshang ba/ tshogs bdag gi sgrub thabs nā ro pas mdzad pa ba ri'i 'gyur/ tshogs bdag gi 'khor lo'i gsal byed ḍom bi he ru kas mdzad pa/ 'khor lo'i gsal byed nā ro pas mdzad pa/ bgegs sel ba'i sgrub thabs jo bos mdzad pa/ tshogs bdag spre'u gsang ba'i sgrub thabs a mo ghas mdzad pa/ nag tsho 'gyur/ tshogs bdag gi sgrub thabs rgyas pa nag po pas mdzad pa 'brog mi 'gyur/ dzam+bha la nag po pa'i sgrub thabs shākya shris mdzad pa/ smug 'dzin la bstod pa zla bas mdzad pa/ u tsush+ma sgrub thabs thun mong ma yin pas sgeg rdor gyis mdzad pa/ smug 'dzin la bstod pa btsun pa zla bas mdzad pa/ smug 'dzin la bstod pa dz+nya na badz+ras mdzad pa/ 'dzam+bha la la bstod pa nyi ma rnam par gnon pas mdzad pa/ rmug 'dzin 'chol pa'i man ngag gi bstod pa dha byang chub sems dpas mdzad pa/ rmug 'dzin chu'i dbang po la phrin las nyi shu'i sgo nas bstod pa shri dz+nya na dang*/ byams pa dpal gyi 'gyur/

rmug 'dzin 'chol pa nag po'i sgrub thabs nor sbyin gyis mdzad pa 'gyur gong ltar/ rmug 'dzin 'chol ba'i sgrub thabs mu ti tas mdzad pa/ u tsusma zhes bya ba nor gyi bdag po'i sgrubs thabs da na shi la'i rang 'gyur/ 'dzam bha la dmar po'i sgrub thabs a bh+yas mdzad pa/ a pa ra tsit+ta'i bsgrub thabs in+t+ra bo dhis mdzad pa/ tshogs kyi bdag po 'jur 'geg sel ba'i sgrub thabs in+t+ra bo dhis mdzad pa/ gnod sbyin spun gnyis kyi sgrub thabs a dzi ta mi tras mdzad pa/ nor rgyun ma'i sgrub thabs da na shi la'i rang 'gyur/ nor rgyun ma'i bstod pa dang bcas pa rnams bzhugs so/ ༈ tha mal gnas lus longs spyod bya ba rnams/ rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor 'khor lo yis/ rnal 'byor thun bzhir goms pas sbyong byed pa/ 'bras bus lam byed sngags kyi khyad par ro/// /rgyu lam du byed pa mtshan nyid theg pa'i dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos la/ byang chub sems pa'i gnas skabs na phar phyin bcu'i sgo nas dka' ba spyad pa'i tshul mdzad pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnam par thar pa'i skor skyes pa rabs kyi sde la/ (ka)pa'i nang du/ skyes rabs kyi rgyud slob dpon dpa' bos mdzad pa'i so bzhi pa yan/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po bid t+ya ka ra sing ha dang*/ zhus chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban dhe mañju shri'i 'gyur/ de'i lhag ma kha skong du thams cad mkhyen pa rang byung rdo rjes mdzad pa'i seng ger skyes pa'i rabs yan bzhugs/ (kha)pa la/ ded dpon blo ldan gyi skyes pa'i rab man chad rdzogs dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi spyod pa btsun pa rta dbyangs kyis mdzad pa/ skyes rabs 'grel pa dharma kit+tis mdzad pa'i/ gtsug phud skyes pa'i rabs yan chad dang*/ (ga)pa la/ de'i 'jug yongs su rdzogs pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta dza nar dha na dang*/ lo tsā ba i bu dge slong shākya blo gros kyi 'gyur/ slob dpon seng ge zhabs phreng bas mdzad pa'i skyes rab kyi phreng ba/

paṇ+ḍi ta a laṃ ka ra de ba'i zhabs dang*/ tshul khrims 'byung gnas sbas pa'i 'gyur/ (nga)pa la/ 'jig rten kun dga' ba'i zlos gar tsan tra go mis mdzad pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta kirti tsin+t+ra dang*/ yar klungs ba grags rgyal gyi 'gyur/ klu kun tu dga' ba'i zlos gar dga' ba'i lhas mdzad pa mkhan po lak+ṣa ka ra dang*/ shong ston 'gyur/ rtogs brjod dpag bsam 'khri shing las/ byas shes kyi rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab yan dang*/ (ca)pa la/ de'i 'jugs yongs su rdzogs snyan ngag mkhan dge ba'i dbang pos mdzad pa 'gyur gong ltar ro// bka' bar pa mtshan nyid med pa las bka' rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum sogs kyi 'grel pa'i skor la/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan mgon po byams pas mdzad pa/ rngog blo ldan shes rab kyi 'gyur/ de'i 'grel pa slob dpon seng ge bzang pos mdzad pa blo ldan shes rab kyi 'gyur bzhugs/ (cha)pa la/ mngon rtogs rgyan gyis 'grel pa tshig gsal chos kyi bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ chos kyi shes rab kyi 'gyur/ mngon rtogs rgyan gyi 'grel pa'i bsdus don sher 'byung blo gros kyis mdzad pa rngog 'gyur/ mngon rtogs rgyan gyi 'grel pa rtogs par dka' ba'i snang ba gser gling pa chos kyi grags pas mdzad pa/ lo chen 'gyur las slad nas jo bo dang nag tsho'i

ma dpe las mi gsal/ nas mdzad pa de nyid dang*/ byams pa dpal gyi 'gyur/ grags pa'i cha rad na kirtis mdzad pa'i skabs gsum pa yan bzhugs/ (ja)pa la/ de'i 'jug yongs su rdzogs ma dpe las mi gsal/ 'gyur/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i don bsdus sgron ma dpal mar me mdzad ye shes kyis mdzad pa/ de nyid dang*/ nag tso'i gyur/ 'grel pa dag ldan shin+ta ma dpe las mi gsal/ (nya)pa la/ de'i 'jug yongs su rdzogs pa mkhan po sha su bhu ti shan+ti dang*/ lots+tsha ba shākya blo gros dang*/ shan+ta bha tra dang*/ 'gos lha btsas 'gyur/ yum gsum 'grel pa ma dpe las mi gsal/ 'jug yongs su rdzogs pa/ mkhan po su man+t+ra bo dhe dang*/ ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ yum gyi 'grel pa daṃ ྴྟ se nas mdzad pa'i le'u dgu yan/ (tha)pa la/ le'u ma dpe las mi gsal/ de'i 'jug yongs su rdzogs pa dang*/ stong phrag brgya pa'i rnam par bshad pa dharma shris mdzad pa dang*/ slob dpon seng ge bzang po'i nyi khri le'u brgyad ma'i bam po bdun pa ma dpe las mi gsal/la de'i 'jug yongs su rdzogs pa/ mkhan po bid ta ka ra pra bha dang*/ lots+tsha ba dpal brtsegs dang*/ slad go mi 'chi med dang*/ blo ldan shes rab kyi 'gyur dang*/ ma dpe las mi gsal/ mthong lam yan dang*/ (ma)pa la/ de'i 'jug yongs su rdzogs pa blo ldan shes rab kyis bsgyur ba dang*/ btsun pa grol sdes mdzad pa'i nyi khri rnams 'grel gyi zhing dag pa'i sbyor ba yan dang*/ (tsa)pa la/ de'i 'jug yongs su rdzogs pa/ mkhan po shan+ti bha tra dang*/ 'bro seng dkar shākya 'od kyi 'gyur dang*/ brgyad stong don bsdus phyogs kyi glang pos mdzad pa blo ldan shes rab kyi 'gyur dang*/ brgyad stong 'grel chen seng ge bzang pos mdzad pa'i le'u gsum pa man dang*/ (tsha)pa la/ de'i 'jug yongs su rdzogs/ mkhan po su bha shi ta dang*/ lo chen 'gyur las/ ti pam ka ra shri dz+nya na dang*/ lo chen 'gyur/

brgyad stong 'grel pa snying po mchog shan+ti pas mdzad pa'i bsgrub pa'i ched du bya ba yan dang*/ (dza)pa la/ de'i 'jug yongs su rdzogs pa paṇ+ḍi ta shi ku ma ra dang*/ shākya blo gros kyi 'gyur/ brgyad stong 'grel pa gnad kyi zla zer 'jigs med 'byung gnas sbas pas mdzad pa'i le'u brgyad pa yan dang*/ (wa)pa la/ de'i mjug yongs su rdzogs pa paṇ+ḍi ta de nyid dang*/ shes rab dpal gyi 'gyur/ brgyad stong 'grel pa man ngag gi rjes 'brang shri dza ga ta legs gnas pas mdzad pa'i le'u bcu gnyis pa yan dang*/ (zha)pa la/ yongs su rdzogs pa a laṃ ka de ba dang*/ tshul khrims 'byung gnas kyi 'gyur/ seng ge bzang pos mdzad pa'i sdud 'grel rtog par sla ba dang*/ sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i sdud 'grel/ bid t+ya ka ra sing ha dang*/ dpal brtsegs 'gyur rnams bzhugs/ (za)pa la/ sher snying 'grel pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ glan chung dang*/ stag lots+tsha'i 'gyur/ sher snying 'grel pa bi ma la mi tras mdzad pa de nyid dang*/ nam mkha' la sogs pa'i 'gyur/ sher phyin bdun brgya pa'i 'grel pa ka ma la shi las mdzad pa cung ma tshang ba/ dkon mchog gsum rjes su ma dpe las mi gsal/ gnyen gyis mdzad pa da na shi la'i 'gyur/ sangs rgyas pa'i rnam par bshad pa ngang tshul bzang pos mdzad pa/ dkon brtsegs las 'od srung le'u'i 'grel pa blo brtan gyis ma dpe las mi gsal/ pa dpal brtsegs 'gyur/ sa lu ljang pa'i mdo 'grel ka ma la shi las mdzad pa/ rnam par mi rtog par 'jug pa'i gzungs kyi 'grel pa ka ma la shi las ma dpe las mi gsal/ ('a)pa la/ dha ka ye shes kyi mdo'i 'grel pa pradz+nya sa mu tras mdzad pa/ dha ka ye shes kyi 'grel pa zhi ba lhas mdzad pa/ 'phags pa shes rab 'gyur/ ga ya ma dpe las mi gsal/ ye shes sde'i gyur/ ga ya go ri'i mdo 'grel shāg blos mdzad pa/ tshigs su bcad pa gcig pa'i 'grel pa dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa/

sgo drug pa'i gzung ma dpe las mi gsal/ dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ chos bzhi'i rnam par bshad pa ye shes byin gyis mdzad pa ye shes sde'i 'gyur tshigs su bcad pa gnyis pa'i 'grel pa slob dpon chen po mdzes bkod kyis mdzad ma dpe las mi gsal/ pas mdzad pa grags pa'i phreng ba tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur rnams bzhugs/ (ya)pa la/ sa bcu pa'i mdo yi gleng gzhi'i bshad pa shākya blo gros kyis mdzad ma dpe las mi gsal/ pa dpal brtsegs 'gyur/ sa bcu pa'i 'grel bshad nyi ma grub kyi mdzad pa/ dpal brtsegs 'gyur/ (ra)pa la/ rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba dang po dang rnam par dbye ba'i mdo sde rnam par 'gre pa ba su ban dhus mdzad pa/ nam mkha'i 'gyur/ rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba thog ma dang rnam par dbye ba bstan pa'i rgya cher bshad pa yon tan blo gros kyis mdzad pa 'gyur gong ltar/ las sgrib rnam par sbyong ba'i bshad pa ti paṃ ka ra shri dz+nya nas mdzad pa/ phung po gsum pa'i sgrub thabs slob dpon kriṣ+ṇa pas mdzad pa de gnyis jo bo dang*/ nag tso 'gyur/ byang chub kyi ltung ba bshags pa'i 'grel pa dze ta ris mdzad pa/ chag 'gyur/ ltung bshags kyi 'grel pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ shan ta rak+ṣi ta dang*/ rnyi ba de ba gho ra'i 'gyur rnams bzhugs so/ (la)pa la/ dgongs pa nges 'grel gyi rnam bshad thog med kyi mdzad pa'i le'u dgu pa yan dang*/ (sha)pa la/ lhag ma yongs su rdzogs pa dang*/ dgongs pa nges 'grel gyi rnam bshad slob dpon wan tsheg gis mdzad pa'i bam po bcu bzhi pa yan dang*/ (sa)pa dang*/ (ha)pa gnyis la/ de'i 'jug yongs su rdzogs pa/ lots+tsha ba mgo chos grub kyis 'gyur bzhugs/ (a)pa la/ pad dkar 'grel pa sing ga gling gi slob dpon sa'i rtsa lag gis mdzad pa/ rgya dpe la bsgyur ba dang*/ 'phags pa lang kar gshegs pa'i 'grel pa ye shes bzang pos mdzad pa'i le'u gsum pa yan dang*/ (ki)pa la/

le'u bzhi pa man chad rdzogs pa dang*/ lang gshegs 'grel pa dza na badz+ras mdzad pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po rgyan gyi le'u gsum pa yan dang*/ (khi)pa la/ de lhag ma yongs su rdzogs pa dang*/ blo gros mi bzad pas bstan pa'i 'grel pa dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa'i chos so so yang dag par rig pa yan dang*/ (gi)pa ma dpe las mi gsal/ mchod pa'i cho ga bsdus pa ba bodhi sa twas mdzad pa dang*/ rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'i tshigs le'u byas pa/ rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'i snying po'i rnam bshad ma dpe las mi gsal/ klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ mdo btus kyi rnam bshad shan+ti bas mdzad pa/ tshul khrims rgyal ba'i gyur rnams bzhugs so// (ngi)pa la/ jo bo rje ma dpe las mi gsal/ mdo btus kyi man ngag tu bya ba gnyis/ nag tso 'gyur/ theg pa bsdus pa'i sgron ma nag po pas mdzad pa/ de nyid dang*/ chos shes 'gyur/ dbu ma rtsa ba shes rab klu ma dpe las mi gsal/ ha su ma ti dang*/ ka na ka dang*/ pa tshab nyi ma grags kyis bsgyur ba/ rtsa ba shes rab kyi 'grel pa ga la 'jigs med klu sgrub mdzad pa/ rnams bzhugs ma dpe las mi gsal/ li tas mdzad pa dang*/ rtsa she'i 'grel pa shes rab sgron ma legs ldan 'byed kyis mdzad pa gnyis cog ro 'gyur/ (chi)pa la/ shes rab sgron me'i 'grel ma dpe las mi gsal/ pa'i rab byed gsum pa yan dang*/ (ji)pa la/ rab byed bcu pa yan chad dang*/ (nyi)pa la/ rab byed nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa yan dang*/ (ti)pa la/ de'i lhag ma dpe las mi gsal/ 'grel pa tshig gsal slob dpon zla ba grags pas mdzad pa'i rab byed bcu bdun pa yan dang*/ (thi)pa la/ de'i 'jug yongs su rdzogs pa pa tshab nyi ma grags kyis 'gyur dang*/ stong nyid bcu bdun pa'i rtsa ba dang 'grel pa gnyis klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ stong nyid bdun bcu pa'i 'gre la pa slob dpon gzhan la phan pas mdzad pa/ gzhon nu mchog gi 'gyur/

rtsod pa zlog pa rtsa 'grel gnyis klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ zhib mo rnams 'thag rtsa 'grel gnyis klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa khu mdo sde 'bar gyi 'gyur/ rigs pa drug bcu pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ pa tshab 'gyur/ de'i 'grel pa zla ba grags pas mdzad pa 'gyur gong ltar/ rin chen phreng ba klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ de'i 'grel pa mi pham bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ bshes springs klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ de gsum dpal brtsegs 'gyur/ dbu ma bzhi brgya pa ar+ya de bas mdzad pa/ bshes springs 'grel pa tshig gsal blo gros chen pos mdzad pa dpal brtsegs 'gyur rnams bzhugs/ (di)pa la/ ma rtogs pa rtogs par byed pa'i rab byed grags 'byor shes rab kyi 'gyur/ skyes med rin po che'i mdzod pa tshab 'gyur/ de gnyis klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ ye shes snying po kun las btus pa 'phags pa lhas mdzad pa/ ye shes snying po btus byang chub bzang pos mdzad pa de gnyis chos shes 'gyur/ bde bar gshegs pa'i gzhung rnam par 'byed pa'i tshigs le'ur byas pa dze ta ris mdzad pa/ shwakya 'od kyi 'gyur/ rab tu byed pa lag pa'i tshad kyi tshig le'ur byas pa dang*/ de'i 'grel pa 'khrul pa bzlog pa'i rig pa gtan tshigs grub pa/ de gsum ar+ya de bas mdzad pa dpal brtsegs 'gyur/ rtog ge pa'i tho ba'i tshig le'u byas pas paṇ+ḍi ta dza ya a nan tas mdzad pa/ khu mdo sde 'bar gyi 'gyur/ phung po lnga'i rab byed zla ba grags pas mdzad pa/ dbu ma rin chen sgron ma bha bh+yas mdzad pa/ dbu ma'i don bsdus pa legs ldan byed kyis mdzad pa/ dbu ma rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba nag po pas mdzad pa/ dbu ma 'khrul 'joms bha bh+yas mdzad pa/ de rnams jo bo dang*/ nag tsho 'gyur/ yi ge brgya pa'i rab tu byed pa'i 'grel pa slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ grags 'byor shes rab kyis bsgyur ba/ srid pa 'pho ba paṇ+ḍi ta byams pa mgon pos mdzad pa/

paṇ+ḍi ta zla ba gzhon nu la/ gru ston chung gis zhus nas rang 'gyur du mdzad pa/ dbu ma snying po'i tshig le'ur byas pa slob dpon bha bh+yas mdzad nag tsho 'gyur/ dbu ma snying po rtog ge 'gyur ba/ dbu ma la 'jug pa slob dpon zla ba grags pas mdzad pa/ mkhan po ti la ka dang*/ pa tshab la sogs pa'i 'gyur rnams bzhugs/ (ni)pa la/ 'jug pa'i 'grel pa zla ba grags pas mdzad pa/ 'jug pa'i 'grel bshad don gsal kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta dza ya a nan tas mdzad pa'i le'u lnga pa yan bzhugs/ (pi)pa la/ de'i lhag ma yongs su rdzogs pa de nyid dang*/ ban dhe kun dga' grags kyi 'gyur/ dbu ma rgyan gyi 'grel pa zhi ba 'tshos mdzad pa/ dbu ma rgyan gyi dka' 'grel ka ma la shi las mdzad pa/ ye shes sde'i 'gyur rnams bzhugs/ (phi)pa la/ dbu ma snang ba ka ma la shi las mdzad pa/ dpal brtsegs 'gyur/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa slob dpon zhi ba lhas mdzad pa/ dpal brtsegs dang*/ lo chen la sogs pa'i 'gyur/ spyod 'jug gi 'grel pa la/ dka' 'grel bai ro tsa na rak+ṣi tas mdzad pa/ dka' 'grel sher 'byung blo gros kyis mdzad pa'i le'u gsum pa yan dang*/ (bi)pa la/ de man chad yongs su rdzogs pa/ su ma ti karti dang*/ dar ma grags kyi 'gyur/ dgongs 'grel khyad par gsal bi bhu ti tsan+t+ras mdzad pa/ de nyid kyis rang 'gyur mdzad pa rnams bzhugs/ (mi)pa la/ legs par sbyar ba dge ba lhas mdzad pa/ shri ku ma ra dang*/ dge slong blo gros kyi 'gyur/ shes rab le'u yi dka' 'grel mi mnyam khol po dang*/ blo ldan shes rab la sogs pa'i 'gyur/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa'i rnam par bshad pa/ spyod 'jug gi don sum cu rtsa drug bsdus pa gser gling ba chos skyong gis mdzad pa/ nag tsho gyur/ des mdzad pa'i spyod 'jug don bcu gcig tu bsdus pa na tsho 'gyur/ rtogs dka'i gnas gtan la dbab pa kriṣ+ṇa pas mdzad pa de nyid dang chos shes 'gyur rnams so// bslab pa kun la btus pa zhi ba lhas mdzad pa le'u bcu gnyis pa yan dang*/

(tsi)pa la/ de'i 'jug yongs su rdzogs pa/ ye shes sde dang*/ blo ldan shes rab 'gyur/ bslab btus tshig le'ur byas pa shan ta de bas mdzad pa/ mngon par rtogs pa mar me mdzad ye shes dang*/ nag tsho 'gyur/ dus gsum brtags pa phyogs glang gis mdzad pa/ shan+ta a ka ra gup+ta dang*/ tshul khrims rgyal mtshan 'gyur/ chos dang chos nyid gtan la dbab pa dze ta ris mdzad pa/ byang chub sems kyi legs lam gyi rim pa mdor bsdus shākya dpal bzang gis mdzad pa de nyid kyi 'gyur/ tshad med bzhi'i 'grel pa bud dha ghu h+yas mdzad pa/ rnal 'byor grol ba'i lam la sbyangs pa'i yon tan bstan pa/ dpal brtsegs 'gyur/ skyabs 'gro yan lag drug pa bi ma las mdzad pa/ ltung ba spyi bshags kyi cho ga jo bo rjes mdzad pa/ ltung ba bshags pa'i cho ga de ba shan+tis mdzad pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod yul yongs su dag pa'i mdo don mdor bsdus pa dgra gcan 'dzin bzang po'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ skyabs su 'gro ba bstan pa/ byang chub sems dpa' las dang po pa'i lam la 'jug pa bstan pa gnyis jo bo rjes mdzad pa/ nag tsho 'gyur/ byang chub sems dpa'i lam gyi rim pa bsdus pa shākya dpal bzang gis mdzad pa/ chag 'gyur/ bslab pa'i snye ma bai ro tsa na rak+ṣi tas mdzad pa/ mar pa chos dbang gis bsgyur ba/ bden pa gnyis rnam par 'byed pa'i 'grel pa zhi ba 'tshos mdzad pa/ bden pa gnyis rnam par 'byed pa'i dka' 'grel ye shes snying pos mdzad pa/ slob ma la spring ba'i 'grel pa sher 'byung blo gros kyis mdzad pa/ slob spring gi dka' 'grel bai ro tsa na rak+ṣi tas mdzad pa/ legs pa'i lam ston pa dpa' bos mdzad pa/ shes rab kyi phrin yig pad ma rdo rjes mdzad pa/ sems rin po che rnam par sbyongs pa'i rim pa zhes bya ba'i 'phrin yig byang chub sems dpa' dgra las rnam par rgyal bas mdzad pa/ chos smra ba dang chos nyan pa la brtson par bya ba'i gdam pa 'tsho byin gyis mdzad pa/

ched du brjod pa'i gtam drang srong zla bas mdzad pa/ mi rtag pa'i don gyi gtam dga' ba'i dbang pos mdzad pa/ shes rab brtsam pa dus kyi gtam bram ze bha lo la gdams pa/ tshul khrims kyi gtam gyi 'grel pa gsal grags kyis mdzad pa/ dri ma med pa rin po che'i phreng yig ti paṃ ka ras mdzad pa/ bla ma la spring dge slong dgon pas mdzad pa/ bu la spring ba paṇ+ḍi ta saṃ dza nas mdzad pa/ lta ba'i khyad par ye shes sdes mdzad pa/ lhag mthong bskyed thabs rnams bzhugs/ (tshi)pa la/ theg pa chen po rgyud bla ma'i bstan bcos 'phags pa byams pas mdzad pa/ de'i 'grel pa thogs med kyis mdzad pa/ blo ldan shes rab 'gyur/ mdo sde rgyan byams pas mdzad pa/ dpal brtsegs la sogs pa'i 'gyur/ mdo sde rgyan gyi 'grel pa dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ dpal brtsegs la sogs pa'i 'gyur rnams bzhugs/ (dzi)pa la/ mdo sde rgyan gyi 'grel bshad/ blo brtan gyis mdzad pa/ mkhan po mu ni tsan+t+ra dang*/ lce bkra shis kyis 'gyur bzhugs/ (wi)pa la/ mdo sde rgyan gyi 'grel pa ngo bo nyid med pas mdzad pa/ dpal brtsegs la sogs pa'i 'gyur/ dbus dang mtha' rnam par 'byed pa mgon po byams pas mdzad pa ye shes rdo rje'i 'gyur/ mdo sde rgyan gyi don bsdus dz+nya na shris mdzad pa/ gzhon nu mchog gi 'gyur/ mdo sde rgyan gyi don bsdus dz+nya na shris mdzad pa/ chos brtson 'gyur/ dbus mtha'i rnam bshad dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ dbus mtha'i 'grel pa blo brtan mdzad pa'i le'u gsum pa yan dang*/ (zhi)pa'i nang du/ de'i lhag ma yongs su rdzogs pa dang*/ chos nyid rnam 'byed byams pas mdzad pa/ de'i 'grel pa dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa gnyis/ rngog 'gyur/ rnal 'byor spyod pa'i sa'i bam po bcu drug pa yan dang*/ (zi)pa'i nang du/ de'i lhag ma yongs su rdzogs pa dang nyan pa yan bzhugs/ ('i)pa'i nang du/ byang chub sems dpa'i sa/ byang sa'i go rim gnyis ye shes sde'i 'gyur/

sa'i dngos gzhi'i rnam bshad ma tshang ba gcig bzhugs/ (yi)pa'i nang du/ rnal 'byor spyod pa'i sa rnam par gtan la dbab pa bsdu ba/ (ri)pa la/ gzhi bsdu ba'i dang po mdo sde'i gzhi bsdu ba/ 'dul ba'i ma mo'i sdom/ 'dul ba bsdu ba/ rnam grangs bsdu ba/ rnam par bshad pa'i sgo bsdu ba rnams 'phags pa thogs med kyis mdzad pa ye shes sde'i 'gyur rnams bzhugs/ (li)pa la/ byang sa'i 'grel pa jo bo dang*/ nag tsho 'gyur/ tshul khrims le'u yi bshad pa ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ de gnyis yon tan 'od kyis mdzad pa/ tshul khrims le'u yi 'grel pa rgyal sras kyis mdzad pa/ ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ byang sa'i 'grel pa rgya mtsho sprin gyis mdzad pa'i tshul khrims le'u yan bzhugs/ (shi)pa la de'i 'jug yongs su rdzogs pa/ zhi ba bzang po dang*/ nag tsho 'gyur/ theg bsdus kyi 'grel pa rab tu gsal ba dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa'i bam po lnga pa yan dang*/ (si)pa la/ de'i 'jug yongs su rdzogs pa/ jo bo dang tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ theg bsdus kyi 'grel pa don gsang rnam par phye ba/ phung po lnga'i rab byed dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ phung po lnga'i rab byed kyi 'grel pa blo brtan gyis mdzad pa/ dzi na mi tra'i 'gyur/ phung po lnga'i rab byed kyi 'grel pa yon tan 'od kyis mdzad pa/ phung po lnga'i bshad pa cung ma tshang ba rnams bzhugs/ (hi)pa la/ rang bzhin gsum nges par bstan pa 'gos 'gyur/ bstan bcos tshigs su bcad pa bsdu ba/ tshigs su bcad pa don bsdu ba'i bstan bcos/ de gnyis dpal brtsegs 'gyur/ theg pa chen po'i chos brgya gsal ba'i sgo'i bstan bcos/ lha btsun chos rin 'gyur/ de rnams dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ rab tu byed pa chos mngon pa la 'jug pa/ mngon pa la 'jug pa snying po kun las btus pa ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ nyi shu pa dang*/ sum bcu pa'i rab byed gnyis dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa ye shes sde'i 'gyur/

sum bcu pa'i rnam bshad blo brtan gyis mdzad pa ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ sum bcu pa'i 'grel bshad dul ba'i lhas mdzad pa/ byang chub lam gyi sgron ma'i dka' 'grail mar me mdzad ye shes kyi mdzad pa de nyid dang*/ nag tsho 'gyur/ sdom pa nyi shu pa'i 'grel pa shan+ti rik+ṣi tas mdzad pa rnams bzhugs/ (i)pa la/ rnam bshad rig pa'i 'grel bshad/ de ban tra rak+ṣi ta'i 'gyur/ las grub pa'i rab byed dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ de'i 'grel pa zangs tshul gyis mdzad pa de gnyis dpal brtsegs 'gyur/ chos kyi rnam grangs kyi brjod byang dpal brtsegs rak+ṣi ta la sogs pa'i 'gyur/ dam pa'i chos dran pa nye bar bzhag pa'i 'gro ba drug gi tshig le'ur byas pa chos ldan rab 'byor dbyangs kyis mdzad pa/ de ban+t+ra rak+ṣi ta'i 'gyur/ 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga'i nyes dmigs bshad pa dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ dgra bcom dge 'dun 'phel lung bstan pa/ myang ngan med kyi sgo nas klu btul ba'i le'u/ shākya 'od kyi 'gyur dpe yi phreng ba rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ li yul lung bstan pa'i le'u ste rnams bzhugs/ (ku)pa la/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag shin+tis pas mdzad pa/ 'gos 'gyur/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa'i man ngag shan+ti pas mdzad pa lo chen 'gyur/ rnal 'byor spyod pa'i bsam gtan ka ro pas mdzad pa/ dbu ma'i man ngag gi 'grel pa shes rab thar pas mdzad pa/ mdo btus kyi don bsdus jo bos mdzad pa/ ka ma la shi las lho za mo tshangs dbyangs la sdug bsngal brgyad kyi bye brag bstan pa/ dbu ma shes rab la 'jug pa zla ba grags pas mdzad pa/ chos thams cad rang bzhin med pa nyid du grub pa ka ma la shi las mdzad pa/ de kho na nyid snang ba zhes bya ba'i rab tu byed pa ka ma la shi las mdzad pa/ dbu ma'i lugs kyi snying po mdor bsdus ber+ya ka ras mdzad pa/ rnal 'byor bsgom pa la 'jug pa ka ma la shris mdzad pa/

shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag ka ma la shris mdzad pa/ rnal 'byor la 'jug pa phyogs glang gis mdzad pa/ mi sdug pa bsgom pa dge ba'i go chas mdzad pa/ lus yongs su dpyad pa bsgom pa'i rim pa nag po zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ phar phyin theg pa'i bsgom pa'i rim pa'i man ngag ye shes grags pas mdzad pa/ sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa bla na med pa bsgom pa shan+ti pas mdzad pa/ rnal 'byor la 'jug pa'i man ngag chos dbang gis mdzad pa/ sher phyin bsgom pa'i man ngag shan+ti pas mdzad pa/ rnal 'byor spyod pa'i don mdor bsdus te bstan pa klu'i bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa don bcu gnyis bstan pa 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyi mdzad pa/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis rtogs brjod/ rin po che'i phreng ba tsan+t+ra ha ris mdzad pa/ dge ba'i sdong po'i rab byed rad na kirtis mdzad pa/ sku gsum la 'jug pa'i sgo klu'i bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ sku gsum 'grel pa ye shes zla bas mdzad pa/ lta ba tha dad rnam par phye ba mdor bsdus pa dbu ma seng ges mdzad pa/ pha rol tu phyin pa bsdus pa ar+ya mañju ras mdzad pa/ dbu ma'i don bsdus pa legs ldan 'byed kyis mdzad pa/ dbu ma rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba nag po pas mdzad pa/ bsam gtan gyi sgron ma zhes bya ba'i man ngag thogs med kyis mdzad pa/ theg gsum rnam bzhag shan+ti pas mdzad pa rgyal ba'i lam la 'jug pa bud dha shri dz+nya nas mdzad pa/ de kho na nyid la 'jug pa'i 'grel pa dpal sbas kyis mdzad pa/ dbu ma rgyan gyi 'grel pa dbu ma'i lam grub pa rin chen 'byung gnas zhi bas mdzad pa/ bsam gtan gyi chos drug rnam par bzhag pa'i 'grel pa dā na shi las mdzad pa/ ting nge 'dzin gyi mi mthun pa'i phyogs rnam par bzhag pa sangs rgyas gsang bas mdzad pa/ rnal 'byor pa'i rtogs pa'i gegs sel sangs rgyas gsang bas mdzad pa/ rnam pa med pa'i tshig le'ur rgyas pa byams pa dpal gyis mdzad pa rnams bzhugs/

(khu)pa'i nang du/ byang chub lam gyi sgron ma la sogs jo bo rje'i chos chung brgya rtsar grags pa bzhugs/ 'di'i nang gi gzhung 'ga' zhig gzhan du yang yod mod 'dir yang thams cad phyogs mthun gyi dbang gis bris pa'o// (gu)pa la/ thub pa dgongs rgyan gyi bsdus don blo gros brtan pas mdzad pa/ thub pa'i dgongs pa'i rgyan a bh+ya ya ka ra gup+tas mdzad pa/ spong 'gyur bzhugs/ (ngu)pa la/ sngon 'jug la sogs pa'i lam gyi rim pa ji snyed cig gi sdom dang bcas pa ye shes sde'i yin nam snyam zer ba dang*/ gces pa bsdus pa'i phrin yig btsun pa dpal dbyangs kyis mdzad pa/ bsgom pa'i rim pa mdo kun las btus pa/ gcig char 'jug pa rnam par mi rtog pa'i bsgom don slob dpon bi ma mi tras mdzad pa/ dran pa gcig pa'i man ngag ye shes snying pos mdzad pa/ des mdzad pa'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa'i lam/ bla ma dam pa chos kyi rgyal po la bstod pa snyan dngags pa chen po k+ṣi ka ras mdzad pa/ shong 'gyur/ 'phags pa chos dbyings snying po'i 'grel pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ chos mngon pa kun las btus pa 'phags pa thogs med kyis mdzad pa mkhan po dz+nyi na mi tra/ shi len+t+ra bo dhe/ ye shes sde rnams kyi 'gyur/ de'i 'grel pa rgyal po sras kyis mdzad pa'i 'gog bden yan bzhugs (cu)pa la/ de'i lhag ma yongs su rdzogs pa ye shes sde dang nyi ma rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ mngon pa mdzod dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ de'i rang 'grel gyi lo'i tshad bshad pa yan bzhugs/ (chu)pa la/ de'i lhag ma yongs su rdzogs pa dang*/ mngon pa'i 'grel bshad rgyal po sras chags pa'i bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa'i bam po lnga pa yan dang*/ (ju)pa la/ gnas gsum pa yan dang*/ (nyu)pa la/ bam po zhe dgu pa yan dang*/ (tu)pa la/ yongs su rdzogs pa/ shud dha seng ha dang*/ dpal brtsegs 'gyur/ mngon pa'i 'grel bshad gang ba spel gyis mdzad pa'i stod/ (thu du)gnyis la yongs su rdzogs pa ka na ka wa rma dang*/

nyi ma grags kyis bsgyur ba bzhugs/ (nu)pa la/ mdzod kyi 'grel pa phyogs glang gis mdzad pa/ yon tan dpal dang*/ bsod nams 'od zer sogs kyi 'gyur/ mdzod kyi 'grel bshad nye bar mkho ba slob dpon zhi gnas lhas mdzad pa'i stod dang*/ (pu)pa la/ de'i 'jug yongs su rdzogs pa dza ya shri dang*/ shes rab 'od zer kyis bsgyur ba dang*/ mdzod kyi 'grel pa kha che 'dus bzang gis mdzad pa'i gnas gsum pa yan dang*/ (phu)pa la/ gnas bzhis man rdzogs pa dang*/ gzhung lugs kyi bye brag bkod pa'i 'khor lo dbyig bshes kyis mdzad pa/ sde tha dad par byed pa bsdus pa dul ba'i lhas mdzad pa/ sde tha dad par byed pa bshad pa bha bh+yas mdzad pa/ ched du brjod pa'i tshom dgra bcom pa chos skyabs kyis bsdus pa/ dpal brtsegs 'gyur/ de'i 'grel pa pradz+nya warmas mdzad pa legs par sbyangs pa'i tshom yan/ de rnams bzhugs/ (bu)pa la/ tshul khrims kyi tshom man chad rdzogs pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta dza nar dha dang*/ shākya blo gros kyis bsgyur ba rnams bzhugs/ (mu)pa la/ 'dul ba lung gzhi'i rgya cher 'grel dge legs bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa'i bam po bcu gsum pa yan dang*/ 'dul ba mdo'i rnam bshad pradz+nya a ka ras mdzad pa'i ma byin gyi lam gyi pham pa yan bzhugs/ (tsu)pa la/ de'i lhag ma yongs su rdzogs pa dang*/ so thar gyi 'grel pa sarba dz+nya de bas mdzad pa'i lhag ma brgyad pa yan dang*/ (tshu)pa la de'i mjug yongs su rdzogs pa cog ro klu'i rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur ba rnams bzhugs pa dang*/ so so thar pa'i tshig gi brjed byang bam po gnyis pa bzhugs/ (dzu)pa la/ thams cad yod par smra ba'i dge slong ma'i so so thar pa'i 'grel pa dang*/ dbu ma snying po'i 'grel pa rtog ge 'bar ba bha bh+ya kirtis mdzad pa'i smad bzhugs/ (wu)pa la/ so so thar pa'i 'grel pa bi ma la mi tras mdzad pa'i bam po bcu pa yan dang*/ (zhu)pa la/ brteg pa'i ltung byed yan dang*/

(zu)pa la/ yongs su rdzogs pa dang*/ so thar 'grel pa mi brjed dran byed bzhugs/ ('u)pa la/ 'dul ba la bstod pa dang*/ lung rnam 'byed kyi 'grel pa dul lhas mdzad pa gnyis cog ro 'gyur/ phran tshig gi 'grel pa tshul khrims bskyangs kyis mdzad pa'i bam po bdun pa yan dang*/ (yu)pa la/ de'i 'jug yongs su rdzogs pa dge ba'i blo gros kyi 'gyur/ 'dul ba bsdus pa khyad par bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa mkhan po shi len tra la sogs pa'i 'gyur/ 'dul ba mdo rtsa ba yon tan 'od kyis mdzad pa/ klu'i rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ de rnams bzhugs/ (ru)pa dang*/ (lu)pa gnyis kyi nang du/ mdo rtsa'i 'grel pa yon tan 'od kyis mdzad pa/ tshul khrims 'byung gnas kyis bsgyur ba bzhugs/ (shu)pa la/ yon tan 'od kyi mdo rtsa'i rang 'grel chung ba bzhugs/ (su)pa la/ las brgya rtsa gcig pa yon tan 'od kyis mdzad pa klu'i rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ 'dul ba mdo rtsa'i 'grel pa chos shes kyis mdzad pa'i mi tshangs spyod kyis pham pa'i skabs yan dang*/ (hu u) (ke)rnams la yongs su rdzogs pa dang*/ me tog phreng rgyud sa ga'i lhas mdzad pa dang*/ bya ba'i phung po zhes bya ba dang*/ dri ba'i tshig le'ur byas pas ka la ya na mi tras mdzad pa/ dpal brtsegs kyis bsgyur ba rnams bzhugs/ (khe)pa la/ ka ri ka sum brgya pa rtsa ba dang*/ 'grel pa 'od ldan gnyis shākya 'od kyis mdzad pa/ pradz+nya de ba dang*/ ban dhe rtsang de ban tra rak+ṣi ta'i 'gyur/ sum brgya pa'i rnams bshad shākya 'od kyis mdzad pa/ dge ba'i blo gros kyi 'gyur/ ka ri ka lnga bcu pa sam gha bha tras mdzad pa/ ka ri ka lnga bcu pa'i 'grel pa ka ma la shi las mdzad pa/ dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa brgyad pa rtsa 'grel gnyis su na ya shris mdzad pa/ dar ma grags kyi 'gyur/ gleng gzhi dang gang zag bsdus pa'i tshig le'ur byas pa shri bha tras mdzad pa/ gzhon nu mchog gis bsgyur ba rnams bzhugs/

(ge)pa la/ pha rol gyi don grub pa'i tshig le'ur byas pa dge srung gis mdzad pa dpal brtsegs 'gyur/ tshad ma kun las btus rtsa 'grel gnyis phyogs glang gis mdzad pa/ su dha na rak+ṣi ta dang*/ dge bsnyen seng ge rgyal mtshan 'gyur/ kun las btus kyi 'grel bshad rgyal ba'i dbang po'i blo gros kyis mdzad pa'i stod dang*/ lhag ma yongs su rdzogs pa blo gros 'gyur/ (nge)pa la/ tshad ma rnams 'grel chos kyi grags pas mdzad pa/ rnam 'grel gyi rnam bshad lha dbang blos mdzad pa'i stod dang*/ (ce)pa la/ de'i lhag ma cung ma tshang ba dang*/ rnam 'grel gyi 'grel bshad shākya blos mdzad pa'i stod dang*/ (che je) gnyis la de'i 'jug yongs su rdzogs pa ste de gnyis dge blo'i 'gyur/ rnam 'grel gyi 'grel pa nyi ma sbas pas mdzad pa'i stod dang*/ (nye)pa la/ de'i smad rnams dang*/ tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi rgyan shes rab 'byung gnas sbas pas mdzad pa'i stod dang*/ (tethe)gnyis la/ de'i mjug rdzogs pa/ skal ldan rgyal po dang rngog 'gyur/ rnam 'grel le'u dang po'i 'grel bshad shin tu yongs su dag pa zhes bya ba'i stod dang*/ (de)pa'i nang du/ de'i lhag ma yongs su rdzogs pa dza ma ris mdzad pa dang*/ rgyan gyi 'grel bshad rgyal ba can gyis mdzad pa/ byang chub shes rab 'gyur gyi stod dang*/ (ne pe) gnyis la yongs su rdzogs pa dang*/ bde byed dga' bas byas pa'i bam po gnyis pa yan dang*/ (phe)pa la/ de'i lhag la ji snyed 'gyur ba dang*/ tshad ma rnam nges dpal chos kyi grags pas mdzad pa/ kha che gzhan la phan pa bzang po dang*/ rngog blo'i 'gyur/ de rnams bzhugs/ (be)pa la/ tshad ma rnams nges kyi 'grel bshad ye shes bzang pos mdzad pa/ chos kyi brtson grus kyi 'gyur/ rnam nges kyi 'grel bshad 'thad ldan chos mchog gis mdzad pa'i stod dang*/ (me tse)gnyis la rdzogs pa/ rngog 'gyur/ rigs pa'i thig pa/ de'i 'grel pa dum bhas mdzad pa/

gtan tshigs kyi de kho na nyid bstan pa dze ta ris mdzad pa/ rig thig gi don bsdus dzi na mi tras mdzad pa/ rig thig gi phyogs snga la mdor bsdus pa ka ma la shi las mdzad pa/ gtan tshigs thigs pa chos kyi grags pas mdzad pa/ de'i 'grel pa pradz+nya bār ma dang*/ dpal brtsegs 'gyur/ gtan tshigs thig pa'i 'grel pa'i bram ze la rdza tas mdzad pa'i stod bzhugs/ (tshe)pa la/ de'i smad rdzogs pa dang*/ rtsod pa'i rigs pa dharma kirtis mdzad pa/ de'i 'grel pa dum bhas mdzad pa mjug ma tshang ba/ de'i 'grel pa don rnams 'byed shan+ti ri ka tas mdzad pa/ 'brel pa brtag pa'i rab byed dharmā kirtis mdzad pa/ dz+nya na garba dang*/ nam mkha'i 'gyur/ slar yang dpal 'byor zhi ba dang*/ ting nge 'dzin bzang po'i 'gyur/ slob dpon des mdzad pa'i rgyud gzhan grub pa dpal brtsegs 'gyur/ 'brel pa brtag pa dga' ba'i rang 'grel ba'i rdo rje'i 'gyur/ 'brel brtag gi 'grel pa slob dpon dul ba'i lhas mdzad pa/ nam mkha'i 'gyur/ 'brel brtag rjes su 'brang ba bram ze bde byed dga' bas mdzad pa rnams bzhugs/ (dze)pa'i nang du/ rgyud gzhan grub pa'i 'grel bshad dul lhas mdzad pa/ dpal brtsegs 'gyur/ dmigs pa brtag pa phyogs glang gis mdzad pa/ de'i 'grel pa dang*/ 'grel bshad gnyis dul lhas mdzad pa/ dpal brtsegs 'gyur/ rig pa la 'jug pa phyogs glang gis mdzad pa/ chos rin 'gyur/ rig pa grub pa'i sgron ma tsan+t+ra go mis mdzad pa/ bā+ai ro tsa na'i 'gyur/ nang gi khyab pa rin chen 'byung gnas zhi bas mdzad pa/ shākya 'od kyi 'gyur/ byis pa 'jug pa'i rtog ge dgra las rgyal bas mdzad pa/ dpal mchog dang po'i rdo rje'i 'gyur/ rigs pa'i sbyor ba rin chen rdo rjes mdzad pa/ ting 'dzin bzang po'i 'gyur/ rgyu dang 'bras bu'i ngo bo grub pa dz+nya na mi tras mdzad pa/ shākya 'od kyi 'gyur/ sel ba grub pa bram ze shi kā ra nan das mdzad pa/

gzhan sel grub pa/ tshad ma brtag pa gnyis dang de gsum chos mchog gi mdzad pa/ 'brel pa grub pa dge bsnyen dam pa shang ka ra na das mdzad pa/ bka' yang dag pa'i tshad ma las mdo btus pa/ 'di yi bar na le'u bcu bzhi pa yan ma tshang 'dug /skad cig ma 'jig pa grub pa chos mchog dang*/ de rnams skal ldan rgyal po dang*/ blo ldan shes rab 'gyur/ skad cig ma 'jig pa/ grub pa'i 'grel pa bram ze mu tig bum pas mdzad pa/ grags 'byor shes rab kyi 'gyur/ thos pa brtag pa/ gzhan sel brtag pa/ dbang phyug 'jig pa/ de gsum dge srung gis mdzad pa/ rnam par rig 'jig rten pha rol grub pa chos mchog gis mdzad pa/ skal ldan rgyal po dang*/ nyi ma grags kyi 'gyur gtan tshigs gi 'khor lo gtan la dbab pa'i phyogs glang gis mdzad pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa grub pa'i tshig le'ur byas pa dge srung gis mdzad pa// rnam par rig pa tsam nyid grub pa shan+ti pas mdzad pa/ de kho na nyid bsdus pa zhi ba 'tshos mdzad pa/ zhi ba 'od kyi 'gyur rnams bzhugs/ (we)pa'i nang du/ de kho na nyid bsdus pa'i dka' 'grel ka ma la shi las mdzad pa'i stod dang*/ (zhe)pa la/ de'i smad rdzogs pa/ mkhan po de ban tra bha tra dang*/ grags 'byor shes rab 'gyur/ bka' bcad kyi skor

tsan tra pa ma tshang ba bzhugs/ (ze)pa'i nang du/ smra sgo mtshon cha can smri tis mdzad pa de nyid kyi 'gyur/ sgra ka la pa'i mdo smad nas cung ma tshang ba dang*/ snyan ngag gi me long dbyug pa can gyis mdzad pa shong 'gyur/ gnas drug pa'i sman dpyad yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po btus pa dge 'dun gsang ba'i bu ma khol gyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dza ran dha ra dang*/ dge slong rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur bzhugs/ ('e ye re le she se)rnams la/ yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po btus pa'i 'grel pa/ tshig gi don gyi zla zer zhes bya ba/ chags pa la dga' ba'i bu zla ba la dga' bas mdzad pa/ 'gyur gong dang 'dra ba bzhugs/ 'grel pa 'di la gong 'og 'khrug nas the tshom gyi gzhi mang du ma dpe la snang nas re shig blo ma rnyed pas 'di yi gzhung dang bstun nas 'khrug bsdeb dgos so// sman 'tsho ba'i mdo klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ sbyor ba brgya pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa bhud dha shi dz+nya na dang*/ blo gros brtan pa'i 'gyur/ thor bu sbyor ba brgya pa/ (he)pa la/ las gdags pa tshigs bcu gcig /'jig rten bzhag pa tshig bcu bzhi pa/ rgyu gdags pa tshig bcu dgu pa rnams/ ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur ba bzhugs so// po ti (e)pa'i nang du/ lo ts+tsha ba chen po rnams kyis mdzad pa'i bstan bcos grags che ba la chos kyi rnam grangs kyi brjed byang*/ dpal brtsegs rak+ṣi ta la sogs pa rnams kyis mdzad/ shes rab snying po'i 'grel pa bhe ro tsa nas mdzad/ gces pa bsdus pa'i 'phrin yig btsun pa dpal dbyangs kyis mdzad/ 'phags pa mdo sde sna tshogs kyi mdo btus dpal brtsegs kyis mdzad pa/ lta ba'i rim pa'i man ngag ka ba dpal brtsegs kyis mdzad// lta ba'i khyad par ye shes sdes mdzad/ lhag mthong bskyed pa'i thabs/ sems gnas par bya ba'i thabs/ zhi gnas la 'jug pa/ bkas bcad bam po gnyis pa/ sgra'i rnam par dbye ba su ban/

bzang spyod smon lam gyi 'grel pa brda 'phrad sla bar brjed byang du byas pa/ slob dpon bdun gyi nyams kyi man ngag gi rtogs tshad bstan pa bzhugs/ dbyangs 'char ba g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba'i rgyud phyi rol pa'i ston pa dbang phyug chen pos bshad pa/ pe'u ris dang bcas pa bzhugs so// de ltar sngags dang mtshan nyid theg pa yi// dgongs 'grel bstan bcos bod du 'gyur ro 'tshal// glegs bam dag tu phyogs gcig bris pa yis// rgyal ba'i bstan pa yun ring gnas gyur cig /'di yi phyogs su sgo gsum re res kyang*// ngal ba mchis pa'i bdag sogs 'gro ba rnams// deng nas bzung nas tshe rabs thams cad du// mtshungs med chos rjes rjes su 'dzin gyur cig /shubhaṃ maṃghalaṃ bha wan+tu/// /
